items.name: dsh-tui-pro

items.name: dsh-file-upload

items.name: dsh-peak-indicator

items.name: dsh-tianshu-tui

items.name: dsh-bloub-mood

items.name: dsh-codex-timeline

items.name: dsh-chat-outline

items.name: dsh-mobile
items.desc: Mobile adapter for the DSH web shell: overlay sidebar/details drawers, responsive composer and settings below 768px, zero desktop regression.

items.name: dsh-codex-ui

items.name: dsh-shorts-wall

items.name: dsh-ui-tweaks

items.name: deepseek-harness-genui

items.name: dsh-client-ui-writing

items.name: dsh-timeline-rail
items.desc: Message timeline rail for DeepSeek Harness web chat: evenly spaced ticks for each user message on the right edge, click to jump, hover to preview.

items.name: dsh-smooth-stream

items.name: dsh-plugin-smooth-stream

items.name: dsh-sticky-disclosure

items.name: dsh-wallpaper-engine#plugin

items.name: dsh-media-preview

items.name: dsh-pet

items.name: dsh-model-search

items.name: dsh-prompt

items.name: dsh-model-picker

items.name: arcana
items.desc: A floating command deck that lists every slash command in DeepSeek Harness as runnable buttons, sorted by usage.

items.name: dsh-ui-hub
items.desc: UI butler for every plugin UI: official/plugin categories, per-widget toggles, drag move/resize, collision avoidance and one-click auto arrange.

items.name: dsh-recall-unread
items.desc: Adds a strip above the composer that lists sent-but-unread (steering) text messages and recalls them before the model reads them, one by one or all at once.

items.name: dsh-ui-mobile
items.desc: Mobile-first DeepSeek Harness UI with an installable PWA, responsive navigation, and Web Push notifications when an agent completes successfully.

items.name: dsh-right-sidebar
items.desc: DSH Web right-side output dock: session-scoped tabs for reports, images, data, video, and audio, with inline previews, output quality checks, and a searchable per-turn history.

items.name: dsh-writing-pad
items.desc: Session-scoped Markdown writing pad docked beside the conversation, with edit/preview modes, selection-based AI rewrites, diff review, undo, and draft recovery.

items.name: folder-tree-sh
items.desc: Workspace file tree for the Web UI: multi-tab preview (text/DOCX/PDF/Markdown/CSV/images), inline Markdown editing, a Git changes panel, and file operations (rename/delete/copy/move/create) via context menu.

items.name: ex-setting
items.desc: Settings extensions for DSH.

items.name: web-components
items.desc: Web Components support.

items.name: dsh-bili-widget
items.desc: Floating Bilibili video mini-player for DSH — always-on-top window with discover/search/follow-UP channels, auto-playlist, mini & focus modes, persisted watch history and window minimize-to-ball.

items.name: dsh-shortcuts
items.desc: Fully customizable keyboard shortcuts for the Web UI: 34 pre-registered features (sessions, views, clipboard, models, silent permission cycling, settings), one-click recording to bind your own, and a shortcut cheatsheet with built-in diagnostics.

items.name: dsh-turn-navigator
items.desc: Turn navigation for the DSH Web UI.

items.name: dsh-web-preview-float
items.desc: Google AI Studio-style floating preview for the Web UI: a draggable/resizable iframe preview with aspect-ratio and resolution presets, plus a VS Code-style code window with direct editing, confirmed writes, and session-log recording.

items.name: dsh-ds-attach
items.desc: **DeepSeek Chat (chat.deepseek.com) same-style attachments**: paperclip upload button, 240×64 DS-style file cards with official colored doc icons (PDF/DOCX/XLSX/PPT/IMG extracted from the DS frontend bundle), drag-and-drop, text extraction (PDF/DOCX/XLSX/TXT) injected into the message, and real attachment cards rendered in the transcript (custom user renderer) with the model reading full content.

items.name: dsh-tui
items.desc: Clean and simple TUI.

items.name: dsh-open-explorer
items.desc: Adds buttons to open the current DSH workspace root in the host file manager.

items.name: dsh-web-launcher
items.desc: Windows desktop launcher bundle for DSH Web that creates a managed shortcut, then restarts DSH in the background and refreshes the existing browser page.

items.name: dsh-tick-rail
items.desc: Tick-rail conversation navigator: one tick per message you sent, a lit peak that follows the mouse with an even falloff, hover previews, click or keyboard to jump.

items.name: dsh-file
items.desc: VS Code-style file manager: browse the conversation workspace in a sidebar tree and edit files in the center column with Monaco, with theme import/export and Markdown preview.

items.name: whale-on-desk
items.desc: Pixel-art whale desktop companion with 29 frame-audited states — taps the glass and flashes the tab title when an approval waits, speaks a completion report when a turn ends, and adds a slash-command palette to the web client.

items.name: pbr-render
items.desc: PBR 3D model preview for game art: GLB/GLTF with textures, IBL environment lighting, orbit controls, and a material channel inspector (baseColor/normal/roughness/metallic/AO/emissive/wireframe); scalar channels shown as grayscale per PBR spec, via the pbr3d fence and pbr_render tool.

items.name: dsh-line-select
items.desc: Line-range selection: browse workspace files, preview code with line numbers, visually select a line range, and write a `@path:start-end` reference into the composer; the agent receives the exact selected lines on send.

items.name: dsh-system-monitor
items.desc: Displays real-time CPU and memory usage for the machine running the DSH Web server.

items.name: dsh-tui-app
items.desc: Interactive terminal chat app for dsh: streaming conversation, tool cards, jobs panel, full-text search, trajectory replay, multi-session tabs, and A2A dispatch (Ink-based).

items.name: dsh-file-uploads
items.desc: Upload arbitrary local files from the Web composer, show pending cards, and manage stored files in Settings.

items.name: dsh-prompt-enhancer
items.desc: Adds a prompt-enhancement button to the DSH composer that rewrites drafts into agent-ready prompts.

items.name: dsh-chat-width-customizer
items.desc: Session-header button that cycles the conversation width (748-1600px), widening the chat column, composer, and user bubbles together.

items.name: dsh-turn-marks
items.desc: Left-edge turn-marks strip in chat: one bar per user message, click to jump to that message, hover for a preview, active bar turns white.

items.name: dsh-restart-fab
items.desc: Floating restart button for the DSH web GUI: restarts the dsh process in place with a full-screen overlay and auto-reloads the page; no launcher script required, works on Windows/macOS/Linux.

items.name: dsh-side-monitor
items.desc: Sidebar system monitor for the DSH Web UI: live host overview (CPU/memory/network/disk), process list, and Docker container status, all read-only.

items.name: dsh-sticker-board
items.desc: Fridge-magnet quick-task stickers docked above the composer: one-click sends a preloaded prompt into the current session, grouped long-term/short-term.

items.name: dsh-sampling-sliders
items.desc: Model sampling sliders (temperature / maxTokens) in the composer: override every model request for all providers via the agent/request hook, with hot/persist modes.

items.name: dsh-client-ui-quote
items.desc: Adds a removable quote banner above the web chat composer for text selected from an AI reply, included in the next message.

items.name: dsh-plugins#dsh-mobile-ui
items.desc: Mobile UI for the Web GUI on narrow screens: full-width responsive layout, overlay session drawer, 44px touch targets, safe-area support, and reading enhancements with zero desktop impact.

items.name: dsh-pet
items.desc: Native desktop pet for DSH that follows agent activity, supports Codex pet packages, and imports approved pets directly from Petdex without its CLI.

items.name: dsh-workspace-files-explorer
items.desc: Floating workspace file-tree browser for the Web GUI with line-numbered syntax highlighting and Markdown preview.

items.name: ai-input-enhancer
items.desc: Adds prompt optimization, cancellation, and undo controls to the DeepSeek Harness composer.

items.name: dph-taskboard
items.desc: Session-based task board in the sidebar: drag sessions into todo/doing/review/done columns, create sessions with model and reasoning-effort selection, trash with restore, notes, export/import.

items.name: dsh-multi-lang-ui
items.desc: Add six languages (繁體中文, 日本語, 한국어, Français, Deutsch, Español) to the DeepSeek Harness Web UI language options, with hand-polished per-language translations and automatic fallbacks (Simplified-to-Traditional conversion for zh-TW, English for the others) covering upstream updates and third-party plugins.

items.name: easy-archive
items.desc: Two-step inline archive on workspace sidebar rows — one click arms a red confirm, the second click archives; the archive entry is removed from the ⋮ menu.

items.name: dsh-github-picker
items.desc: Composer GitHub picker: click the GitHub icon at the bottom-right of the input box to search the workspace repository's issues and pull requests via the gh CLI, and insert the reference as a URL or @owner/repo#number mention.

items.name: dsh-workspace-dir
items.desc: Shows the current conversation's working directory in a draggable directory panel with adjustable opacity.

items.name: dsh-airdrop
items.desc: ⭐ Drag-and-drop uploads of any file or whole folders, anywhere in the window; remote-safe — bytes go straight into the session workspace on the server, so a DSH deployed on a remote machine works exactly like localhost.

items.name: dsh-conversation-rail
items.desc: Left-edge conversation rail for the Web UI: one bar per turn, length scaled to the turn text, hover for a question and answer preview, click to jump; bars come from a host-side outline of the whole session log, so turns outside the loaded window are drawn too and history is paged in on click.

items.name: dsh-sticky-notes
items.desc: Workspace sticky notes for DSH, saved as multiple Markdown files under the current workspace.

items.name: dsh-sidebar-width
items.desc: Control the Web UI left sidebar width: lower the 264px drag minimum and optionally tune the drag maximum and the expanded default width, applied by a startup patch of the ui-layout bundle.

items.name: dsh-balance
items.desc: Composer-dock balance/usage readout for DeepSeek, Kimi Coding, OpenCode Go, Zhipu, MiniMax, OpenRouter and OpenAI Codex — provider-based, 2s polling, 5min cache.

items.name: dsh-interrupt-button
items.desc: A green interrupt button beside the send box: silently stops a running agent, which then summarizes its progress and asks for your new requirements, with a customizable interrupt prompt.

items.name: dsh-whale-desktop-launcher
items.desc: Windows desktop launcher for DSH with a whale-girl icon, background server startup, and a Chromium app-mode window without browser chrome.

items.name: dsh-no-setup-mode
items.desc: No-setup mode for the DSH web UI: hides advanced surfaces, auto-applies best defaults (chat mode, full access, account balance), and one-click role-play personas (maid/butler).

items.name: dsh-modal-enhancer
items.desc: Window-like controls for every Web UI modal: drag by title bar, eight-way resize, pin against outside clicks, maximize to the full viewport, removable backdrop blur, and per-dialog persistent state.

items.name: dsh-claude-style-reasoning-slider
items.desc: Animated Claude-style reasoning-effort slider and model picker that replaces the native DSH model selector.

items.name: dsh-plugin-collapsible-steps
items.desc: Collapses consecutive tool-use and thinking steps between messages into a single bracketed, expandable item.

items.name: dsh-custom-ui
items.desc: Right-side file-tree sidebar that opens workspace files, plus a DeepSeek account balance meter in the composer stats line.

items.name: dsh-desktop#bundle
items.desc: Desktop profile for dsh: native Tauri window over the harness web surface with tray, native notifications, a file-manager panel, and one-click updates.

items.name: dsh-prompt-optimizer
items.desc: Optimize Prompt button under the composer: one click rewrites your draft into a clearer, more executable prompt, with a before-and-after dialog and one-click replacement.

items.name: dsh-process-fold
items.desc: Folds each DSH Web turn's thinking, tool calls and context into bordered process boxes cut at every piece of model text; a collapsed box shows its latest two items, the stacked lines above its border open that one box, the border itself folds it back, and user dialogue, interactive questions and model text stay outside.

items.name: dsh-file-preview#dsh-file-preview
items.desc: Floating workspace file-preview window for the Web client: lazy file tree, CodeMirror preview and in-window edit with save, Markdown and image preview, Quick Open search, and opening paths clicked in the conversation.

items.name: better-reasoning-slider
items.desc: Official-style composer model trigger with a floating reasoning-effort slider popup.

items.name: dsh-approval-translator
items.desc: DSH审批汉化 — approval dialogs translated to Chinese before they render: DeepSeek-powered, host-side, nothing for React to revert.

items.name: dsh-mobile-glass
items.desc: Mobile adaptation for the DSH Web UI on narrow screens: reveal drawer with the chat layer on top, drag gestures, bottom-sheet settings panel, composer and header fixes, zero desktop impact.

items.name: dsh-postman
items.desc: Upload files and folders straight into the conversation — images attach as real message blocks, text content is written into the composer draft, folders land by directory structure.

items.name: dsh-workspace-menu
items.desc: Workspace/chat context menu for the DSH home page: pin, rename, open in file explorer, archive, fork, copy, and open in a new window.

items.name: dsh-forge-studio#plugin-notes
items.desc: Sticky-notes board for DeepSeek Harness: a sidebar entry opens a Markdown note panel with auto-save, colors, image paste and task-list rendering.

items.name: dsh-about
items.desc: Adds an "About" settings page to the DeepSeek Harness web interface, showing the running DSH version and recent release notes.

items.name: dsh-prompt-polish
items.desc: Input-bar prompt optimizer: rewrites drafts with 6 strategies × 3 languages plus custom instructions, optional goal/todo/compaction-summary/tool-result and chat context, a confirm dialog, last-5 history and three-tier settings persistence.

items.name: agent-body#dsh-anatomy-panel
items.desc: Anatomy panel for the Agent-Body organs: serves a live vitals dashboard at /anatomy inside the harness itself - organs, heartbeat, healing ledger, self-training counters and the real pulse stream - read straight from the runtime files rather than retyped. Host-only, no client bundle and no build step.

items.name: dsh-text-inject
items.desc: Adds a "Text Injection" section to the DSH Settings sidebar: user-maintained blocks in a standalone Markdown file are injected into the system prompt every turn or into session context with keyword gating, with hot reload and automatic history backups.

items.name: dsh-plugin-crypto-ticker
items.desc: A live crypto ticker card in the DeepSeek Harness sidebar footer, above the balance and Settings, showing BTC, ETH, SOL and JUP prices, 24-hour change and 24-point sparklines, with a pulse on each price tick, zero dependencies and no API key.

items.name: dsh-harness-chat-control
items.desc: Adds ChatGPT-style stop, edit-and-resend, native quote annotations, and an independent sidebar follow-up chat with model and image input for DeepSeek Harness Desktop.

items.name: dsh-session-diff
items.desc: Session-scoped diff view for the DSH Web right sidebar: opening a file the current conversation changed renders it in place with git-style added/removed line backgrounds, +/− gutter markers and dual old/new line numbers under syntax colouring, a header with +added −removed counts, a Changes only / Whole file toggle and a Re-read button, plus a companion tab that lists every file the session changed and opens each one in the same view. Files the conversation did not touch keep the shipped text viewer.

items.name: dsh-draft-attachments
items.desc: Persists unsent composer attachments per session, so images and files pasted into the input box survive page switches, conversation switches and app restarts: the bytes are mirrored in IndexedDB and handed back through the official createDrafts/addAttachments channel, and are dropped as soon as the message is sent or you remove them.

items.name: dsh-integration-settings
items.desc: Adds three visual pages to DSH Settings: MCP servers (managed by rewriting the profile patch managed block from a JSON source of truth, with YAML validation and timestamped backups), skills (browse, create, edit and delete across DSH global, shared .agents and Claude / Codex directories) and the global AGENTS.md persona (with one-click restore of the last three backups).

items.name: dsh-task-monitor#dsh-task-monitor
items.desc: Right-side overlay panel for DSH sessions showing git status, background jobs, skills and MCP usage, artifacts and visited pages, with a commit/push dialog and one-click GitHub publish.

items.name: dsh-plugin-namecards
items.desc: Icon, Chinese display name and a one-line note for every DSH plugin, organized with folders, favorites, drag or pinyin ordering, list and grid views. Icons are auto-assigned to all installed plugins and can be overridden; import and export cover icons, names, notes, folders and order. Display-only: plugin files and cordis config are never modified; enable switches call the official plugin manager.

items.name: dsh-pinned-sessions
items.desc: A pinned-sessions group in the sidebar, above the workspace list: every pinned session across all workspaces in one collapsible, searchable list, with click-to-open and a hover-revealed unpin button.

items.name: amoji#amoji
items.desc: AI-native expressions for two-way chat: people see images, while text-only models read fixed meanings; includes a picker, custom expressions, import/export, and two visual styles.

items.name: dsh-weekly-check#dsh-weekly-panel
items.desc: Sidebar panel for a weekly, human-curated Chinese ranking of the DSH ecosystem: 31 tracked projects (17 installable plugins plus tools/skills) ranked by live GitHub stars with week-over-week deltas, and a real-call availability survey of the "free" models. Sponsor slots are labelled and sit outside the ranking.

items.name: chicheng-peak
items.desc: Edge breathing border showing DeepSeek peak/valley hours, with flowing light and scheduled push reminders.

items.name: chicheng-quickinput
items.desc: Vault button beside the DSH composer: save keys, servers, phone numbers, addresses and URLs, auto-collected from conversations, password-protected with WebDAV backup; click to insert, Ctrl+click to send.

items.name: dsh-douyin-webview
items.desc: An embedded Douyin window docked in the DSH sidebar: a real Electron webview guest, so douyin.com's X-Frame-Options: DENY no longer applies.

items.name: dsh-tool-explorer
items.desc: Skills and MCP management console in the settings panel: merged skill catalog across every provider (hierarchical browse by source, online create/edit, independent model and user invocation switches, recoverable trash), GitHub install with multi-select batch install and update checks, MCP server add/edit/remove and enable/disable through the profile patch layer, cross-agent import from Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Cline, Roo Code, Continue and Windsurf, and an independent SDK connection probe.

items.name: dsh-chat-width
items.desc: Drag-to-resize the chat content width in the DeepSeek Harness web UI: a handle on the column right edge overrides the built-in 748px width (default 1040px, 520-2400 range, persisted per browser, double-click resets).

items.name: dsh-session-turn-eta
items.desc: Live progress bar under the composer with a percentage and an estimated time left for the current DeepSeek Harness turn; the estimate re-anchors as the turn runs and never reads 100% until the turn ends, and the bar turns red when the turn fails or is interrupted.

items.name: dsh-openviking-enhance
items.desc: OpenViking in the DSH web GUI: a Studio panel, a per-session memory-commit status pill with its commit timeline, and a right-sidebar tab showing what the current session retrieves.

items.name: dsh-chat-toc
items.desc: Interactive chat table of contents with bookmarks, turn pinning, global shortcuts, and heading extraction.

items.name: dsh-better-display
items.desc: A calmer reading view for DeepSeek Harness: native process details, live reasoning, and clean final answers.

items.name: dsh-dragndrop-attachments
items.desc: Adds drag-and-drop attachments for local files, folders, ZIP archives and Office documents.

items.name: dsh-watcher
items.desc: Read-only session work-path observer: fold turns into stage, run, duration and tok/s summaries, then expand parallel branches, tool results and vendor-visible reasoning.

items.name: dsh-callout
items.desc: GitHub-style alert cards for DSH assistant Markdown: a qualifying `> [!NOTE]`, TIP, IMPORTANT, WARNING, or CAUTION blockquote becomes a theme-aware card. Stored session content is left unchanged.

items.name: dsh-keyboard-manager
items.desc: Keyboard shortcuts for the DSH Web UI: Ctrl+Q toggles the left sidebar, Ctrl+E toggles the right panel, and Ctrl+S opens Settings. Physical key codes can be overridden in the profile patch.

items.name: dsh-panel-tint
items.desc: Add independent opacity controls for the sidebar, message panels and composer in dsh web.

items.name: dsh-question-nav
items.desc: In-session question navigator for the DSH Web UI: a dot minimap on the conversation edge (left or right, configurable in settings), one dot per user question — hover shows the full question text, click jumps to it.

items.name: dsh-deepseek-web-relay
items.desc: Adds a native sidebar menu item in DSH that opens chat.deepseek.com in a standalone browser window with persistent login, and supports bidirectional text selection transfer between DSH and the web page.

items.name: dsh-livebench-rankings
items.desc: LiveBench leaderboard for DSH — discovers the release the official site currently publishes, then reads its CSV and category JSON, and renders model rankings in an isolated same-origin iframe opened from a button beside the composer. Search, organization / open-weight / reasoning filters, per-category sorting, task-level detail, up to four models side by side, CSV export; refreshes every 60 s by default (configurable 30–3600) and caches only to the plugin's own .cache/rankings.json.

items.name: dsh-rtl-chat
items.desc: Right-to-left reading mode for the conversation answer area, with a button to switch back to left-to-right.

items.name: dsh-tmux-cc
items.desc: Persistent tmux control-mode cockpit for DSH Web that mirrors native panes in a dock.

items.name: dsh-brand
items.desc: One-click brand replacement for the DSH web GUI — logo, product name, version badge, hero headline, tab title and favicon.

items.name: dsh-coding-workspace
items.desc: Coding workbench for DSH: docked workspace panels, a grouped project sidebar, split editor tab groups with hibernate/resume, file preview and diff views — built on parallel git worktree development with cross-session collaboration primitives.

items.name: dsh-plugin-lx-music
items.desc: Shows the lyrics LX Music is playing in a floating panel on the right of the DSH conversation page, with previous / play-pause / next controls. Scroll the lyric window to read ahead, double-click a line to start the song there, and if the player is not running, pressing play starts it in the system tray. Windows only, and LX Music has to be installed with its local Open API enabled.

items.name: dsh-conversation-map
items.desc: Conversation minimap docked on the right edge of the dsh Web chat: colour-block and to-scale thumbnail modes, drag-to-resize (10–320px), hover loupe preview, click-to-jump and drag-to-scroll with a live viewport indicator, and collapse to a 4px strip.

items.name: dsh-status-telemetry
items.desc: Adds a session status pill to the composer dock that expands into a panel of turn, token, performance and context readings.

items.name: dsh-docking-layout
items.desc: Dockable DSH Web UI layout that organizes conversations as tabs across draggable split groups.

items.name: dsh-clean-desktop-shell-pro
items.desc: Enhanced desktop shell for DSH: auto-starts the local backend on launch (no browser tab), asks before closing the backend on quit, and starts the backend in parallel with Electron for faster cold start. Fork of dsh-clean-desktop-shell.

items.name: dsh-worktable#01_content
items.desc: Workbench plugin for the DeepSeek Harness web UI: collects your own projects and mounted plugin entries with rename, icon, sort, show/hide, project-to-session binding and a per-project file cabinet, adds a split-pane workspace engine with draggable panes, tabbed windows and built-in Explorer, terminal, browser, animation and custom panes, and auto-mounts an agent output into the matching window when it writes widget-result.json.

items.name: dsh-plugin-offpeak-badge
items.desc: Shows whether the DeepSeek API is currently billing at the off-peak or peak rate in the sidebar brand row, with the Chinese statutory-holiday calendar built in and zh/en copy.

items.name: dsh-xiaoke-widget
items.desc: A Claude-persona desktop pet pinned to the bottom-right corner of the DSH web GUI — shows balance, today's usage, peak/off-peak pricing and per-turn cost, with editable bubbles (text, balance, usage, pricing, images, random lines and weighted choices), per-line styles and fonts, a floating quick editor, sound effects, and custom character/audio. Ships animated roles that breathe and blink, plus a balance-alert variant that switches to a crying face when the balance falls below the alert line; 256/384 animation tiers and an optional 512 HD pack installed from the resource manager. 63 Claude-flavored lines. A derivative of MeteorNOX/DeepSeek-Balance-Whale-Widget (MIT).

items.name: dock
items.desc: VSCode-style workbench shell for the DSH Web UI: activity bar, side bar, editor area, panel and status bar, with a registry service (ctx.workbench) for mounting panels, views and commands.

items.name: dock-editor
items.desc: Text viewer and editor for the dock workbench: undo/redo, Ctrl+S save, unsaved-change confirmation and binary detection, registered as the default file viewer.

items.name: dock-files
items.desc: File explorer for the dock workbench: tree browsing of the session workspace with create/rename/copy-paste/delete, drag-and-drop import and paste of local files and clipboard images.

items.name: dock-git
items.desc: Git history visualization for the dock workbench: swimlane commit graph, branch and tag management, stage/commit/push and remote operations.

items.name: dock-images
items.desc: Image viewer for the dock workbench: PNG, JPEG, GIF, WebP, BMP, SVG, ICO and AVIF, with SVG rendered as image data only.

items.name: dock-markdown
items.desc: Markdown viewer for the dock workbench: GFM rendering with DOMPurify sanitization, document outline and relative-path image/link resolution, with one-click switch to editing.

items.name: dock-spreadsheet
items.desc: Read-only XLSX, XLS, ODS, CSV and TSV viewer for dock-files with worksheet tabs, sorting, filters, search and cell links.

items.name: dsh-fullscreen-input
items.desc: Adds a full-screen panel to the DSH composer for writing multi-line text, movable and resizable, sharing one draft with the composer; Enter inserts a newline and only Ctrl+Enter sends, so an IME cannot turn Shift+Enter into a send.

items.name: dsh-right-click-menu
items.desc: Adds a right-click menu to the DSH web UI for files and for links: a file-tree row, a file path or file mention in a chat message, or a hyperlink opens a menu that previews a file in DSH, opens it in the default application or a chosen associated one, reveals it in the file manager, copies the path, the workspace-relative path, the file name, the link address, the link text or the file contents, saves a copy elsewhere, and opens an HTTP(S) link in the sidebar browser or in the system browser, while a right-click that is not on a file or a link keeps the browser's own menu.

items.name: dsh-custom-plugin
items.desc: Web GUI convenience suite with appearance controls, timeline navigation, project folders, prompts, conversation export, Mermaid rendering, quote reply, and DeepSeek balance and daily token usage.

items.name: dsh-ui-enhancer
items.desc: Desktop-style UI enhancements for the DSH Web client: adaptive wallpapers, a desktop pet companion with an activity feed and feeding economy, @file workspace references, and the resizable file/preview right panel.

items.name: dsh-thumb
items.desc: A phone shell for the web GUI - the sidebar becomes an overlay drawer that closes when a session is tapped, the settings sheet goes full-screen single column, and the transcript is retuned for phone reading.

items.name: dsh-soul
items.desc: Personalization for the agent: a Web UI panel (about-you, reply style & tone, traits for headings/lists and emoji, output language, custom instructions) and `/soul` commands, with nickname/occupation/bio/style/traits/language compiled into a system prompt and re-injected into active sessions. Exposes `soulConfig` for other plugins and a `set_persona` tool the agent can call.

items.name: dsh-prompt-optimizer
items.desc: Refine prompts with guided questions and editable previews using Harness AI or native Codex across Web, desktop and TUI, applying drafts only after user confirmation.

items.name: dsh-better-sidebar-n23
items.desc: Full workbench fork of dsh-better-sidebar: explorer, editor, terminal, Git, browser and split panes, plus a VSCode-like shell refactor with a full-width compact header and activity rail; publishes as @all3cn/dsh-better-sidebar-n23 on npm.

items.name: dsh-calendar-plugin
items.desc: Obsidian daily notes, tasks and Day Planner time blocks in the DSH sidebar: a Monday-first month grid with per-day word-count and task dots, a compact timeline for HH:mm time blocks, the selected day's diary excerpt and task list, and write-back of checkbox state, task text and times to the Markdown files; a first-run wizard detects the vault or accepts a path.

items.name: hover-glossary
items.desc: Shows local glossary definitions when hovering over terms in chat messages.

items.name: dsh-piano-nav
items.desc: Conversation navigation with full-history turns, collapsible process steps, final-result and structured question-and-answer keys, and pointer-following piano interaction.

items.name: dsh-settings-hub
items.desc: Unify third-party plugin settings in DeepSeek Harness. Auto-discover, group, and reorder plugin settings under one collapsible nav entry with drag-and-drop support.

items.name: dsh-desktop-tweaks
items.desc: Desktop tweaks: F11 fullscreen toggle; enables Ctrl+C / Ctrl+V copy and paste in the terminal, both switchable in the General settings.

items.name: dsh-turn-outline
items.desc: Adds a sidebar tab that folds a session into user turns (input, tool steps, output) with one-click jump back into the conversation.

items.name: dsh-plugin-video-player
items.desc: TikTok-style video feed in a floating sidebar window: swipe local or SMB-NAS folders, or paste online video URLs (yt-dlp, bilibili/YouTube, cookies.txt login state); the window auto-fits the video aspect ratio, with fullscreen, drag-resize, Range streaming and an agent video-queue endpoint.

items.name: dsh-live2d-pet
items.desc: Live2D companion for DSH: a floating Cubism model with state-driven expressions and mouse tracking; config-driven geometry (size/position from the plugin config); official Haru sample bundled (© Live2D Inc.).

items.name: dsh-simplify
items.desc: Clean-mode for the Web GUI: hover any element and right-click to remove it; removals survive reloads and are restorable from the settings page.

items.name: dsh-shell-card-plus
items.desc: Replaces the stock bash/pwsh terminal rows in the DSH web UI with shell command cards: long commands soft-wrap with line numbers instead of truncating, plus separate copy-command and copy-output buttons.

items.name: dsh-next-step-suggest
items.desc: Next-step suggestions for the DSH composer: after each completed turn, one auxiliary call on the session's current model returns 3 clickable follow-up suggestions above the input box, and clicking one fills the draft.

items.name: dragview
items.desc: Drag-and-drop file attachments as Codex-style cards, with in-app PDF/text/video/audio previews and system-default opening for other formats.

items.name: dsh-accountdisplayname-edit
items.desc: Replaces the sidebar account label (the phone number, email, or account name) and avatar with your own text and image, chosen in one dialog opened from a new row in the account menu, so screenshots do not expose the original.

items.name: dsh-wallpaperandcost
items.desc: Merged plugin: wallpaper customization (original-resolution uploads, crop editor, per-area opacity, MP4/WebM dynamic wallpapers) + Steam Workshop wallpaper extraction (parses scene.pkg/.tex via a bundled Python script, preview/download) + DeepSeek balance & usage widget + OpenCode Go plan usage (rolling/weekly/monthly percents in a top header pill; expand for progress bars & reset countdowns). API keys are read from DSH's credential store by the host — never stored in source or the browser.

items.name: dsh-mcp-manager-plus
items.desc: MCP management page in DSH Settings: list, enable/disable, restart and delete MCP servers, edit them in form or JSON mode, expand a server to see the tools it registers, and paste-import MCP configs from 14 tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, VS Code and more) in one go.

items.name: dsh-client-ui-font-scale
items.desc: Conversation font-size controls for the Web UI: a stepper in the composer row, keyboard shortcuts, and Ctrl+wheel zoom, all writing through the theme service setFontSize.

items.name: dsh-client-ui-gpt-helper
items.desc: ChatGPT-desktop-style model picker whose thinking-level slider carries a particle trail, plus a visual-only fast-mode toggle and a hold-to-lock for it.

items.name: dsh-model-selector-search
items.desc: Session model selector with search: two-stage loose matching (normalised substring first, subsequence as fallback, so glm53 finds GLM-5.3 and ds finds DeepSeek), providers with recent successful calls pinned first, and a reasoning-effort pane that remembers each model's last explicitly chosen effort.

items.name: dsh-teaching-board
items.desc: Teaching board view: agent-generated self-contained HTML is projected into a sandboxed iframe as a board, annotated by hand (brush, four colours, eraser, undo), extended in place across several tool calls, and screenshotted back into the conversation as a real user message.

items.name: dsh-source-deck
items.desc: In-conversation source deck for DSH Desktop: the current chat model runs LLM search rounds, candidates render as GitHub-aware cards, and keep/exclude feedback, favorites, and the selected sources stay in the same conversation.

items.name: dsh-work-progress
items.desc: Persistent work-progress row in the band below the composer: task completion, a progress bar, and what the agent is doing right now (generating a reply or running a tool), expandable into the full task list with turns, steps, timings and context usage.

items.name: dsh-whale-tools
items.desc: Replace the dsh-whale-widget mascot with your own image through a built-in cutout pipeline, plus a session-header restart button, a browser heartbeat, and an opt-in patch self-heal that is off by default.

items.name: dsh-better-workspace-file-manager
items.desc: Adds upload, download, new folder, delete, drag-to-move, drag-to-chat and in-place text editing with auto-save to the workspace Files tab and file previews.

items.name: dsh-smart-prompt
items.desc: One-click prompt refinement for the DSH composer: the ✦ button next to Send rewrites the draft into an agent-ready prompt in Standard or Light mode, with Revert and Retry; asks follow-up questions through the question card when the draft is missing information; checks that paths, identifiers, numbers, URLs, inline code and @mentions survive the rewrite and adds back any that were dropped; runs on the conversation model or a dedicated model chosen on the Plugins page.

items.name: dsh-term-glossary
items.desc: Select a term in a DeepSeek Harness conversation and press the Search button beside it to read the explanation in place: basic meaning, purpose and usage, with the token cost of that answer. The call is auxiliary — it writes nothing to the session log.

items.name: dsh-quick-open
items.desc: Quick-open palette for the Web GUI: Ctrl+P fuzzy-searches an in-memory index of the session workspace (about 51k entries, median query 5 ms) with per-segment path anchoring, dir: and file: prefixes, Tab directory drilling and :line jumps, opens the picked file in the native right sidebar, and drops a file reference into the conversation draft with Ctrl+Enter. Also adds in-file find (Ctrl+F) and a selection-to-reference action to the built-in file preview.

items.name: dsh-bot-codex-ui
items.desc: Unified install for DS Bot and the Codex-style sidebar: one package that mounts both and fixes their layout conflicts (composer alignment, sidebar footer, account entry, conversation width).

items.name: dsh-plugin_awl
items.desc: Wallpaper-aware readability repair for the DSH Web GUI: it lifts the three low-contrast secondary text tokens with color-mix plus an adjustable text halo, adds content rules (bold, permanently underlined or recoloured links, tinted headings and body text) scoped to conversation Markdown only, offers adjustable rainbow-edge and gradient-fill heading effects, loads custom fonts from the plugin folder or the DSH home, and ships a draggable WYSIWYG preview with a WCAG contrast badge.

items.name: dsh-deep-diving-back
items.desc: Restores the blue shimmering Deep diving turn status row that DSH 0.1.6 and earlier showed at the end of the transcript.

items.name: dsh-reduce-effects
items.desc: Adds a UI effects page to Settings that switches off DSH Web animations and transitions, loading and progress animations, backdrop blur, smooth scrolling, hover title scroll, shadows, gradients and JS motion one category at a time, to cut browser rendering cost.

items.name: dsh-quorfloat
items.desc: System-level desktop floating-window plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH): a global hotkey opens a floating window; the plugin supports workspace and session switching, approval and follow-up handling, and export of its own diagnostic logs for plugin troubleshooting.

items.name: dsh-account-balance-pill
items.desc: Shows the signed-in DeepSeek account's remaining balance in the DSH composer bottom bar, next to the shipped turn/step and token-usage pills, and refreshes it periodically and after each turn.

items.name: dsh-vscode-scrollbar
items.desc: Gives the DSH conversation the Visual Studio Code editor chrome: a 14px always-visible scrollbar with a flat, translucent thumb, plus a VS Code-style minimap in the right margin (half-window column, media not painted, hover-only minimapSlider, click/wheel scrolling) and auto-expanded older pages.

items.name: dsh-chinese-mode-modern
items.desc: Adds a Chinese-mode toggle beside the composer that opens a panel for switching reply, reasoning, and tool-narration language, persisted in the profile.

items.name: dsh-paperflight#plugin
items.desc: PaperFlight is an experimental future-retro DSH Web workbench with session management, file previews, approvals, and optional preset-scoped browser and terminal tools.

items.name: dsh-plugin-busy-workspace
items.desc: Ranks workspaces holding a session that wants attention to the top of the sidebar session list - waiting on you first, then running, then finished-but-unopened, then just read - and draws those rows with a state bar, tinted surface and coloured title, plus a one-shot settle pulse when a run stops. Every colour is taken from the active theme's own tokens, and the three windows that decide how long a finished session stays promoted are settings.

items.name: dsh-composer-history
items.desc: Command history for the DSH composer: press Up/Down to cycle through previously sent instructions, then restore the draft at the end of the history; works in the official desktop app and web-profile builds.

items.name: dsh-greaterclarity-plugin
items.desc: Enhances the DSH web session view — one-click collapse of reasoning and tool chains, numbered history quick-jump, Markdown export, AI avatars.

items.name: dsdragpasteall
items.desc: Drag or paste any local file onto the DSH page; it resolves the real absolute path (Spotlight + size/mtime + head/tail fingerprint match) and inserts it into the composer, with a content-cache fallback.

items.name: dsh-client-ui-quote
items.desc: Select text in a DSH conversation, a file preview or the terminal to quote it: the floating bar offers Comment, Add to chat and Side chat, and Alt+Q / Alt+C / Alt+B do the same three things. The quote - and its comment, kept in the same chip - is inserted as a native reference chip, and a sent quote stays one rounded capsule in the message that expands on click and can be copied. A hover card can jump back to the message a quote came from, and the right sidebar carries a quote list page that searches every quote of the session, jumps back to any of them and exports them as Markdown. Side chat writes the quote into the composer of one dsh-better-sidebar side thread per conversation without sending it, and that page can bring the thread conclusion back into the main composer or export it as a file. A sent quote can also be revised: the card puts its old comment back in the comment box, the corrected quote is sent as a new message, and the old capsule is marked as superseded (the transcript itself is append-only).

items.name: dsh-huaci-pinglun
items.desc: Selection comments and quoted conversations (dsh划词评论 / dsh-huaci-pinglun), based on the MIT-licensed BangBang-03/dsh-client-ui-quote 0.11.1 with attached textarea measurement, border-aware height and long-text scrolling.

items.name: dsh-restart-ui
items.desc: Adds a restart button to the DSH Web UI through a loopback-only endpoint that requests a relaunch using the current process executable, arguments and working directory.

items.name: dsh-keep-awake
items.desc: Holds the OS wake lock while any agent, subagent, or background job runs, releases it after a configurable grace period, and provides a bilingual web settings page with live status, manual hold, and display-on options.

items.name: dsh-session-tree
items.desc: Hierarchical session tree for the sidebar - native subagent trees plus an optional organization-derived hierarchy, with collapsed branch counters and orphan/cycle defense.

items.name: dsh-classic-coding
items.desc: Slides out a Monaco editor plus a lazy-loaded file-tree panel in the DSH Web conversation, so you can edit the local workspace inline without switching to an external editor.

items.name: dsh-edit-diff
items.desc: Client-side re-render of edit/write tool cards with a near-linear line-level diff that drops duplicate unchanged lines and underlines the actual changed characters inside replaced lines.

items.name: dsh-mobile-drawer
items.desc: Below 1024px the sidebar collapses to a 44px floating square and expands into a 280px overlay drawer; picking a session collapses it again and the focus grab that would raise the soft keyboard after a session switch is suppressed.

items.name: dsh-tool-autoexpand
items.desc: Auto-expands newly arrived tool-call cards in the DSH Web UI, with a sidebar toggle cycling no-op/expand/collapse and the state persisted to localStorage.

items.name: dsh-plugin-scaling
items.desc: Independent per-pane zoom for the DSH web shell: Ctrl+wheel over a pane, Ctrl+± / Ctrl+0 for the focused pane. Works with the official look and every skin.

items.name: dsh-favicon-status
items.desc: Browser tab status indicator for dsh web: paints the document favicon from the session list (blue spinning while work runs, amber while waiting on the user, green when finished).

items.name: dsh-session-menu
items.desc: Adds mark-unread, copy session info, reveal in Finder or open with your IDE, and permanent delete (with child sessions) to the DSH sidebar session menu, plus error and unread status dots, hover-card details, one-click delete for archived rows, and a settings panel that switches each menu item on or off; the interface is available in English and Chinese.

items.name: dsh-quote-to-composer
items.desc: Select text anywhere in DeepSeek Harness, click the quote pill next to the pointer, and the selection lands in the composer as a small quote chip; hover the chip to read the full quote.

items.name: dsh-conversation-anchors
items.desc: Codex-style left-gutter tick rail for each user turn, with hover preview and click-to-scroll.

items.name: dsh-model-selector
items.desc: Enhanced model selector for the DSH composer with searchable provider groups, keyboard and accessibility support, and an inline reasoning-effort slider.

items.name: dsh-pet-sprite
items.desc: A pixel companion living in the chat area: hatches from an egg into one of three sprites or an LLM-drawn custom one from a text description, platform-jumps over message bubbles on its own, WASD controllable, chats in character through the models you already configured, and carries a nurture system (mood/power/health, levels, shop) driven by real token usage.

items.name: codsh#codsh-bundle
items.desc: Terminal coding agent for DeepSeek Harness with a full-screen alternate-screen UI, turn-aware session navigation, and a gated /ship workflow that takes one-line requirements through specification, TDD, and rerun acceptance checks.

items.name: dsh-skill-zh-overlay
items.desc: Chinese summaries for the dsh-skill-mcp-panel skill cards: each expanded card gets a short Chinese overview, a category tag and a few bullet points, while the English description the panel already renders is folded behind a "原文" toggle. Skills missing from the bundled map are translated on demand by the host with your current default model and cached on disk, keyed by a hash of the original text, so a new skill needs no manual entry. Skills whose own description is already Chinese are skipped.

items.name: dsh-peakvalley
items.desc: Composer-dock badge showing DeepSeek peak/off-peak pricing on a Beijing-time calendar whose China holiday schedule is fetched online at runtime (off-peak costs half the peak rate); auto-hides for non-DeepSeek models and cycles seven readouts on click.

items.name: dsh-always-status-bar
items.desc: Keeps the native per-message status line always visible without hovering — date and time on every message, run duration, TTFT, and tokens per second on assistant messages.

items.name: dsh-think-expand
items.desc: Auto-expands every Think row after switching sessions, with a header switch to turn it on or off.

items.name: dsh-pending-review-glow
items.desc: Highlights sidebar session rows by state (pending approval, running, just finished) with color, animation and a matching status dot.

items.name: dsh-oh-my-terminal
items.desc: Bottom terminal panel for the DSH Web GUI, providing multi-tab interactive terminals powered by node-pty (Windows ConPTY / POSIX openpty) with split panes, a side terminal list, and a dropdown new/split menu. Also compatible with DSH-better-sidebar — auto-detected at runtime, it switches to a bottom workbench tab so PTY sessions do not bind the DSH session write handle.

items.name: dsh-code-collector
items.desc: Session code collector for DeepSeek Harness: a composer-side panel gathering every code block the model produced in the current session, with by-language / by-file views, per-file version history, live search, per-entry copy, copy-all, download-all as Markdown, and click-to-jump back to the exact turn (Alt+Shift+C).

items.name: dsh-conversation-timeline
items.desc: Conversation timeline dock bar for DeepSeek Harness: a turn-level timeline above the composer with user-prompt hover tooltips and click-to-jump back to the exact chat position.

items.name: dsh-agent-group-panel
items.desc: Feishu multi-agent robot console: start, stop and reconnect the daemon, view status and recent activity, and jump to the task workspace.

items.name: dsh-my-music
items.desc: Full-page NetEase Cloud Music player for DSH: daily recommendations, playlist browsing by category, charts, new releases, search, playlist/album/artist pages, QR-code login, synced lyrics, queue and downloads, plus four agent tools for search, song URLs, lyrics and playlist tracks.

items.name: dsh-mobile-ui
items.desc: Adds touch-friendly navigation, layout refinements, and standalone PWA styling to the existing DeepSeek Harness web interface.

items.name: dsh-file-and-terminal
items.desc: Adds host file management and an interactive Bash terminal to the DSH WebUI.

items.name: dsh-app
items.desc: Windows Electron companion sharing the DSH Web profile, conversations and plugins, with startup logs, update recovery and diagnostics.

items.name: dsh-fold-context
items.desc: Auto-fold context/system messages in DSH conversation — collapse think blocks, tool calls, and tool results into grouped expandable bars.

items.name: dsh-activity-pane
items.desc: Activity overview pane for the DSH web UI: running, awaiting-response and recent sessions with child agents, progress, model and reasoning level in one sidebar pane.

items.name: dsh-prompt-shortcuts
items.desc: Pinned prompt shortcuts in a single row above the composer — one click replaces the draft with the saved text — plus a searchable panel for pinning, editing and deleting prompts, overflow collapsed into a "More" menu, storage in a Host-side JSON file, and a prompt_shortcuts agent tool that reads and writes the same file.

items.name: dsh-topic-trail
items.desc: Turns each long dsh conversation into a three-level trail (topic to progress steps to milestone timeline) and shows it in a draggable overlay, where one click jumps back to the matching message in the transcript. Topics are distilled by the DeepSeek model with a zero-cost rule-based fallback, can be renamed, locked, merged by drag and drop, and support per-conversation notes plus a vector drawing board.

items.name: dsh-page-zoom
items.desc: Page zoom for the DSH Web UI: Ctrl+mouse wheel scales the entire interface in 5% steps (30%-200%), remembers the zoom level locally, and shows a magnifier with the percentage in the bottom-right corner.

items.name: dsh-turn-fold
items.desc: Codex-style turn folding for the DSH Web UI: keeps final answers visible, groups consecutive reasoning and tool activity, and shows configurable live duration, tool-call, and token metrics with multilingual summaries.

items.name: dsh-beginner-hub
items.desc: Beginner panel for DeepSeek Harness: routes a plain-language request into ready-to-use plans (prompt variants, matching skills, advanced moves) with a local keyword engine and fills the chosen plan into a new session in one click.

items.name: dsh-workspace-activity
items.desc: Shows a spinner on a sidebar workspace row while any of its sessions are running, and a short-lived finished mark after they stop.

items.name: dsh-sticky-notes
items.desc: Draggable sticky notes with 9 skins, image notes, and agent-readable to-do lists for DeepSeek Harness.

items.name: dsh-better-composer
items.desc: Markdown visual enhancement and session workbench for DSH Web Composer: live syntax presentation with caret-row source reveal (inactive-line markers can be hidden or faded), deterministic local completions, and list/quote continuation on line break with ordered-list renumbering; long pastes fold into persistent chips with inline context or file-mode delivery (@path across 50+ extensions) plus sidebar LLM rewrites (stop, preview diff, undo/redo); real-time context map with token gauge, composition breakdown, per-turn growth chart with anchor lines, in-place /compact, turn forking, and a Context Doctor workspace (overview, diagnostics, analysis, feedback).

items.name: dsh-muv-engine
items.desc: MUV engine for DeepSeek Harness: runs the regex_scripts from a character card against model output, tracks variables, renders a status bar, expands macros and LaTeX, and styles tagged code blocks such as letter, terminal, newspaper and phone. Needs dsh-muv-table installed as well, which is its companion plugin.

items.name: dsh-muv-table
items.desc: MUV variable table editor for DeepSeek Harness: a tree view of the variables being tracked, a macro test panel for random, pick and roll, a dice shortcut bar and pick-cache management. Companion plugin for dsh-muv-engine.

items.name: dsh-task-progress
items.desc: Live progress for long-running DSH tasks: a script appends JSON lines to a per-session progress file, the Web UI draws them in a floating overlay and a right-sidebar tab that also lists background jobs which reported nothing, and `dsh-progress run -- <cmd>` wraps a command that cannot report for itself.

items.name: dsh-perf-hud
items.desc: A transparent, draggable performance HUD for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI: CPU, GPU and memory usage in three compact rows that float directly over the interface without any card background, snapping to the nearest window corner so resizing or maximising keeps them in place; CPU package temperature comes from an optional elevated helper (LibreHardwareMonitor + PawnIO) and the plugin itself stays at a fraction of a percent of CPU. Windows only.

items.name: dsh-composer-markdown
items.desc: Markdown editing aids for the DSH web composer: ordered and unordered list continuation with continuous renumbering, Tab-nested list levels, inline-code styling, and code-fence auto-closing, with the sent draft kept as literal Markdown.

items.name: dsh-client-ui-skin-alice-greyrat
items.desc: A pale rose-and-gold Mushoku Tensei skin for the DSH web GUI: an arcane sigil and two full-body Eris figures behind the conversation, a young Eris standee and gilt plugin glyphs in the sidebar, and its own settings card.

items.name: llm-capture
items.desc: Web UI for capturing and reviewing raw LLM requests, streamed responses, token usage and tool calls.

items.name: thoughtdag#dsh
items.desc: Adds an editable conversation canvas to DeepSeek Harness, where graph connections select context for canvas requests, with branching, merging, and local agent session imports.

items.name: dsh-ui-ux-pro-max
items.desc: Offline-first UI/UX design intelligence library for DeepSeek Harness: design_recommend, design_review and design_search tools with a built-in database of 84 design styles, 192 color palettes, 74 font pairings, 99 UX guidelines, 25 chart types and 22 tech stacks, Chinese-first with zero runtime dependencies.

items.name: dsh-add-to-chat
items.desc: Adds lightweight selected-text references to DSH assistant replies: selections stay outside the editor as removable draft contexts, remain marked beside the source, and render as hoverable annotations after submission.

items.name: dsh-product-preview
items.desc: Browse local image, video, and SVGA artifacts from conversation nodes in a Finder-style column view.

items.name: dsh-footer-order
items.desc: DSH sidebar footer ordering: forces the sidebar.footer.action slot into a vertical stack and lets users configure the top-to-bottom order of its entries.

items.name: dsh-message-outline
items.desc: Current-session message outline rail for the DSH web UI — your messages show as slim bars on the left edge; hover to expand the full outline (line number + text), click to jump instantly to that message. Pure frontend, zero external service dependencies, sessions-snapshot driven with zero polling.

items.name: dsh-file-finder
items.desc: File search palette for the DSH workspace: find files by name or content, open results in DSH's native right-sidebar preview, and edit text files inline with version-conflict checks.

items.name: dsh-paste-code-block
items.desc: Cherry Studio-style paste: multi-line/indented/fenced text or code pasted into the DSH Web composer collapses into a bordered, collapsible, language-tagged card and is restored as a fenced code block on send.

items.name: dsh-plugins#dsh-sidebar-tidy
items.desc: Sidebar layout fix for the DSH Web UI: caps and scrolls the plugin-action area, shrinks the inline pairing QR code and tightens the brand row, so the workspace and session list stays clickable when footer plugins grow tall.

items.name: dsh-live2d-avatar
items.desc: Live2D avatar stage and desktop companion for DSH: bundled Haru sample, custom Cubism 2/3+ model loading with scale and position controls, a draggable in-page pet, an optional transparent always-on-top desktop pet window, per-conversation expression prompt control, and opt-in voice with self-hosted ASR/TTS.

items.name: dsh-quick-input
items.desc: A 3×3 pad of saved phrases sitting to the left of the composer and tracking the input box's height: clicking a cell inserts its text at the caret as one undoable edit. Presets are editable in place, 9 cells per page up to 12 pages, and the UI follows the DSH language setting. Falls back to a panel above the composer when the window leaves no room.

items.name: dsh-cad-viewer
items.desc: Adds a 3D model library in its own conversation tab, where agents store models built from CadQuery scripts or supplied as tessellated meshes; the library previews them with three-cad-viewer, organises them into folders and exports them to 10 formats including STEP, BREP, STL and DXF.

items.name: dsh-generative-ui
items.desc: Lets the AI insert streaming-generated UI into the conversation or a side panel, written in TSX — already one of the model's native languages, so there is no JSON schema to teach it. Rendered without flicker, state kept across frames with no hard remount, and a click in the card driving the next chat turn. Inline is where streaming matters most; the side Canvas is the more agentic shape. Cards get agentic capabilities of their own — run bash, curl, call the model, read and write files.

items.name: dsh-zh-more
items.desc: Chinese-first UI enhancement: translates slash-command names and plugin-inventory cards with three display modes (Chinese only / Chinese + English / off), switching instantly without losing English.

items.name: dsh-tweaks#git-bash-terminal-tool
items.desc: Replaces the terminal tool on Windows with Git Bash.

items.name: dsh-tweaks#prompt-history
items.desc: Recalls prompts sent earlier in the current session with the up and down keys in an empty composer, and shows a position badge while browsing.

items.name: dsh-tweaks#smart-list
items.desc: Continues numbered and bulleted lists in the DSH composer, so Shift+Enter after "1. item" starts a new line with the next marker.

items.name: copree#dsh-copree
items.desc: Embeds Copree (formerly AIsChat) into the DSH web UI as a native sidebar board. Copree is an open-source framework for AI group chat and programmable worlds: the AIs are residents, not tools — each has its own memory, state and personality, they talk to each other on their own, and you can watch or join in. Group World goes further: every group chat can bind a living world (its own web page + world AI + code + clock) that the world AI builds and edits through DSH workspace tools. This plugin ships the native sidebar board (contacts, pinned DMs and groups), real-time chat over a same-origin HTTP/WS proxy, Markdown/LaTeX rendering, group invites and image messages, immersive full-frame pages, and one-click mirroring of your worlds into DSH workspaces (folder + DSH session + world_* tools). Front end only: it proxies to a Copree backend you run yourself (default 127.0.0.1:5228, same repository).

items.name: dsh-better-display
items.desc: Renders assistant replies with numbered citation chips and a sources panel for web-search results, inline pictures with their source captions, and KaTeX formulas, Mermaid diagrams and highlighted code in streaming Markdown.

items.name: dsh-prompt-enhancer
items.desc: Adds a ✨ button and an /enhance command to the composer that rewrite the draft into a structured prompt, flag open questions below the input, follow the current session model, and offer an undo.

items.name: dsh-drop
items.desc: Drag or paste files into the Web composer with one image-and-file preview rail; native PNG/JPEG/WebP/GIF keep the image attachment path, while other files reuse a matching local path or stream to Host staging and become @ references only at send time. Includes browser media/PDF and bounded text previews; Office and archives show identity cards, and unsent file entries are page-local.

items.name: dsh-viewer
items.desc: Model-facing display_file tool that renders 36 file extensions inline in the web UI: images with a click-to-zoom lightbox, seekable video, audio, PDF, Office and OpenDocument files converted to PDF on the host via LibreOffice, and local HTML in a sandboxed frame; bytes stream from a signed HTTP route with range support, and PNG/JPEG/WebP/GIF also enter model context on image-capable routes.

items.name: dsh-terse-mode
items.desc: Four adjustable terse levels plus independent switches for reasoning effort, web search and subagents, on the conversation header and in the Settings page. No output ceiling.

items.name: dsh-indexbookmark
items.desc: Conversation question index for the DSH Web UI: every question you asked in a session, searchable, paginated, with one-click jump to the exact message.

items.name: dsh-float-chat
items.desc: Pops the DSH side chat into a frameless, always-on-top Windows desktop window that can sit over any other application, with its own settings page for appearance, pinning, remembered geometry, opacity, ephemeral threads and cache cleanup.

items.name: dsh-ssh-tui
items.desc: Terminal UI for DeepSeek Harness on jump hosts and high-latency links: plain ANSI, incremental repaint, and a session that survives a dropped SSH connection (resume it from the log).

items.name: dsh-johari-cognition-quadrant-dialog-composer
items.desc: Johari cognition-quadrant dialog prompt composer — adds a button above the composer that opens a 2×2 quadrant panel (known/unknown × AI-known/AI-unknown) to groom conversation context into a structured prompt written back into the draft.

items.name: dsh-flow
items.desc: Small DeepSeek Harness affordances for everyday actions — locate the current session from the sidebar header (Cmd/Ctrl+Shift+D), copy a session ID from the session row menu (Cmd/Ctrl+Shift+C), open links in the system default program including localhost, open or copy inline code from a context menu, open changed-file cards with a local IDE or reveal them in the file manager, swap Enter with Cmd/Ctrl+Enter, recall sent messages with Up/Down, and show the current workspace name inside the header open button; every one of them has its own switch in a Flow settings page.

items.name: dsh-hide-empty-workspace
items.desc: Auto-hide a sidebar workspace the moment its last unarchived session is archived, and add a "隐藏工作区" entry to each workspace row's own "..." menu. The restore entry sits at the bottom of the sidebar. It only toggles display and never archives, deletes or rewrites a workspace.

items.name: dsh-scratchpad-plus
items.desc: Workspace-free chats that promote real files into their own project workspace - a maintained fork of dsh-scratchpad, kept working on current DSH.

items.name: dsh-search-enhance
items.desc: Search inside the New-Session workspace picker: pinyin initials and full pinyin spelling for Chinese titles, substring matching anywhere for English titles, and separator-insensitive matching.

items.name: dsh-agent-teams-dashboard
items.desc: Adds a Teams sidebar dashboard that lists every Agent Teams chat with its roster and task roadmap, token spend in USD and RUB, work and online time, and an archive of older teams. Requires the Agent Teams plugin.

items.name: dsh-morning-paper
items.desc: A newspaper-style front page for a session you left running, as a Conversation View tab beside Chat and Trajectory: a per-turn timeline (duration, steps, tools, tokens, outcome), file churn counted per file, where the wall clock went and how much of it was the model rather than tools, which single turn ate the spend, failures nobody retried quoted with their failing command, and a context-pressure gauge measured against the routed model's own declared capacity. The briefing is folded from the durable session log and never generated by a model, so it costs no tokens, cannot hallucinate, and is byte-identical for the same log and clock; it appends nothing to the session and reaches no model, and it reports a pending approval without ever answering it. Pages are offered only when they have content, and the tab refreshes itself on turn settle and on a two-speed poll backed by a metadata-only tail probe.

items.name: dsh-queue-reorder
items.desc: Reorder the messages queued while a DSH agent is busy, from inside the official queue dock: a drag handle and per-row ↑ / ↓ buttons on the dock's own rows, applied on the host as one concurrency-checked inbox splice. The dock is decorated rather than replaced, so previews, inline editing, steering, removal and attachments stay as shipped. A move is refused when the queue has changed since the caller last saw it, when the row is not a user prompt (a goal round prompt, for example), or when the queue belongs to a subagent session.

items.name: dsh-plugin-zh-cn
items.desc: Renders installed DSH plugin titles and descriptions in Simplified Chinese: at startup it translates the plugins the local JSON cache lacks through the harness LLM service, then projects { en, zh } metadata for resolveText() to render — no DOM changes, no third-party API.

items.name: dsh-webask
items.desc: Adds a button beside the composer and a global hotkey palette (default mod+shift+k) that hand one-off questions to a web chat instead of into the harness context: the draft is lifted out of the composer, copied to the clipboard and opened in the templated URL. Ships target-site presets (DeepSeek, Kimi, Qwen, 豆包, 腾讯元宝, GLM, Gemini), a local question history that can be re-opened, copied, or inserted back into the composer, and a settings tab for site, URL template, hotkey, clipboard and history.

items.name: dsh-page-refresh#dsh-page-refresh
items.desc: Adds a refresh button to the conversation header in DeepSeek Harness, reloading the current page in one click without losing the conversation. Desktop-first, client-only, zero tokens.

items.name: dsh-enhance-tool
items.desc: All-in-one UI enhancement layer for DeepSeek Harness web: prompt library with quick-insert and management, two-step AI polish, predicted-reply dock with click-to-send, MCP tool management, scheduled automation, smart session titles, adjustable chat width, full-width AI messages without gray background, auto-collapse for long user messages with smooth expand/collapse animations, and scene-specific entrance animations across all plugin surfaces.

items.name: dsh-lived-pet#dsh-pet-bridge
items.desc: Writes the harness agent live state (thinking, working, waiting, done, error) to a state file that a bundled Electron Live2D desktop pet polls, so the pet bubble and face follow what the agent is doing.

items.name: dsh-obsidian
items.desc: Your real Obsidian vault in the DSH right Sidebar: the vault tree, full-vault search, notes rendered with read-view typography, wikilink navigation, in-place editing, and a clickable outline.

items.name: dsh-screenshot-plugin
items.desc: WeChat-style in-app screenshot button: drag a region, fine-tune with 8 resize handles, Enter to capture and Esc to cancel; auto-numbered PNGs plus a \[Shot N HH:mm] marker written into the composer. Windows-only, tested on DeepSeek Harness Desktop.

items.name: dsh-jumpbar
items.desc: User message jump bar for the DSH web GUI: a minimap-style dash strip on the right edge of the conversation, with hover preview, click-to-jump, drag-to-scrub and a viewport marker.

items.name: dsh-quotalk
items.desc: Select response text or code to ask contextual follow-ups with streaming replies in a native sidebar.

items.name: dsh-plugins#dsh-weather
items.desc: Draggable weather bar in the shell overlay with forecast and geocoding from Open-Meteo; the position persists across sessions.

items.name: dsh-selection-translator
items.desc: Adds a right-click menu to selected text in the Harness Web UI that replaces it with a Simplified Chinese translation in place, and restores the original on a second right-click.

items.name: dsh-status-turbo
items.desc: A status bar in the composer footer showing the current phase, how long it has been running, the current step token count and a no-progress warning, projected from session logs without polling the host, plus a detail panel that opens on click.

items.name: dsh-better-input
items.desc: Input experience enhancement: voice input, AI polish, anti-overwrite, prompt optimization with diff preview, and auto locale switching following DSH UI language.

items.name: dsh-market-sidebar
items.desc: Adds the dshmarket plugin market to the DSH sidebar as a panel of its own, ordered above the built-in Plugins entry. Clicking the entry renders the market through the client service dshmarket publishes for hosts, so the catalog, category filters, comments and install and update flows are the ones dshmarket ships rather than a copy of them. Nothing to learn or configure: the panel is the market, with its own sidebar entry, label in Chinese or English to match the interface language, and icon. If dshmarket is not loaded the panel says so instead of failing client composition, and its locale keys, slots and style tag are released when the plugin unloads.

items.name: dsh-signal-pet
items.desc: A small pet in the corner of the interface that reads the real event stream instead of guessing: it drifts when idle, speeds up while the agent is thinking, draws a flowing line per running tool call, turns red and shakes with the error summary on a failure, and celebrates a turn that ran longer than ten seconds. The same widget is the at-a-glance busy and error indicator, so there is no spinner to stare at. The host half folds real harness events into a snapshot and the client half only draws it; it performs no content recognition, and it positions itself away from the composer so it never sits over what you are typing.

items.name: dsh-plugin-width-slider
items.desc: All-in-one UI plugin for DSH Desktop (Windows): conversation-width slider with fullscreen preview and follow-window mode, thinking-block enhancements (forced Chinese, expand/collapse, Markdown rendering), an Open With header button, UI label localization, a resizable settings dialog, session delete, and workspace tabs.

items.name: dsh-macos-pet
items.desc: macOS desk pet forked from anneheartrecord/dsh-desk-pet, in a real always-on-top window that covers fullscreen Spaces: the pose follows whatever the local DSH is doing across six states, the right-click menu is a real AppKit one carrying quiet mode and a session list, and seven skins ship with it. Two of the seven are drawn from geometry by a script in the repo rather than generated, so making a skin needs no image model and no API credits; the bundled skill still expands one photo into all eighteen poses on your own image tool and credentials. There is no Electron and nothing to install alongside it: the window is driven through ctypes on the Python that ships with macOS.

items.name: dsh-ui-skin-switcher
items.desc: Replaces the model button with a Claude Desktop-style model and reasoning-effort switcher, with per-model effort memory, theme-aware styling, smooth slider feel, rounded track, hover highlight, and pixel-dot animation.

items.name: oledcare
items.desc: OLED burn-in care for the Web GUI with pure-black surfaces, gamma-aware text dimming on an idle/focus ladder, a true-black nap screensaver with live agent status, and slow accent-hue rotation.

items.name: dsh-sidebar-restart
items.desc: Adds a Restart row to the desktop app's sidebar foot beside Settings that restarts the app and reloads the page onto the newly installed plugin bundle.

items.name: dsh-open-project
items.desc: Adds a Windows Explorer folder context-menu entry that registers the folder as a DSH project, with a switch for the menu entry in Settings → General. Windows only, and nothing extra has to be installed.

items.name: dsh-friendly-steps
items.desc: Folds Think and tool-call rows into a floating summary pill with red failure counts, for a cleaner writer-friendly chat view.

items.name: dsh-aoci-panel
items.desc: AOCI cognition panel for DSH: multi-workspace AOCI overview, per-repo index and governance view, MCP binding diagnosis, and guided or batch initialization. Governance, verification and guided/batch initialization require the external aoci CLI on the host; index browsing works without it.

items.name: dsh-primitive-pulse
items.desc: A floating panel that lights up which HowNet semantic primitives the current answer touches, as a brain-shaped node graph, EEG-style channel traces and a composition card.

items.name: dsh-file-menu
items.desc: Right-click menus for the DSH Web UI — copy, cut, paste and select all on text and input areas, plus copy path, reveal in the file manager and open with the default app on file references and links.

items.name: dsh-plugin-zoom
items.desc: Manually zoom the Harness Web UI from 75% to 200% via a Settings row, Ctrl+wheel, or a Session-header control, keeping text crisp and readable on high-DPI displays.

items.name: dsh-arrowkey-nav
items.desc: Arrow-key navigation for the DSH Web GUI: Up/Down switch sessions inside the current workspace and Left/Right switch workspaces, reading session identity from the client controllers rather than the DOM, and yielding the keys back to the composer while a draft is being edited.

items.name: dsh-brief-sidebar
items.desc: A dsh-better-sidebar tab that renders a session brief — a todo board read from the `todos` projection plus a deliverables section listing the files written this turn — and hides the official todo panel above the composer while it is mounted.

items.name: dsh-canvas-tsx-sidebar
items.desc: A dsh-better-sidebar tab that statically parses Qoder Canvas `*.canvas.tsx` files into structured pages in the DSH right sidebar (the source is never executed: no eval, no bundler, no sandbox iframe), with a file-viewer takeover for `.tsx` and a bundled Skill for authoring the format.

items.name: dsh-paste-dock
items.desc: Turns large text pastes into pastes/*.txt attachments with a dock above the composer and a minimal, recognisable badge in the draft.

items.name: dsh-tidy-display
items.desc: Honest merge of two community plugins into one calmer display: the streaming reading view from dsh-better-display (fork) and the message rail from dsh-tidychat. For theme lovers it wraps reasoning prose and tool-call output in translucent message bubbles, so text no longer sits directly on busy wallpapers or skins where it is hard to read. Cross-version rc adaptation attempted across DSH 0.1.0-0.2.0 (all rc); no obvious problems so far.

items.name: blue#blue
items.desc: Plugin-tree terminal UI for DeepSeek Harness — streaming markdown transcript, tool cards, fuzzy slash commands, and live theming, with every component a hot-swappable Cordis plugin.

items.name: dsh-group-status
items.desc: Aggregated status badges on collapsed sidebar groups in DSH: a folded folder row shows in-progress / awaiting-approval / done / scheduled / review-pending counts, with numbers and hover detail. (sidebar badge / group status / aggregate)

items.name: dsh-suggest-ghost
items.desc: Input prediction for the DSH composer: your next prompt suggested as ghost text after each turn, accepted with Tab. (autocomplete / input prediction / prompt suggestion)

items.name: dsh-prompt-optimization
items.desc: Adds a one-click prompt optimization button to the DSH composer, with undo and an optional dedicated optimizer model.

items.name: dsh-session-actions
items.desc: Sidebar conversation actions: open the row menu on right-click, rename by double-click, copy the session id, and delete a conversation together with its storage after a confirmation.

items.name: dsh-restart
items.desc: Adds a Restart page to the DSH Web settings panel. The page shows the PID, port, start time and uptime of the running host and restarts it through a detached helper that waits until the port stops answering before replaying the same launch invocation; the page reloads itself once the replacement host answers with a new boot id.

items.name: dsh-recover-context
items.desc: Roll back to before any of your questions or edit the last one and resubmit, with the workspace files of the discarded turns restored.

items.name: dsh-gacha-calendar
items.desc: Anime game banner and event schedule lookup: sidebar button with current banners, events, and countdowns for 11 gacha games, auto-refresh, and per-game selectable sources.

items.name: grokbot_in_deepseekherness
items.desc: Bring GrokBot into DeepSeek harness.

items.name: dsh-run-button
items.desc: Adds a Run button to shell code blocks in replies, executing the snippet through the host shell service and showing its output in a floating bottom-right dock, or in one bottom-panel tab per run.

items.name: dsh-think-ux
items.desc: Smooth think-row experience for the DSH Web UI: think rows expand as a capped 24-line preview that glides to the bottom while reasoning streams, collapse with a short height animation on settle, and the main conversation view follows with a reader-safe smooth chase (no snaps, no yanks).

items.name: dsh-pet-progress
items.desc: Folds the durable todo and goal events the dsh pet ignores into a percentage bubble on the pet, and falls back to a one-line activity summary for a session that never wrote a todo list. Requires the dsh web pet plugin (@linxin666/dsh-pet >= 0.4.0).

items.name: dsh-plugin-quick-chat
items.desc: Adds a Quick Chat entry to the Web UI sidebar that opens a floating chat window with its own model and reasoning-effort picker, optionally seeded with the current session's transcript, and keeps every side conversation in a resumable, renamable, deletable history.

items.name: dsh-session-colorful-unread-pin-jobs
items.desc: Colors each DSH sidebar session title by state: unread (blue while the model is running, green once it has finished) and pinned (yellow, read from DSH's own pinned set), composed into one left-to-right gradient. Pinning, archiving and ordering stay with DSH itself — the plugin reimplements no pinning and rewrites no official bundle — and a settings section lists every unread session.

items.name: packhub-workbench-assistant
items.desc: Adds quick installation and switching for workbench templates in DSH Desktop.

items.name: mayfly#mayfly
items.desc: Interactive terminal UI for DeepSeek Harness: tables, Mermaid and chart rendering, side conversations, and the same Cordis plugin model as dsh Web.

items.name: dsh-theme
items.desc: Theme skin plugin for DeepSeek Harness — built-in themes / static image / dynamic 360°-follow video, one-click from the sidebar & Settings; imports persist, default skins protected.

items.name: dsh-ui-three-body
