items.desc: Adds a sentient floating eye to DeepSeek Harness — injects a taming kernel that makes the AI truly understand you, with 11 dynamic eye skins, ghost mode, and zero token cost when AI mode is off.

items.name: dsh_session_folders
items.desc: One-level session folders for the web sidebar - group sessions per workspace, move them by drag-and-drop or context menu, archive and restore, server-side persistence.

items.name: dsh-model-navigator
items.desc: Replace the model picker with global search, favorites, recent selections, model-family navigation, and reasoning effort selection.

items.name: dsh-just-chat
items.desc: One-click native conversations with independent workspaces for DeepSeek Harness.

items.name: dsh-cot-en2cn
items.desc: Shows a Chinese translation under each English thinking block in the DSH web chat, without modifying the session transcript; per-chunk caching, a configurable translation model, and a settings panel.

items.name: dsh-model-in-use
items.desc: Marks models in use by other running sessions in the DSH model menu, and restores the remembered reasoning effort and group collapse state for each model.

items.name: dsh-mcp-diff
items.desc: Renders every file mutation in the web chat as one collapsed diff card with per-line highlighting — MCP filesystem edit_file/write_file and the built-in edit/write.

items.name: dsh-tui-pi
items.desc: Full-featured TUI for DeepSeek Harness: streaming conversation, powerline status bar, real-time think/tool/todo panels, subagent dual-view, theme hot-switch — all as pure cordis plugins with zero upstream patches.

items.name: dsh-composer-ux
items.desc: Configurable send and newline keys, a composer context menu with three sources (leave it to DSH and other plugins / browser menu / plugin-styled custom menu), a quick-command panel with categorized prompt lists where each prompt can append on every send or only on the first message of a session, a create-and-move row at the bottom of each category, a prompt optimizer that rewrites the draft with a separate model call, settings-panel size memory, and automatic x-opencode-session header injection for OpenCode routes. Prompt lists live in a global ~/.dsh/quick-prompts.json that is independent of the session and the project.

items.name: dsh-model-picker
items.desc: Model quick picker for DeepSeek Harness: a button left of the model dropdown opens a full model-selection dialog with provider grouping, live search, provider filter, capability tags read from the user's own input config, reasoning badges, recent-model shortcuts and a reasoning-effort picker; the choice writes back to the native dropdown immediately.

items.name: dsh-im-companion
items.desc: IM Companion for dsh-im: groups Feishu/WeChat/QQ bots by Agent in DSH workspaces and enhances DSH native session states (blue/orange/red rail markers for running, needs-review and error), with left badges, one-click filter, fleet overview and drag-to-move. Clean uninstall.

items.name: ilife#dsh-life-pack
items.desc: iLife: one DSH settings card for the iLife home-life suite — memo, calorie, chef, home, schedule and bill in a tab bar — covering every part of your home life.

items.name: dsh-email-board
items.desc: Read-only unread-mail board for the accounts configured in dsh-email — unread messages appear as per-account cards in the DSH right sidebar (sender, subject, time) and refresh on demand.

items.name: dsh-stock-ticker
items.desc: A floating, semi-transparent market ticker for DeepSeek Harness showing real-time level and change percentage for the Shanghai Composite, ChiNext, STAR 50 and Hang Seng Tech indices.

items.name: dsh-plugins#dsh-ask-highlight
items.desc: Highlights answered ask blocks (question n/n answered) in the conversation with a soft card style; pending asks and other tool blocks keep their native look.

items.name: dsh-plugins#dsh-pwa-icon
items.desc: PWA icon: sets the icon (and manifest app name) used when the Web GUI is installed or added to the desktop; ships a default icon set and accepts a custom image.

items.name: dsh-plugins#dsh-vertical-layout
items.desc: Portrait layout for desktop windows: navigation takes the full left column, the file/terminal panel moves above the conversation, and a draggable splitter sets its height; touch devices are unaffected.

items.name: dsh-session-icons
items.desc: Sidebar session-title icons: an auxiliary model call on the same route as title generation draws a 24x24 monochrome SVG metaphor shown before each session row title, with disk caching.

items.name: dsh-editor-link
items.desc: Links DeepSeek Harness to VS Code: approvals answered in native notifications, ask_user_question answered in a sidebar card, an ide_context tool fed by the active file, diagnostics and selection, selection to composer, and a sidebar with the live transcript, workspace-scoped session picker, model and permission controls.

items.name: dsh-prompt-predict
items.desc: Predicts the user's next prompt after each assistant reply and shows it as gray ghost text inside the composer; accept it whole with Tab, accept it piece by piece with Alt+→, reroll it, or dismiss it with Esc.

items.name: dsh-whale-particles
items.desc: Dot-matrix backdrop for the DSH Web UI: the dots form the DeepSeek whale or a transparent PNG you import (alpha-masked), each dot carries its own low-frequency force and follows the cursor in manual mode, while an auto screensaver mode sweeps 360-degree waves and full-screen breathing across the artwork; sliders and toggles live under Settings > Plugins.

items.name: dsh-auto-maximize
items.desc: Maximizes the DeepSeek Harness desktop window automatically on startup, equivalent to clicking the maximize button once. Cross-platform (Windows/macOS/Linux), best-effort, host-only.

items.name: dsh-native-code-workbench#dsh-code-workbench
items.desc: Code workbench in the right sidebar: a workspace file tree and a multi-tab Monaco editor with syntax highlighting and version-guarded saving, Tab completion from DeepSeek fill-in-the-middle, per-save checkpoints with rollback, codebase search (plus a codebase_search tool for the agent), and reference chips that insert a selection into the chat as an @path mention.

items.name: dsh-boot-video-manager
items.desc: A companion playlist panel for the dsh-boot-animation intro-video plugin: add clips without leaving the app, order them, and switch between sequential, random and single-clip playback. Sequential order is made deterministic by parking every clip except the one due to play in a disabled/ subdirectory of the same asset folder and rotating it back in on each boot, leaving the upstream plugin unpatched. Also supports recycling instead of deleting, pinning one clip for every launch, per-clip opt-out, and .mp4/.webm/.m4v/.mov files including non-ASCII names.

items.name: dsh-input-prediction
items.desc: Input prediction: the likely continuation of your draft appears as grey ghost text after the caret and Tab accepts it, and after each assistant turn 1-3 clickable follow-up suggestions appear above the input box and send on click. Ghost completion, suggestions and the suggestion count can be toggled in Settings, Built-in plugins.

items.name: dsh-icon-changer
items.desc: Replaces the DeepSeek Harness desktop app icon (exe, tray and Start Menu) with any uploaded .ico, and restores the stock icon on demand.

items.name: dsh-file-transfer
items.desc: Adds download buttons to the document preview toolbar and the Files tree, packs a folder download into a streamed ZIP, and adds a Files-tree upload button that streams to the Host one file at a time, capped at 1 GiB and renamed with an (n) suffix instead of overwriting.

items.name: dsh-message-nav
items.desc: Adds a Codex-style message navigation rail for quickly locating earlier prompts in long DeepSeek Harness Web UI conversations.

items.name: dsh-app-restart
items.desc: Adds a Restart application section to the desktop app Settings; quits gracefully and relaunches the whole application.

items.name: dsh-mode-seat
items.desc: Persistent agent-preset (mode) selector docked in the composer input bar: switch the mode for new tasks, and set the new-task default from any running session.

items.name: dsh-chat-tools
items.desc: Chat column width and alignment control, numbered question history with keyboard navigation and auto-load of older questions, and markdown outline rails for both the conversation and the file preview.

items.name: dsh-prompt-vault
items.desc: Prompt library above the DSH composer — a 📚 button expands a searchable panel to insert saved prompts into the draft with one click (appends, never overwrites), persisted in a host-side JSON file.

items.name: dsh-wallpaper
items.desc: Persistent image or MP4 wallpaper for the DSH Web profile: a wallpaper card under Settings -> General selects a local image or MP4 (up to 300 MB), tunes surface opacity and blur, compresses video locally to H.264 when ffmpeg/ffprobe are on PATH, stores media under ~/.dsh/wallpapers, and pins the Web server to port 9191 so the saved wallpaper survives restarts.

items.name: dsh-fullscreen-settings
items.desc: Opens the DSH settings dialog as a full-page screen and moves the close control to a back row at the top left.

items.name: dsh-resizable-settings
items.desc: Makes the DSH Settings dialog resizable from its edges and corners and movable by its top strip, remembering the chosen size across opens.

items.name: dsh-desktop#packages/dsh-desktop-plugin
items.desc: Desktop-grade companion: browser native notifications for user questions and approval interactions, screen capture model tool, multi-agent tiling grid view, and lightweight Tauri desktop shell.

items.name: dsh-ui-zoom-regions
items.desc: Per-region UI zoom for DeepSeek Harness — Ctrl + wheel sets independent zoom levels for the conversation header, the left sidebar, the conversation body and the right sidebar (sidebars 25%-300%), and dragging the header bottom edge makes that header shorter or taller, growing by height only so label size stays unchanged.

items.name: dsh-restart-button
items.desc: Adds a Windows-only button at the foot of the sidebar that restarts the DSH desktop app and reloads the page when it comes back.

items.name: dsh-composer-plus
items.desc: Composer and sidebar helpers in one plugin, each switchable in Settings: a git Changes panel (uncommitted / unstaged / staged / branch diffs), ↑/↓ input history, Shift+Tab /plan toggle, one-click ▶ Continue after a stopped or failed turn, drag-and-drop queue reordering, Copy deeplink, Auto Review "Allow for this chat", project status markers with active projects first, background notifications, 11 extra UI languages and automatic updates from GitHub releases through the plugin manager.

items.name: dsh-session-drag-move
items.desc: Drag a session onto another workspace in the DSH sidebar and it really moves: the session-log header cwd is rewritten and the log directory is re-homed under the target project, with a progress bar while it runs.

items.name: dsh-selection-tools
items.desc: Select text in any Windows app to explain or translate it with the Harness agent, answered in a native always-on-top overlay.

items.name: dsh-sidenote
items.desc: Side chats and selection annotations for DeepSeek Harness, preserving full conversation history and bringing findings back to the main thread.

items.name: dsh-diy-layout
items.desc: Customizes the DSH home sidebar plugin entries without harness source changes: one- or two-column panel list, icon-only mode with 500ms hover tooltips, and per-entry ordering, hiding, and a settings page for the upper panel area and the footer plugin row.

items.name: dsh-token-speed
items.desc: Draggable ring gauge showing live model output speed (tok/s) with an expandable per-step detail panel (exact speed, TTFT, cache-hit rate, cache read/write, reasoning and input tokens, model, cumulative tokens).

items.name: dsh-convmap
items.desc: Conversation-map rail down the left edge of the transcript: one tick per user turn, read from the full session log on the host rather than from the rendered page, so long sessions are covered end to end. Hovering fans the neighbouring ticks open by pixel distance and floats a scrollable preview of that turn prompt and its last reply; clicking scrolls to the turn, paging older history in first when it has not been rendered yet; the tick for the visible turn stays highlighted while you scroll.

items.name: dsh-office-plugin
items.desc: Renders live multi-agent session activity as a pixel-art office in a Web UI side panel - each session is an ox/horse worker typing at its desk when busy or wandering off when idle, with click-to-view work monitors and in-place approval cards.

items.name: dsh-prompt-better
items.desc: Adds a button to the composer that rewrites the current draft into a clearer, more specific prompt through a one-shot LLM call, with one-click revert and cancel.

items.name: dsh-select-assist
items.desc: Select text in any Windows app to explain, summarize, translate, or read it aloud with DeepSeek Harness — answered in a streaming always-on-top overlay with a horizontal capsule menu.

items.name: sage-reminder
items.desc: A time module in the DSH session header: current time, time since your last message, reminders, and countdowns. Pure browser-side - data lives in localStorage and the host half registers nothing. Alerts are a border glow plus an in-app toast; no system notifications.

items.name: dsh-task-board
items.desc: Personal task board for the DSH Web GUI with a two-month calendar of colored timeline bars and day tasks, a daily checklist, a seven-day week view with completion checkboxes and drag-to-reschedule, a draggable 24-hour day timeline, ordered subtasks, per-day completion for long-term tasks, and AI extraction of tasks from natural language.

items.name: dsh-conversation-navigator
items.desc: Conversation navigator panel: turn-folded outline of the current session with per-step kind badges (assistant, tool, command, compaction, error), a hover bubble showing the full user question, a minimal mode that hides turn numbers for an all-badge view, keyword filter over user questions and assistant replies, click-to-jump with reading-position tracking, and load-earlier/load-all history paging. Host >= 0.1.2-rc.1; legacy hosts install @legacy/0.2.5.

items.name: dsh-quote-to-agent
items.desc: Quote text selected in a DSH Web conversation, then either attach it to the current composer or dispatch it to a subagent session: the quote sits on a bar above the composer, or opens that subagent in a new pane on the right. When the target has no subagent yet, the quote is held and the composer is seeded with a spawn request, then picked up automatically once the new session appears. Client-only.

items.name: dsh-russian-lang
items.desc: Adds Russian as a native option in Settings - General - Language for DeepSeek Harness, covering both the core UI and companion plugins. Localized Markdown export, in-message translation, live typography, slash-command aliases and an Alt+L layout fix, plus a settings card, all applied through a runtime locale snapshot rather than by modifying core files.

items.name: dsh-job-stop
items.desc: Stop a running background job from the session-header job list, with a confirmation dialog that restates the full command.

items.name: dsh-jev-advisor
items.desc: Adds human-facing TypeSafe Jev advice to DSH multiple-choice prompts, with recommendations, probabilities, confidence, close-call warnings, copyable suggestions, one-click adoption, profile-scoped card layout persistence, temporary decision preferences, and optional request previews with common-credential masking.

items.name: dsh-hermes-panel
items.desc: Hermes in the DSH sidebar: start and stop the gateway and dashboard, watch the dashboard beside the chat, and bridge DSH to Hermes. Windows only; requires an existing Hermes install.

items.name: draw2code
items.desc: An Excalidraw prototyping tab for dsh-better-sidebar with structured product clarification, conflict-aware human and Agent board updates, and prototype-guided frontend generation.

items.name: dsh-mindmap
items.desc: Conversational Markdown mindmap workspace: edit complete documents step by step, keep a live right-side visualization synchronized, and open, manage, and export mindmaps from the working directory.

items.name: dsh-intelligent-ui
items.desc: Interactive calculators, charts, forms, checklists, simulations and games in DSH replies, with local controls, native artifact expansion, and saved UI state.

items.name: dsh-game-hud
items.desc: Game-style floating HUD: balance HP bar, context MP bar, official peak/valley pricing with countdown, auto-compaction under 5% remaining, and memory-carrying new conversation.

items.name: dsh-icon-console
items.desc: Icon console for the DSH desktop app: import one icon and apply it to the desktop and Start Menu shortcuts (immediately), the application window image and the system tray image (after a restart), with automatic backup, one-click restore, a named icon library, and restart/exit controls.

items.name: dsh-restart-button
items.desc: Adds a restart button next to the shutdown button in the bottom-right of the DSH Web GUI; the server comes back up and the browser reopens.

items.name: dsh-plugin-dsweb-harness
items.desc: Use DeepSeek's web chat inside DSH: real chat history in the leftmost sidebar, a Chat/Work switch beside the agent mode, plus streaming answers, thinking, web search and file uploads.

items.name: dsh-reasoning-effort
items.desc: Adds an animated DeepSeek Chan reasoning-effort slider to DSH's native model selector, following model-declared levels with a running animation that speeds up while dragging.

items.name: dsh-save-button
items.desc: Adds a Download button to DSH Web GUI delivery cards, so files delivered with present save straight from the browser.

items.name: dsh-bubble-explain
items.desc: Select any text in a conversation and tap the Explain button to get a streaming Markdown explanation bubble, with recursive follow-up questions.

items.name: dsh-code-quote
items.desc: Composer code-quote collapse for the DSH Web UI: pasting a `path:line` header followed by code folds the input into one compact inline quote chip, and at send time the `agent/pre-step` hook injects the full pasted snapshot to the model as a separate context message. 0.5.x also folds sidebar file-selections that insert only a `path:lines` line (large selections), fetching the code from disk by session cwd, and preempts Ctrl+V paste interception.

items.name: dsh-diff-stat
items.desc: Inline +N −M badges on edit/write tool rows and a collapsible per-turn file-change summary card with aligned diffs, review and undo — covers native edit/write, str_replace_editor and Code Dispatch sub-calls, no git required.

items.name: dsh-router-laya
items.desc: Auto thinking-effort routing for dsh: a locally fine-tuned 7-question classifier (ModernBERT, 842MB, <1s CPU inference) picks low/high/max for no-intent messages; in-session retries escalate the tier (low to high to max) under exclusion constraints; the judge service fails safe to low if unreachable. A tier chip in the input bar shows the live tier and the last 20 judgments. All inference is local - task text never leaves the machine.

items.name: dsh-superterminal
items.desc: Native terminals for DSH 0.1.1-rc.2 on macOS, with local terminal AI sessions, SSH terminals that reconnect to the same remote task, bounded Terminal Group discussions, and handoffs with acceptance and rework.

items.name: dsh-at-any
items.desc: Codex-style `@file` mentions for the web GUI: search and reference workspace files of every format (.java, .vue, PDF, images, extension-less, hidden) with no index truncation. Replaces dsh-at-file.

items.name: dsh-chat-locator
items.desc: Turn-rail settings for the DSH conversation locator: tick thickness, rail on the left or right, a curved length gradient on the hovered tick, and a plain-text hover preview with adjustable line count, font size and width.

items.name: dsh-wallhaven-wallpaper
items.desc: Searches wallhaven.cc from a settings page and sets any wallpaper as the DSH web GUI background, with opacity, blur and scrim controls, a sidebar shuffle button and one-click original download; all fetching runs in the host process, so the browser never needs to reach wallhaven.

items.name: dsh-task-console
items.desc: Flip the DSH page over to a glass task board showing live jobs, subagents and session state, with an infinite canvas that unrolls a card into draggable controls, embedded web-app frames, and a conversation box that edits the canvas.

items.name: dsh-text-explain
items.desc: Select a passage in a DSH conversation and read a plain-language explanation in a floating panel, which carries the surrounding message as the context. Three explanation depths (plain / general / pro) that re-explain on the spot when switched; optional web search and local file lookup (the model decides by default, and a button can force one lookup that reports only what is new); follow-up questions; and a button that hands the whole exchange to a new session in standby mode - the background is queued without waking the model or spending tokens. Settings live on the host in settings.json, and nothing is written until you press save. The repository also ships an OpenAI-compatible endpoint and a browser extension (source).

items.name: dsh-plugin-response-window
items.desc: Web UI plugin that folds each staged response's think and tool calls into per-segment bounded, scrollable slide windows with a configurable height, keeping every intermediate response visible.

items.name: dsh-simple-view
items.desc: Declutters the DSH chat: hides agent execution-log rows, tightens spacing and fonts, wraps messages in bubbles, and injects an editable reply-concisely system instruction.

items.name: dsh-plugin-ai-drama
items.desc: AI short-drama workspace for DeepSeek Harness, with a dedicated drama agent preset, 35 agent tools and 10 bundled skills covering outline, characters, script, storyboard and export.

items.name: dsh-sidecard-ask
items.desc: Select text in the DSH Web GUI and ask about it in place (floating button, or the Alt+Q shortcut): an independent subagent that inherits no parent context answers, streaming into a side card hosted by the native right sidebar, dsh-better-sidebar, or a built-in overlay — and the question can be routed to the main conversation instead.

items.name: dsh-composer-enhance
items.desc: Composer prompt enhancement for DSH Web: a ✨ button rewrites the current draft in place after asking only about genuine ambiguity, and an empty composer shows a grey next-message ghost that Tab or a click fills into the draft without sending.

items.name: dsh-music-player
items.desc: Local music player: scans a folder for audio and video files, plays them in a Music tab with crossfade, a 10-band EQ and ReplayGain, and can write matched tags, covers and filenames back to the files with atomic replacement.

items.name: dsh-ppt-canvas
items.desc: Element-level PowerPoint canvas that edits the opened .pptx in place: click, marquee-select or pick a whole slide, describe the change, and the AI writes byte-preserving OOXML patches with undo and redo.

items.name: dsh-suggest-actions
items.desc: Clickable next-step suggestions under every reply; one click sends that sentence as your message.

items.name: dsh-whale-brand
items.desc: Puts your own animated vector logo over the DSH brand mark in the sidebar and beside the start-page headline, taking over the three single slots sidebar.brand.mark, sidebar.brand.name and conversation.hero.brand.mark. The bundled patch only inserts the plugin into the loader — the official brand plugin (@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-brand-official) holds those slots too, so you must disable it in the profile's cordis.patch.yml and restart. Ships a swimming whale that follows light and dark themes through currentColor and is tuned to stay legible at the sidebar's 24 px.

items.name: seektty
items.desc: Terminal workspace for DeepSeek Harness with local VS Code JSON/JSONC theme import, inherited terminal background effects, mouse text selection, structured tool and diff views, Session/Profile/plugin management, and Skill/MCP browsers.

items.name: dsh-queue-first-enter
items.desc: Pressing Enter with an empty composer steers the first queued message into the running turn while the agent is busy.

items.name: dsh-ui-polish
items.desc: UI polish layer for the DSH web client: frosted-glass menu surfaces, a draggable reasoning-effort slider that replaces the level radio list, and model-menu navigation that reaches the model list in one click and closes on a single Esc.

items.name: dsh-sm-context-piano
items.desc: A Codex-style conversation navigator for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI.

items.name: dsh-round-rightclick
items.desc: Radial right-click menu on conversation turns in the DSH web GUI for forking a session from a chosen turn, interrupting generation, copying the working directory path or session ID, opening the working directory, and exporting session logs.

items.name: dsh-model-shelf
items.desc: Replaces the chat model picker with a collapsible provider-grouped list (640x720 max) that shows each model name, provider name, provider ID and exact model ID, plus a manually managed uncommon list and a separate favorites list. Classification is user-driven only: no usage tracking and no auto-sorting. Search covers model name, model ID, provider name, provider ID and account notes.

items.name: dsh-tvision
items.desc: Turbo Vision-style character-cell window manager for dsh agents: overlapping framed windows with drop shadows, a Borland menu bar, a function-key strip, mouse drag and resize, approvals as modal dialogs, and five skins including the classic Borland blue.

items.name: dsh-input-assist
items.desc: Ghost-text completion for the composer: FIM suggestions stream in inline after a typing pause (SSE, first token rendered immediately), Tab accepts one word at a time and Shift+Tab takes all, in-flight requests are truly cancelled on retyping or Esc. Plus two-layer typo checking: a browser-local dictionary scan (Chinese wrong phrases, English misspellings and proper-noun capitalization, user-defined per-browser entries) with a debounced LLM context pass, underlined in red in the text with per-item navigation and click-to-fix.

items.name: dsh-raindrop
items.desc: Read-only Raindrop.io dashboard in the sidebar with collection and tag distribution, top source domains, content types, a 12-month trend and a cleanup backlog, plus two read-only agent tools for analyzing saved bookmarks. Requires a Raindrop.io API token (create an app and paste the token).

items.name: dsh-todos
items.desc: Todoist-style todo management in the sidebar with projects, labels and priorities, CJK-aware natural-language quick-add, repeat rules, a stats dashboard, import and export, seven agent tools and due-time reminders.

items.name: dsh-improve-prompt
items.desc: One-click prompt improvement for the DSH composer: press the sparkle button to rewrite the draft into an agent-ready prompt, replaced in place and undoable, with a deterministic fidelity check that keeps every path, identifier, number, URL and backticked token verbatim, plus a length ceiling that blocks inflation.

items.name: dsh-turn-tools
items.desc: Adds deliverable-file buttons to the end of each agent turn (opens files with the OS default app) and a floating dot rail for jumping between conversation turns.

items.name: dsh-model-controls
items.desc: Switch providers and models, adjust reasoning effort; each model remembers its own level.

items.name: dsh-user-message-timeline
items.desc: User Message Timeline - floating pill rail with hover preview, click/drag jump and pagination, switchable left/right.

items.name: dsh-conversation
items.desc: Conversation outline panel for the DSH web surface: user questions as root nodes (index, time, tool count and text volume per turn) with the Markdown headings of assistant replies hanging beneath them, plus level slider, search scope, bookmarks, copy and export as Markdown, section jump, keyboard navigation, a right-edge density rail and per-session reading-position memory. Read-only UI: it never touches prompts, tool results or provider traffic, and writes nothing outside its own localStorage keys.

items.name: dsh-custom-instructions
items.desc: Manage global AGENTS.md in DSH Web with Markdown preview, reusable templates, version history, import/export, failed-import rollback, and revision-conflict protection.

items.name: dsh-math-render
items.desc: Renders LaTeX in the chat — formulas inside your own message bubble, plus a live preview of the composer draft while you type.

items.name: dsh-math-snippets
items.desc: LaTeX snippet expansion in the composer, built from Obsidian LaTeX Suite's own defaults — 138 triggers expand as they are typed, Tab walks the tabstops, and the table of 142 is editable in one JSON file.

items.name: dsh-plugin-search
items.desc: Search field on the DeepSeek Harness Plugins page that filters the installed and official plugin cards as you type, matching each card title, description and package name; space-separated keywords must all match.

items.name: dsh-selection-translate
items.desc: Select text in the DSH web client and a translate button appears at the end of the selection; clicking it translates that text in place. Translation goes through the host llm service, so it reuses the model the current session already has selected and needs no separate API key; an OpenAI-compatible endpoint can be configured instead. The result opens in a popover that stays inside the viewport, with one-click copy, a row of language buttons for instant retranslation, and smart Chinese-to-English / other-to-Chinese as the default. Configuration is stored host-side and its API key is never sent to the browser.

items.name: dsh-qrpairing
items.desc: Floating phone-pairing QR button for the DSH WebUI. One click opens the dsh-remote-link pairing QR (image + 6-digit code + TTL) in an in-app overlay — works in both browser and DSH Desktop (same-origin img, no iframe).

items.name: dsh-search-switcher
items.desc: One-click search-engine switcher beside the DeepSeek Harness model picker; changes the dsh-free-search provider, handy on overseas university networks that block the DeepSeek Official search endpoint.

items.name: dsh-sidebar-assistant
items.desc: A sidebar assistant plugin for the Web interface, allows users to select any text, displays the model’s reasoning process and final answer in a floating panel.

items.name: dsh-plugin-subagent-model-route
items.desc: Annotates every subagent with the model route it actually ran on: a badge line in each parent-catalog row and a readout in a child session's own header.

items.name: dsh-codex-mini-pet
items.desc: Adds separate Chat and Work modes to DeepSeek Harness, embeds DeepSeek's official chat page, and provides an animated desktop companion with quick chat and task-completion notifications.

items.name: dsh-model-provider-badge
items.desc: Shows the provider behind a session's current model as a compact badge in the DSH Web composer tool row, left of the model selector.

items.name: dsh-nestquay
items.desc: Workspace groups for the DSH sidebar with group navigation and session status indicators.

items.name: dsh-s7r
items.desc: A retro macOS System 7-style workstation UI for DeepSeek Harness with desktop windows, Workspace and Agent management, Finder, Terminal, Monitor, context tools, and desk accessories.

items.name: dsh-artifact-index
items.desc: The missing backend for the dsh-artifacts sidebar tab — serves the /report artifact index and the artifact bytes it renders.

items.name: hwfee-dsh#system-fonts
items.desc: Separate font slots for content, code and terminal text, plus line height and letter spacing. Typography only — it never touches colour.

items.name: dsh-desktop-tauriapp
items.desc: Tauri 2 desktop app for DeepSeek Harness (macOS + Windows; installers on the repository's Releases page) with a built-in dsh runtime: tray-resident launcher with per-profile ports and windows, a process guardian that auto-heals up to three times, local or remote dsh, task-completion notifications with a Dock badge, and a live startup console. This plugin is the app's in-page half — its desktop chrome and notification bridge only take effect when DSH runs inside the desktop app; added to a regular DSH with `dsh plugin add`, it provides the bundled skill for packaging a DSH Web GUI as a Tauri app.

items.name: dsh-plugin-open-with
items.desc: Adds a capsule split-button to the conversation header: launch VS Code, terminal, or File Explorer at the current workspace directory in one click.

items.name: dsh-client-ui-shortcuts
items.desc: Profile-aware keyboard shortcuts for DSH Web: supports Question and Approval cards, Standard/Vim/Custom profiles, and capability-gated Session and Workspace navigation.

items.name: dsh-plugin-kit#kit-settings
items.desc: Host page for kit plugin configuration in the DSH Web GUI: registers a "Plugin configuration" section in Settings — peer to the built-in General section — through the official settings.section slot and declares a settings.kit.item child slot, which dsh-plugin-kit plugins render their own config cards into. Installing it alone shows an empty page; cards appear as slot-registering kit plugins are installed.

items.name: dsh-plugin-kit#tty
items.desc: Terminal panel for the DSH Web GUI: a sidebar "Terminal" entry opens a multi-tab xterm.js interactive terminal over a real PTY (node-pty), with SSH remote tabs (ssh2, agent / key / password auth), a cwd following the current session, and tty_list / tty_capture / tty_send agent tools.

items.name: dsh-lawagent-ui
items.desc: Legal training workbench: three-pane academic UI that reads the "Minglü" (lawagent preset) learning profile (case dossiers, flashcards, wrong-answer book, notes) and sends instructions into a Minglü session with one click.

items.name: dsh-lawkb-ui
items.desc: Legal knowledge-base workbench: hybrid keyword/statistical/vector retrieval over local statute .doc/.docx corpora, faceted filtering, charge-name and civil-cause trees, a document editor, and four AI tools (citation check, contract review, AI analysis, AI drafting).

items.name: dsh-xingye
items.desc: Chat agent for a DeepSeek Harness session: create characters and write their personas, keep several archive threads per character, undo or rewind the locally stored transcript, and record story beats in an event book.

items.name: dsh-clean-desktop-shell
items.desc: Clean desktop shell for DSH: launch by double-clicking a desktop shortcut like any normal desktop app, live backend monitoring with one-click tray start/restart/stop (progress dialogs), offline auto-reconnect, single instance. Reuses your existing web profile, no restyling of the web UI. Windows + macOS.

items.name: dsh-file-explorer-kit
items.desc: In-session "Files" tab (conversation.view, order 20) for dsh Web that browses the active session's workspace directory with breadcrumbs and previews files inline — sanitized Markdown (marked + DOMPurify), images, line-numbered text and PDF — served by read-only /dsh-files host routes registered on ctx.webServer; no write endpoints. Bilingual zh/en.

items.name: dsh-workspace-kit
items.desc: Workspace-first enhanced sidebar for dsh Web that shadows the built-in workspace browser at low priority (one-click toggle back to the official one) and adds soft workspace archive/restore, per-workspace SVG icons and accent colors, drag reorder and title/path/session-content search, plus a ⌘K Spotlight palette fuzzy-searching workspaces and sessions; the host half ships read-only workspace_find/workspace_list model tools and /workspace-find /workspace-list slash commands. Bilingual zh/en.

items.name: dsh-session-upload
items.desc: Composer attach button for DSH Web: multi-file picks become inline draft capsules, files are stored under the workspace uploads root with an auto-extracted UTF-8 .txt sidecar (txt/docx/xlsx/pptx/zip/odt, zero dependencies), and sent messages carry only the file name — never a raw path.

items.name: dsh-quick-replies
items.desc: Manageable one-tap text chips above the session composer; idle sessions queue the message and running sessions steer at the next safe boundary without rewriting the draft.

items.name: dsh-update-status
items.desc: Read-only DeepSeek Harness Web sidebar version chip that shows the running DSH version, npm latest/next/alpha channels, compatibility labels, and a copy-only upgrade command.

items.name: dsh-contradictions-indicator
items.desc: Shows a 0-100 conversation coherence badge and commentary by running parallel contradiction analysis on the live DSH session, with a manual trigger and interval-based auto-analysis (on by default, editable per session or globally).

items.name: dsh-peak-pricing-warning
items.desc: Shows DeepSeek peak/off-peak pricing status, a countdown to the next rate change, and the estimated session cost as inline text beside the model selector.

items.name: dsh-sidebar-hover
items.desc: Claude Code-style sidebar for the macOS desktop app: hovering the collapsed sidebar toggle peeks the sidebar over the content, selecting a session collapses it, clicking the toggle pins it; plus back/forward session history arrows (⌘\[ / ⌘]).

items.name: dsh-ctrl-wheel-zoom
items.desc: Hold Ctrl and roll the mouse wheel to zoom the whole Harness Web UI around the pointer, 50-200% in 10% steps; Ctrl +/- and Ctrl 0 from the keyboard; a bottom-right chip and a Page zoom row in Settings → General show and reset the level.

items.name: search2chart-mcp#dsh
items.desc: Native DSH plugin that renders structured data as inline charts directly inside the conversation, with zero runtime dependencies.

items.name: dsh-custom-fonts
items.desc: Fonts and code-font settings for the UI with an English-only glyph scale (100-160%), a -4..+8 px content-size offset that actually applies, and settings kept across refreshes - a maintained fork of lsh2002/dsh-custom-fonts.

items.name: dsh-keys-setting
items.desc: Configures from the settings window's General page whether Enter, Shift+Enter and Ctrl/Cmd+Enter send the message or insert a line break; the engine default is kept until you change it.

items.name: dsh-flowglass
items.desc: Live flowgraph visualization for DeepSeek Harness sessions, including tool calls, parallel groups, subagent branches, and drill-down details.

items.name: dsh-skills-mcp-manager
items.desc: Manage skills and MCP servers from one DSH settings panel. Skills are read from disk: browse, search, preview the body, create, rename and delete, with a backup written before every removal. Global MCP servers are the real cordis.patch.yml loader rows; per-project entries mount only for sessions in that project. Each expanded card lists the tools that server actually registered, and a per-server allow/deny rule keeps only the ones you need — a blocked tool never enters the tool registry, so it costs no context on every turn. Every MCP card carries a connection status tag (connected with a tool count, retrying, gave up, activation failed) plus a one-click reconnect, so a server that fails at startup is visible instead of silently missing its tools. Imports existing configs from 26 other MCP clients.

items.name: dsh-quick-screenshot
items.desc: One-click screenshot button that floats over every DSH page, with a second one in the composer tool row: it captures the DeepSeek Harness window (or the whole desktop with a modifier) using the host capture tooling and puts the PNG where it is useful — straight into the composer draft as an attachment, or on the clipboard when no composer is mounted. Windows-verified, with macOS and Linux backends; no dependencies and no build step.

items.name: dsh-drawio
items.desc: A draw.io editor as a .drawio file viewer in the DSH sidebar: diagrams are ordinary workspace files (new ones default to docs/diagrams/), edits autosave, and a file changed outside the editor is refused with a conflict bar instead of being overwritten; the editor is downloaded once from a pinned upstream release with a SHA-256 check and then runs fully offline.

items.name: dsh-atlas
items.desc: Unified @ mentions in the DeepSeek Harness web composer: five built-in categories (file, folder, skill, past chat, plugin) plus a data-source seam any plugin can register through, references to absolute paths outside the workspace, and a candidate menu that can be scoped by a folder named earlier in the draft and pages with PageUp/PageDown instead of hiding rows.

items.name: dsh-inline-diff
items.desc: Renders edit and write tool calls as always-expanded side-by-side diffs styled like git diff, with optional syntax coloring and word-level highlighting.

items.name: dsh-custom-js
items.desc: Load, edit, manage, and hot-reload trusted JavaScript and TypeScript userscripts in DeepSeek Harness.

items.name: dsh-paste-path
items.desc: Finder clipboard paste for macOS: Cmd+C files or folders in Finder, then Ctrl+V in the DSH composer inserts their absolute paths; ordinary text paste with Cmd+V is untouched.

items.name: dsh-pluginone
items.desc: Gathers custom plugin settings pages and cards into draggable top tabs under a unified Plugin settings navigation row.

items.name: dsh-harness-ui
items.desc: A full-page console panel opened from the sidebar, with eight tabs: an overview; a session list read from the sessions service (title, directory, running state, updated time, with filters); installed bundles and Loader entries from pluginInventory and pluginManager, with per-bundle enable switches; a plugin market listing public topic:dsh-plugin repositories from the GitHub search API; a model and provider editor that writes the llm-pi-ai settings namespace through remote.settings.mutate (switch a session model, add or edit providers and their model lists, and store API keys via remote.credentials, merging over the stored profile so fields the form does not expose survive an edit); MCP and skills tabs; and a usage tab that reads the host's loopback /api/dsh-usage/overview document. Services are declared through ctx.inject, so a deployment that omits one mounts without the console rather than crashing.

items.name: dsh-prompt-enhancer#dsh-prompt-enhancer
items.desc: Composer prompt enhancement for DeepSeek Harness: a button beside the model selector rewrites the draft through one auxiliary LLM call and writes the result back in place, with composer undo left intact; a /prompt-enhance slash command returns the rewritten prompt as a command result line without touching the draft; the enhancement call can be pinned to its own fast provider and model in the profile patch; the rewrite policy is faithful - original intent, language and information are kept, code, commands and paths are preserved verbatim, and nothing is invented or padded with placeholder text.

items.name: dsh-reasoning-language
items.desc: Uses a configurable system-prompt section to request a chosen reasoning language (Simplified Chinese by default), and expands thinking rows by default while preserving rows the user manually collapses.

items.name: dsh-locale-ko
items.desc: Korean UI language pack that adds 한국어 to Settings → General → Language through the official language-pack API.

items.name: dsh-moss-boot
items.desc: Plays an intro full-frame when you open DSH, when you open a new conversation, or every time you open the one you pinned. The built-in footage is themed on a Wandering Earth-style space station and the quantum AI MOSS (550W): a red single eye ignites while the Earth’s curve slides past the viewport. Four clips ship embedded in the code — no separate video files — and the library lets you tick any number to rotate at random (never the same clip twice in a row), preview the rotation, or swap in your own videos. Sound plays without a click; the pin button sits beside Settings.

items.name: dsh-liquid-glass-input
items.desc: Liquid Glass refraction input card for the DSH web GUI, with coupled-spring press animation. Published on npm: dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-liquid-glass-input.

items.name: dsh-deckseek
items.desc: A calmer reading view for DeepSeek Harness with auto-collapsing process, a minimap-style message navigation rail, in-page search, unified failure cards, and generative MCP Apps (SEP-1865) in sandboxed iframes.

items.name: dsh-vitals
items.desc: Live btop-style CPU/memory/temperature/GPU monitor tab for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI.

items.name: dsh-qol
items.desc: Mobile-first Web UI quality-of-life pack for the DeepSeek Harness: a Chrome-style active-session tab bar, full-screen sidebar swipe open/close, overlay sidebar, collapsed-sidebar recents, keyboard-suppressing session switching, viewport/IME keyboard adaptation, touch feedback, code/table inner scrolling, hidden permission dropdown, a full-screen settings rewrite with tab memory, and a compositor-driven status pulse, no-touch-drag long-press protection — 14 features, each independently toggleable from the Settings QoL section with instant effect, persisted per browser in localStorage; pure client-side CSS/JS, mobile rules locked to viewports of 768px and below so desktop stays untouched.

items.name: dsh-zen
items.desc: Zen Mode view tab and foreground time tracker for DeepSeek Harness: while the agent works, a calm conversation view shows running/done status, your latest user message, live activity hints and the final AI reply in markdown with one-line turn stats, plus screen-watching (focus) time tracking with daily/weekly Zen scores, a chat-hide toggle that hides tool calls and reasoning rows, auto enter/exit Zen on task start/complete, an Alt+Z shortcut and a Zen settings panel — pure client-side, stored in localStorage, no network.

items.name: dsh-strata
items.desc: Session minimap in the scrollbar gutter: to-scale bands coloured by event kind, anchor dots for user messages and failures, auto-loading history at the top, a hover wall of every prompt in the session, and a three-step map scale switcher.

items.name: dsh-locale-ko
items.desc: Adds Korean (한국어) as a native option in Settings - General - Language and translates all 2,775 Web UI strings of dsh 0.2.0-rc.2 and 0.2.1-alpha.2, experimental features included. Works in dsh web and the desktop app.

items.name: dsh-ui-scale
items.desc: Scales the whole DeepSeek Harness interface from 50% to 200%, menus and pop-ups included, set from Settings - General with a slider, a percent field or presets. Works in dsh web and the desktop app, which has no zoom of its own.

items.name: dsh-stock-view
items.desc: A collapsible, draggable popup in the top-right corner of the DSH web interface for watching A-shares, ETFs, Hong Kong and US stocks and OKX spot crypto side by side: real-time quotes, intraday and daily/weekly/monthly candlestick charts with moving averages, buy/sell target prices, group switching with drag-to-reorder, rename and delete, cross-market search, and light/dark themes. A fork of Awu12277/dsh-stock-watch that adds US quotes via Eastmoney and crypto via OKX.

items.name: dsh-vsceditor
items.desc: Embeds a real VSCode editor (code-server, or your local desktop VS Code via the bundled bridge extension) as a GUI tab: agent file edits open turn-scoped red/green diffs that survive tab closes and page reloads, files lock while the agent writes, and a watchdog supervisor keeps zero orphan processes.

items.name: dsh-chat-diff-summary-legacy
items.desc: A per-turn change bar above the composer showing which files the turn changed and the line deltas, for DeepSeek Harness 0.1.5-rc.1 through 0.1.7.

items.name: dsh-plugin-lookatstudy
items.desc: A study tab with course-map, tutor and blackboard columns that turns markdown files, local folders or GitHub repos into guided courses, with lesson unlocking, mastery tracking, spaced repetition and a tutor-designed course import.

items.name: dsh-awesome-fonts
items.desc: Font switcher for DeepSeek Harness Web GUI: 99 UI fonts + 31 code fonts with CJK-Latin pairing.

items.name: dsh-better-workspace
items.desc: Hierarchical workspace tree for the DSH sidebar: every slash in a workspace title becomes a virtual folder (arbitrarily deep), the add-workspace directory flow gains a parent-group popup, renames re-derive the tree instantly, sessions nest on the same rule with separate visual styling, and every row carries right-click actions plus per-row appearance customization (color, text-only glow, font weight, primitives-family icon).

items.name: deepseek-splash-animation
items.desc: Plays a video while DSH opens, then dissolves over 0.3 seconds once it has played out. Ships with a default video so it works on install, and the path can be changed or cleared from the plugin settings page.

items.name: dsh-ui-rainbowspeak
items.desc: RainbowSpeak — a flowing rainbow marquee border around the chat composer card, driven by a conic-gradient ring. Live settings for speed, width, seven color schemes, direction, sides and breathing, plus session-state awareness that reacts to running, attention, error and celebration moments.

items.name: dsh-task-graph
items.desc: Adds a Graph tab that renders one session's execution as an interactive DAG of turns, LLM steps, tools, skills, subagents, code changes and tests, with live status, retry aggregation, critical path and trajectory linkage.

items.name: dsh-hebrew-rtl
items.desc: Hebrew RTL rendering for the web GUI: per-block direction by dominant script, bidi-safe input fields, and RTL-aware Cmd+Left/Right line navigation.

items.name: dsh-header-controls
items.desc: Restart / exit power buttons in the conversation header.

items.name: dsh-plugin-makima-tui
items.desc: A terminal workbench for dsh with streaming chat, tool execution, session management, provider management, and image input.

items.name: dsh-chat-index
items.desc: Per-session question index for the DSH Web UI: a time-proportional dot rail on the right edge and an expandable chain panel showing every user question with its time, including branch/subagent sessions; clicking a node jumps to that message and highlights it.

items.name: dsh-balance
items.desc: Shows the selected model provider's account balance next to the composer's model seat once a model and reasoning effort are selected.

items.name: dsh-sidechat
items.desc: Side conversations forked from the main session, with native conversation rendering, selection annotations and handback.

items.name: dsh-plugin-approval-zh
items.desc: Localizes the DeepSeek Harness approval panel in the web client and translates authorization reasons from English to Chinese, with a built-in phrase dictionary first and a model-router fallback for reasons the dictionary does not cover.

items.name: dsh-workspace-categories
items.desc: Category tree for the DSH sidebar workspace browser: workspaces and their sessions nest under user-made categories (collapsed state remembered), rows drag between categories, a new workspace can be created straight into one through the directory picker, categories rename and delete in place, and a footer toggle switches the panel back to the built-in list.

items.name: dsh-nav-pointer
items.desc: Vertical message pointer rail on the left edge of the chat: one dash per user message, click to scroll to that message, hover for a preview bubble.

items.name: dsh-bingo-ren
items.desc: Adds a draggable restart button and a plugin panel to the DeepSeek Harness desktop app: it prompts when the profile plugin list changes, records additions and removals per profile, tracks trials, reports host startup state, and offers rollback, minimal boot and recoverable cleanup.

items.name: dsh-input-list
items.desc: DSH prompt library and reusable snippets plugin: save, edit, delete, and append prompt templates, workflow instructions, and reusable text from a button beside the composer without sending.

items.name: dsh-hud
items.desc: Read-only Git panel for the current workspace — branch, changed files, diffs and image before/after compare — plus three capsules above the composer (Git status, tool and skill activity, session running time) and per-session change attribution with review progress.

items.name: dsh-sidebar-branch-chat
items.desc: Adds a Branch Chat tab to dsh-better-sidebar that opens independent archived sessions with a head/middle/tail context digest and the same tools as the main agent.

items.name: dsh-markdown-input
items.desc: Markdown input for the composer that keeps the typed Markdown as the sent text while drawing bullets and checkboxes, styling bold, italic, inline code, strikethrough, headings, quotes and fenced code blocks, continuing lists on Shift+Enter, and wrapping selections with Cmd/Ctrl+B, I and E.

items.name: dsh-startup-animation
items.desc: Startup splash for DeepSeek Harness: an animated avatar with aurora, stardust, pointer parallax and a module-assembly entrance, plus the same image as the main-UI wallpaper; both images can be swapped from a settings page that previews the animation live.

items.name: smooth-cursor
items.desc: Smooth comet-mode animated caret for the DSH Web composer: a glowing comet trail replaces the native blinking caret and glides across the input as you type, with configurable accent color, thickness, and trail, IME-aware for CJK input.

items.name: dsh-model-accordion
items.desc: Provider-folded model selector for the DSH Web composer with catalog-driven reasoning effort choices.

items.name: dsh-draft
items.desc: A Markdown-based draft-board plugin for dsh: live-preview editing and local persistence.

items.name: dsh-live-terminal
items.desc: Visible terminal panel that streams the agent's shell commands into an in-app terminal and lets the agent capture the terminal screen as text.

items.name: dsh-workspace-create-dialog
items.desc: Codex-style Create Workspace dialog: name it and the folder is created for you, or pick one with a native chooser that remembers where you were (the native chooser is Windows-only; elsewhere use the name field).

items.name: dsh-mobile-upgrade
items.desc: Requires DSH 0.1.5-rc.1. Mobile UI fixes for the dsh web profile: narrow-screen drawer and settings tabs, a full-width model menu, a stuck-request network chip, and a narrow-header collector that folds the lineage, subagent and background-job chips into one tappable sheet.

items.name: dsh-novel-reader
items.desc: Local TXT novel reader in the DSH right sidebar: bookshelf with file, directory and path import, chapter table of contents with jump, click-to-turn or vertical-scroll paging, reading progress restored across restarts, and font, line-spacing, background and night themes.

items.name: dsh-plugin-media-wallpaper
items.desc: Image and video wallpapers for the DSH web workspace: auto-detected GIF/APNG/animated WebP/PNG/JPEG/MP4/WebM backgrounds with blur, brightness and dimming, tint-following UI, per-component transparency, and one-click preset wallpapers.

items.name: dsh-select-quote
items.desc: Select text in the dsh web conversation to attach it as an annotation to your next message. The source text keeps a dashed highlight with an ordinal badge in place, and the composer summary lists, edits and jumps back to each annotation.

items.name: dsh-composer-layout
items.desc: Web Composer placement for long prompts: keep it at the bottom or dock it in a resizable right column beside a long answer.

items.name: dsh-skills-hub
items.desc: DSH Skill Manager: browse, enable/disable, import from Codex/Claude Code/ZCode/WorkBuddy/QCoderWork, auto-discover skills with symlink support.

items.name: dsh-workbench
items.desc: A right-side file workspace for DeepSeek Harness Web with source previews, captured DSH diffs, tabs, and a workspace tree.

items.name: dsh-launch-buttons
items.desc: Multiple named launch targets in the DSH composer: left-click starts the default target, right-click opens the list.

items.name: dsh-file-review
items.desc: Review agent file changes in a Diff panel, add comments for follow-up edits, and undo edited or newly created files.

items.name: dsh-effort-switcher
items.desc: A Codex-like effort switcher for Deepseek Harness.

items.name: dsh-settings-beautify
items.desc: Normalize the DSH settings UI onto one design language: unified typography, cards, controls, focus and motion across every settings page, including pages contributed by other plugins.

items.name: dsh-plugin-groups
items.desc: Adds a My Groups tab to the DSH Installed plugins page: custom groups with drag reordering, colored text tags, Chinese notes, group locking, real enable switches, and two preset snapshot slots.

items.name: dsh-open-native
items.desc: Click a delivered-file card to open the file with the system default application instead of DSH's built-in sidebar preview; hold Shift to keep the original preview.

items.name: dsh-longtext-input
items.desc: Adds a Long text button to the composer tool row: write or paste the body in an editor overlay, and on save it is written to <workspace>/.dsh-longtext/<timestamp>_<title>.md and an @ path reference to that file is appended to the composer, leaving the conversation free of the long text itself.

items.name: dsh-prompt-optimizer
items.desc: Improve the current chat draft before sending with a confirm-before-apply comparison.

items.name: dsh-genui
items.desc: Renders OpenTiny GenUI charts, forms, calculators and mini apps inline in DSH replies via schemaJson fences, with user actions flowing back into the conversation.

items.name: dsh-audio-control
items.desc: Floating audio control panel in the Web GUI: play/pause/next/previous for Windows media sessions (SMTC) and the system master volume/mute, served by a Node route half that runs a PowerShell helper.

items.name: dsh-shutdown-idle
items.desc: Runs a chosen power action (shutdown / restart / hibernate / sleep / lock / logoff) once every Agent session and background job has gone idle: the plugin samples in-process sessions once per second, counts running sessions as always busy, checks running background jobs through a configurable option (considerJobs, on by default, shown with its live count in Settings), waits a confirm window and then a cancellable countdown, and shows a draggable bottom-right card with the current phase and remaining seconds; the enable toggle never survives a host restart, any newly started session or Cancel aborts the countdown, and if the agents service is unavailable the machine is treated as busy so nothing ever fires. Windows only (the built-in shutdown / rundll32 actions); every action except none degrades to none elsewhere.

items.name: dsh-alt-enter-newline
items.desc: Adds Alt+Enter as a newline to the DeepSeek Harness (dsh) web composer.

items.name: dsh-file-viewer
items.desc: Read-only Web client file-preview panel with image, PDF, CSV/TSV, text, source-code, Markdown, JSON and YAML renderers, large-file range loading, and a provider API for non-local content.

items.name: dsh-moon-light
items.desc: A marquee mood-light ring around the DSH web UI edge that reacts to session state, turning green while the agent works, pink when done, and yellow when something needs attention, with colors, ring width, rotation speed, and flash frequency configurable from the settings panel.

items.name: dsh-task-panel
items.desc: Task panel for the DSH Web sidebar: publish tasks, auto-distill related sessions, and drive plan/develop/review stages with subagents plus in-panel acceptance.

items.name: dsh-thinking-slider
items.desc: Turns the composer's reasoning-effort menu into a draggable slider and takes over the stock model-and-reasoning-level chip. Dragging follows the pointer continuously; releasing snaps to the nearest level and submits one session update per drag. The track draws its own fill, tick marks and white knob, only the highest levels (xhigh, max, ultra) get a flowing brand-colour gradient, and both ends carry the lowest and highest level names. The same card expands into the official model list. Arrow keys step one level, PageUp and PageDown two, Home and End jump to the ends, and each move submits. A generation counter on the directory object discards late responses, and reduced-motion turns the animations off. All data comes from the stock modelDirectories directory; no new capabilities are added.

items.name: dsh-workspace-browser
items.desc: Replaces the shipped sidebar workspace browser with Recents, a project editor that adds extra source folders, and pin, rename, fork, and archive row actions.

items.name: dsh-question-index
items.desc: Question index: an ordered, collapsible list of your asked questions floating on the right side of the conversation; click a question to jump the session to that point. Auto-indexes each session's full history on open, persists it locally, and jumps to older questions by growing the window on demand.

items.name: dsh-continue-button
items.desc: A continue button in the composer tool row, immediately left of the send key: one click writes an interruption-aware prompt into the draft and submits it, so an interrupted task resumes without retyping the context. The prompt names the interruption and appends the current task plus the tail of the last reply; Alt-click or right-click sends a bare 继续, and a non-empty draft is appended to rather than overwritten.

items.name: dsh-screenshot
items.desc: Native, instant region-screenshot button for the DeepSeek Harness composer: one click freezes the screen, a WeChat-style overlay (gray mask, green selection) appears, and the cropped PNG is inserted into the current draft. An optional eye toggle hides the whole DSH window before capturing, then restores it. No ms-screenclip, about 10 ms per drag frame, coexists with voice input. Windows 10/11 x64 only; the first capture compiles a helper with the built-in .NET Framework csc.exe.

items.name: dsh-feng-gu-lite
items.desc: Offline Beijing-time peak/idle indicator below the conversation composer, with a 2026 calendar, uncertainty labels, and brief peak reminders; no API key or runtime network access required.

items.name: dsh-capyreporter
items.desc: Always-on-top capybara task reporter for DSH Web — a transparent floating pet that narrates each trajectory step in a speech bubble, names the project it reports for, and alerts you when a task completes while you work elsewhere.

items.name: dsh-boot-compass
items.desc: Desktop full-screen boot splash. It covers DSH's loading card before first paint, plays a 4.5 s five-stage compass sequence, then hands off to the app; clicking anywhere skips ahead, and reopening the window from the tray replays it. The first cold start may hitch once, then runs smoothly.

items.name: dsh-plugin-execution-graph
items.desc: Adds an Execution graph conversation-view tab that renders each turn's prompts, replies, and tool calls/results as a foldable timeline with a detail panel and PNG export.

items.name: dsh-status-card
items.desc: Adds a configurable dsh-ui status card before each DSH agent reply, with bilingual templates and a live settings preview. Requires @omdsh-dev/dsh-genui from dsh-market; without it, the card markup is emitted unrendered.

items.name: dsh-model-block-picker
items.desc: Composer model selector grouped by provider: pick a provider card, then drill into that provider to choose a model, with cross-provider search and Reasoning Effort kept.

items.name: jira-tasks-dsh-plugin
items.desc: JIRA task panel under the DSH composer: per-workspace project key and optional JQL, listing the issues assigned to the current user with status, priority and issue-type chips, a total count, collapse and refresh, links to JIRA, plus a settings card for the base URL and token with a connection probe.

items.name: dsh-pwa-launcher
items.desc: Turns the browser PWA shortcut already on your desktop into a real launcher: it adopts that shortcut and keeps its icon, then starts dsh web silently on double-click and opens the app window; adds restart and dsh self-update (with rollback) controls to the web UI. Windows only.

items.name: dsh-quote-reply
items.desc: Keeps quotes out of the message body: quoting any passage from an assistant turn opens an editable quote tray above the composer, the quotes are injected into the next turn as system-prompt context (attributed with source and time), and an expandable quote row under that turn shows exactly which quotes were used. Quotes persist across page reloads and are claimed per turn; the host and client halves hand-shake on version and report a compatibility verdict.

items.name: dsh-image-picker
items.desc: Adds a paperclip image-picker button to the conversation composer - pick reference images through the system file dialog and feed them straight into the official attachment pipeline (thumbnails, limit checks, upload with message).

items.name: dsh-composer-input-history
items.desc: Recalls messages you already sent in the DSH composer with ArrowUp; ArrowDown walks forward, restores the draft you were writing, and one more press discards it and clears the composer.

items.name: dsh-prompt-optimizer
items.desc: Smart prompt optimization & dynamic thinking effort adaptation with composer capsule, DSH/custom models, undo/re-optimize, and native settings.

items.name: dsh-boot-splash
items.desc: Boot film for the web UI: a blue whale floods black from below as the page loads, then glides left and pulls the | deepseek HARNESS wordmark out of itself before the app appears.

items.name: dsh-pwa-ui
items.desc: Gives an installed dsh web app a native-looking window caption through Window Controls Overlay - the manifest route is served with display_override, the app's own sidebar brand row and session header become the drag region, and the app's own trailing controls are inset clear of the browser's caption chrome.

items.name: dsh-work-list
items.desc: Local-first DSH Web work checklist with rich-text notes, categories, folding, drag reordering, search, JSON import/export, and a restorable trash.

items.name: dsh-sao-link-start
items.desc: Adds a configurable SAO-inspired full-screen startup animation to DeepSeek Harness.

items.name: dsh-pixelwhale
items.desc: Pixel-font "deep seeking" thinking status with an animated DeepSeek blue whale (20 spout frames and 32 tail-wag frames).

items.name: deepseeh-harness-ultra-slash
items.desc: Separate slash-command group in the Web UI composer: /steer injects text on the agent's next step without interrupting the turn, /new starts a blank session, /skill and /docs wrap /steer with post-turn skill or docs tasks, and custom /steer aliases are configurable in Settings.

items.name: dsh-plugin-canvas-pro
items.desc: Adds a Canvas drawer and eight model tools to create, patch, version, and export HTML, Markdown, Mermaid, SVG, and React artifacts.

items.name: dsh-prompt-optimizer
items.desc: One-click prompt enhancement and structuring button for DSH composer.

items.name: dsh-image-question#plugin
items.desc: Ask the user a question about a local image; the DSH Web card offers zoom, pan, box, brush and lasso annotation, NG/OK/unsure verdicts and a note, and the agent receives annotations back in source-image pixel coordinates.

items.name: dsh-markdown-input
items.desc: Markdown live rendering for the DSH Web UI composer: typed Markdown (bold, lists, code fences) renders as you type in a CodeMirror-based takeover composer; sent user messages render as Markdown; pasted rich text becomes clean Markdown.

items.name: dsh-revise
items.desc: Visual frontend revision workbench: point at a real page element, describe the change, send it into the current DSH session, then review fixed-viewport before/after screenshots (1280x800 and 390x844) beside a captured source diff, accepting each revision item by item. Revision records are kept per session under .dsh-revise/ and export as a single portable HTML report.

items.name: dsh-composer-autopair
items.desc: Auto-pairs brackets and quotes in the DSH chat composer, inserting the closing half with the caret in between; it also wraps selected text with the typed pair and handles brackets committed by an IME.

items.name: dsh-effort-ultra
items.desc: A native reasoning-effort control for the composer: a blue-to-violet tier bar with a starfield and a sheen sweep. It owns the model seat and drives the official model-directories service, so the ladder comes from each model's own reasoning declaration and no other plugin is required.

items.name: dsh-quick-actions#composer-quick-actions
items.desc: Global Quick Actions beside every session-backed composer in DSH. One press sends a preset or your own saved text, with per-action send confirmation.

items.name: dsh-chat-image-lightbox
items.desc: Full-screen lightbox for chat images with zoom, drag pan, download, and keyboard or touch navigation. Images returned by the display_image tool render inline in chat.

items.name: dsh-font-enhancer
items.desc: DIY your DSH UI fonts and colors: per-region styling, unified overrides, theme save and switch, random font and color.

items.name: dsh-lobsterai-daddy
items.desc: Turns the LobsterDaddy multi-account console into a floating ball in the DSH window: drag it anywhere and the position persists, and the panel can be set to follow the ball. Clicking it slides out a drawer that renders the console as native DOM (no iframe) from the loopback-only same-origin proxy, showing action buttons, the account LobsterAI is currently signed in as, and a per-account list with balance, check-in state and last check-in time; a resizable persisted drawer, a live online/offline dot and an account-count badge are included.

items.name: dsh-skill-browser
items.desc: Browse the DSH skill library from a floating-ball panel: categories, Chinese descriptions, instant search, full SKILL.md viewer, and an automatic skill-failure ledger driven by tools/result events.

items.name: dsh-todo-float-ball
items.desc: Floating progress ball for the AI agent todo checklist: six skins, live done/total ring, multi-session monitoring with pins, inline rename, capsule mode, draggable; realtime sync via the sessions service.

items.name: dsh-live2d
items.desc: A Live2D waifu plugin for DSH.

items.name: dsh-plan-plus
items.desc: Plan review enhancement for DeepSeek Harness Web: reply to the plan-review card inline to have the model revise the plan, and browse, compare, edit and archive every plan version in a full-screen overlay.

items.name: dsh-workspace-plus
items.desc: Hierarchical workspace tree and multi-view manager for DSH: workspace and session naming creates virtual folders (/), multi-view support (workspace tree, flat workspaces, single list, time timeline), session pinning, and independent sections for workspaces and sessions.

items.name: dsh-custom-fonts
items.desc: Customize the UI's Chinese and English fonts, code font, and global font-size offset on a settings page, with a live preview and one-click reset.

items.name: dsh-workbench-layout
items.desc: Rearranges DSH Web into a three-column workbench with file editing, Git views, Markdown preview, and workspace terminals.

items.name: dsh-pet-guardian-dragon
items.desc: A draggable desktop pet for the DSH web interface with interactive actions and growth states.

items.name: dsh-workbench-shell
items.desc: Compact 56px app navigation rail with a separate conversation list and sidebar collapse control for the DSH web UI; also hides embedding, rerank and image/video generation models from the chat model menu and /model.

items.name: dsh-global-todo
items.desc: Global cross-session todo list in the sidebar that the person and the agent both write to: ten global_todo_* tools add, batch-capture, update, attach documents and links to, append progress notes to and complete items from any session, and each item can be handed to an agent session in one of four modes with the outcome recorded on the item. The list is a single JSON file.

items.name: dsh-todo-inbox
items.desc: Global cross-session todo inbox for DSH web: any session's agent records human-action todos (merge MRs, approve work orders, reviews) via inbox_add/inbox_done/inbox_list; a sidebar entry shows a count badge and an expandable list to open and complete them, persisted to ~/.dsh/todo-inbox.json.

items.name: dsh-effort-dial
items.desc: Codex-style reasoning-effort card for the composer: takes over the model selector and shows the current level, the model row and a segmented slider over the model's own adapter-provided levels, with a model list, a reset, and a purple aurora with twinkling particles at the maximum level.

items.name: dsh-re
items.desc: Adds a refresh button to the DeepSeek Harness desktop title bar next to the Edit menu, reloading the interface without restarting the app.

items.name: dsh-settings-nav-scroll
items.desc: Adds a visible vertical scrollbar to the DSH Web settings navigation when its sections exceed the viewport.

items.name: dsh-context-window-picker
items.desc: Adds a session-scoped context window selector next to the reasoning-effort row in the DeepSeek Harness model popup: a pill showing the effective window opens a dropdown of presets below the model default, the choice applies to the next request of that session only, and a new session falls back to the profile default. It writes no config file and appends nothing to the session log.

items.name: dsh-tool-emoji
items.desc: Replace tool-card leading icons with emoji while preserving the original cards.

items.name: dsh-boot-animation
items.desc: Replaces the kernel boot page with a full-window video clip that dissolves into the app; the clip pool, enter mode and fade length are configurable in Settings → Plugins.

items.name: dsh-fonttune
items.desc: A font plugin for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI: the conversation gets its own font, size, line height, weight, tracking, word gap, paragraph gap and first-line indent, the interface font follows it, code keeps its own axis with ligature control; light and dark can each hold their own set, whole setups save as presets, and a floating panel puts every axis a dot away.

items.name: dsh-soup
items.desc: Project file explorer in the details column (multi-select, drag-move, upload, download, rename, trash, system-open) with an in-session read-only preview tab for Markdown/HTML/JSON/CSV/notebook/PDF + code highlighting, a live model throughput badge, and a multiline GoalBar.

items.name: dsh-steer
items.desc: Adds a live status badge to the session header and delivers guidance added mid-task without interrupting the turn.

items.name: dsh-file-review-tab
items.desc: Review agent file changes as a dsh-better-sidebar sidebar tab or chat turn-tail row — line-level diffs and undo.

items.name: dsh-plugin-brand-custom
items.desc: Custom brand icon and name for the DSH Web sidebar and conversation hero, editable live from a settings card on the plugin detail page.

items.name: dsh-manutd-fixtures

items.name: dsh-statusbar-config

items.name: dsh-rich-editor

items.name: dsh-agent-instructions-editor
items.desc: Edit global AGENTS.md and project AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md custom instructions in DeepSeek Harness settings, with project-chain discovery, byte-budget display, and save-conflict handling.

items.name: dsh-open-folder-fix

items.name: dsh-answer-highlighter

items.name: dsh-node-appearance

items.name: dsh-quick-toolbar

items.name: dsh-desktop-kit

items.name: life-workbench

items.name: deepseek-balance-whale-widget
items.desc: A fixed-corner whale widget for the DSH web GUI — balance, today's usage and per-turn cost with peak/off-peak pricing, editable balance-alert and daily-budget bubbles, a module-based custom bubble queue with A/B weighted choices and random lines or images, 30+ vendor templates (OpenAI, OpenRouter, Kimi, SiliconFlow, Ark, Zhipu, MiniMax and more) with per-model balance and subscription quota, plus task-end sound, imported audio, custom roles and a resource manager.
