items.name: dsh-files-native
items.desc: Native-feel DSH attachments: official PNG/JPEG/WebP/GIF thumbs plus 64px cards for other files via drag, paste, or paperclip; non-images land in .dsh-uploads and sent cards sit on the user bubble.

items.name: dsh-sidebar-account
items.desc: Sidebar balance row for DSH Desktop — account balance and a top-up button, right under the version row; refreshes every 10 minutes and whenever the window regains focus, with explicit signed-out and error states.

items.name: dsh-update-vd
items.desc: DSH Desktop control center: one-click app updating (progress dialog, unattended install, resume), plus Skills / MCP / Agents / Import settings pages — import agent presets and chat history from Codex, Claude Code, TRAE and WorkBuddy, search remote sources by address, and push notes straight into the composer.

items.name: my-dsh-desktop-extra
items.desc: DSH Desktop enhancement: one-click update checker, DeepSeek balance & API key viewer, and import other AI tools.

items.name: dsh-message-navigator
items.desc: Codex-style message navigator for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI: a tick per user message along the conversation edge, hover or click to preview and smooth-jump to the message, with full history auto-loading.

items.name: dsh-codex-effort-slider
items.desc: Drags the official reasoning-effort row into a continuous track: blue-to-violet fill, a starfield on the higher levels, and the official value text tinted to the current level. Off stays gray; no official text is rewritten.

items.name: dsh-terminal-keybar
items.desc: On touch devices, supplies the keys a phone's soft keyboard lacks (Escape, Tab, Enter, Ctrl-C and the arrow keys) as a translucent on-screen column beside the active terminal.

items.name: dsh-directory-plugin
items.desc: Starts the DSH desktop New Workspace folder picker in a directory you configure (Windows only) and adds a settings page for it, falling back to the stock picker when the saved folder is missing.

items.name: dsh-i18n
items.desc: Adds 20 locales (Traditional Chinese HK/TW, Japanese, Korean, French, German, Spanish, Portuguese, Italian, Russian, Ukrainian, Polish, Dutch, Turkish, Arabic, Hindi, Indonesian, Vietnamese, Thai, Swedish) to the DeepSeek Harness Web UI, with hand-polished translations, runtime fallbacks, and automatic translation of market and third-party text.

items.name: dsh-activity-bell
items.desc: Sidebar activity bell: a red badge counts sessions that finished, and clicking it swaps the sidebar list from workspace grouping to a day-grouped recent-activity list with a green dot on completions that have not been opened.

items.name: dsh-missher-enhance
items.desc: Adds usage statistics, a highlighted footer, piano navigation, projectless sessions, and model and document helpers to DeepSeek Harness.

items.name: missher-dsh-output-renderer
items.desc: Four assistant output layouts with full reasoning, independent tool details, and frame-synchronized or fading text.

items.name: dsh-cuigengji-plugin
items.desc: A fiction-writing workbench for DSH with chapter editing, shared plot canvases, grouped character and world settings, writing presets, and scoped import/export for author-agent collaboration.

items.name: dsh-better-ux
items.desc: Web interface enhancements for DeepSeek Harness with session rename/fork shortcuts, a searchable model picker with provider filters, mobile layouts, global font scaling, context usage alerts, DeepSeek balance and tariff rates, sent-message navigation, and conversation summaries.

items.name: dsh-subagent-ui
items.desc: Search, monitor, interrupt, and batch-archive workspace subagents, featuring real-time activity streaming and an active-agent floating panel.

items.name: dsh-workbuddy
items.desc: Reskins the DSH conversation hero — brand mark and workspace picker — with a Wordless-style landing view. The native composer stays untouched, and the picker still adds new workspaces (the entry declares its own directory-flow child hole, exactly like the shipped picker).

items.name: dsh-dock-vitals
items.desc: Live CPU, memory and GPU readout in the DeepSeek Harness composer status bar — a clickable badge with a details panel, per-metric toggles, and three refresh speeds.

items.name: dsh-ghost-prompt
items.desc: Predicts your next message after each completed turn and shows it as ghost text in the composer: press → to accept, or keep typing and finish it word by word with Ctrl+→, Esc to dismiss. The prediction model follows the session by default or can be picked in the settings card, which also has an on/off switch and a speed test.

items.name: dsh-review-md-preview
items.desc: Markdown preview and rendered side-by-side compare for the changes-review tab.

items.name: dsh-shader-workbench
items.desc: Node-based GLSL workbench: wire a shader graph on a canvas and preview it live, compile it to Shadertoy-compatible GLSL with multi-pass buffers (BufferA–D), hot-reload as you edit, cross-compile to HLSL / MSL / SPIR-V, and keep projects, materials, snapshots and resources (images, audio, lyrics) in a local workspace. Ships 57 built-in nodes, 8 bundled examples and 11 agent tools. No runtime dependencies.

items.name: dsh-web-file-uploader
items.desc: A file-upload plugin for the DeepSeek Harness.

items.name: dsh-desktop#whaleharbor-promo
items.desc: Turns a plain-browser DSH session into the WhaleHarbor lite client: a standalone browser --app window with a client-style top bar and task notifications, while the full desktop installer downloads in the background (multi-source, SHA-256 verified) and an install prompt appears when ready.

items.name: moonshile-dsh-plugins#dsh-workspace-sort
items.desc: Re-sorts sidebar workspaces by last activity once per day; stable order within the day.

items.name: dsh-sidebar-fold
items.desc: Folds every panel row in the sidebar (slot-registered and plugin-injected alike) into one Plugin Hub entry, giving the workspace list its vertical space back.

items.name: dsh-download-progress
items.desc: A download-progress indicator for the DSH session header: it reads the background-job roster and parses what downloaders already print — curl --progress-bar, wget, aria2, or a JSON progress file — into a progress ring, animated bars, transfer speed and ETA. No third-party plugin required; the package ships zero runtime dependencies.

items.name: dsh-htmlui
items.desc: Renders agent-authored HTML/CSS/JS inside the conversation as sandboxed iframes, with POST and SSE back to the model and reusable templates.

items.name: dsh-launcher
items.desc: Adds a power button to the DSH sidebar - Shut down or Restart, each behind a confirmation - and ships a Windows tray launcher that starts DSH without a console window, supervises it so Restart can relaunch it, and offers the same start-at-logon switch.

items.name: dsh-continue-button
items.desc: Adds a one-click Continue button beside Send that resumes a stopped turn by sending the "continue" prompt; hidden while a turn is running or the session is empty.

items.name: plugin-effort-slider
items.desc: Notched reasoning-effort slider grouped with the model picker in the composer, with theme variables and English, French and Chinese labels.

items.name: dsh-boot-animation
items.desc: Plays an intro full-frame on a new conversation, or every time you open the one you pinned. Four clips ship inside the plugin itself, embedded in code with no separate video files, and an in-app library switches between them, previews the choice, and accepts your own clip. The picker has two independent sections, so the intro animation and the workspace wallpaper are picked separately; the wallpaper can be a still or a looping tail of the last N seconds, with independent transparency for the picture and the sidebar plus three blur levels. The sidebar and the workspace also get a text colour each, for when the picture is at full strength and the theme own text no longer reads.

items.name: dsh-thinking-slider
items.desc: Replaces the composer model selector with a "model · reasoning level" trigger: a slider across every level a model reports, three switchable modes (the DSH native selector, a gradient particle rail, an energy-charge track), and a per-provider one-click fill for models that declare no reasoning levels.

items.name: dsh-ticker-jp
items.desc: A floating stock ticker for DeepSeek Harness: real-time quotes for Nikkei 225 and TOPIX ETF out of the box, plus worldwide markets via Yahoo Finance — Japan (.T), US, Hong Kong (.HK), China (.SS/.SZ) and any other symbol — with a customizable watchlist, display aliases and 16 UI languages.

items.name: dsh-screen-translator
items.desc: Universal on-screen translator for DeepSeek Harness Web UI: translates text, attributes, Shadow DOM, and iframes across 45+ languages.

items.name: dsh-plug-in
items.desc: Adds three settings pages to DeepSeek Harness: add, edit, enable and remove MCP servers; write agent skills by hand or install them from a GitHub repository; and keep a library of global personas with one active.

items.name: dsh-plugin#dsh-context-manager
items.desc: Conversation enhancements: a history-input overlay (Alt+Up with workspace/session/global/prompt scopes), recall of unapplied interjected messages, conversation forking with fork-family version switching, and optional auto-resend after forking (off by default).

items.name: dsh-plugin#dsh-settings-nav-icons
items.desc: Section icons for the settings navigation: replaces the uniform gear icons with per-section glyphs and fills the plugin-market card avatar slot with each plugin icon; a page reload after uninstall restores the official icons.

items.name: dsh-plugin#dsh-think-expand
items.desc: Auto-expands streaming thinking: always keeps the latest thinking block expanded, manual actions take priority, only the last block expands when opening a session, and nothing remains after uninstall.

items.name: dsh-vibeify#dsh-vibeify-experience
items.desc: Turns completed DeepSeek Harness public-content work into a browser-local visual magazine with explicit updates and reviewed one-article sharing.

items.name: dsh-power
items.desc: Windows-only power card injected into the DSH page: the artwork carries two hit zones (left shuts down, right restarts), the first click only turns the card into a yes/no question and the second click fires, and the restart engine stops only this instance's process tree, waits for the port to free, relaunches outside the host's Job Object and confirms the new instance answers on the plugin's own status route.

items.name: dsh-boot-animation
items.desc: Plays an intro full-frame on a new conversation, or every time you open the one you pinned. Four clips ship inside the plugin itself — embedded in code, with no separate video files — and an in-app library switches between them, previews the choice, and accepts your own clip. The pin button sits beside Settings.

items.name: dsh-plugin-pin-session
items.desc: Adds Pin/Unpin to the sidebar session-row menu and a collapsible Pinned Sessions group above the session list, with host-side persistence, hover quick-unpin, collapse memory, and live running-state dots.

items.name: dsh-plugin-sidebar-views
items.desc: Adds a Workspaces / Recent-sessions switcher above the sidebar list, with a pinned-sessions group, a per-row menu (pin/unpin, copy session id), title filtering, and browser-local pin storage with a one-shot migration from dsh-plugin-pin-session.

items.name: dsh-widget-center
items.desc: Native macOS desktop widgets for DSH: manage any number of widget instances — share quote tickers (5-provider fallback, trading-phase-aware throttling) and notes memos — each an independent NSPanel+WKWebView window spawned detached from the host, dragged anywhere, with a type-aware right-click menu. Instances are edited as cards in a three-view settings page (list / type picker / detail), and a market_quote model tool serves standardized quotes to any session. A Type Studio flow seeds a creation-mode session with an issue-template prompt for authoring new widget types.

items.name: dsh-show-media
items.desc: Shows a local image or short video in the current conversation card, with click-to-preview.

items.name: dsh-locale-es-cl
items.desc: Adds Chilean Spanish (es-CL) to the Web UI language list: 2,603 strings across 57 namespaces, with per-key fallback to English.

items.name: neoxider-agent-deck#dsh-agent-deck
items.desc: Opens the NeoXider Agent Deck desktop widget (chat, the slime pet avatar or the hinge handle) from a Harness session, and reports its mode, installed version, running state and whether it follows the same Harness.

items.name: dsh-power-button
items.desc: Adds a draggable power pill to the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI: a live status dot plus restart and stop actions, where restart is handed to a detached helper that resumes the same boot invocation once the port is released.

items.name: dsh-multi-root-explorer
items.desc: Replaces the sidebar workspace region with a two-tab browser: several workspace roots stay registered side by side while conversations are filed under the real working directory of each session, with a read-only resource tree that previews files in the right sidebar. Hiding is per tab, display-only and fully reversible; a resource folder or file can be copied as a path or dragged into the composer as a native reference, and @ completion covers every registered root rather than the working directory alone.

items.name: schedule
items.desc: Three draggable, resizable, auto-positioning floating desktop widgets for DSH Desktop — daily schedule, goals tracker, and calendar planner.

items.name: dsh-whale-girl
items.desc: Interactive whale-girl desktop pet for DeepSeek Harness: live balance/usage/context occupancy, slingshot toss, easter-egg bubbles, eco mode. 346KB package, zero extra processes.

items.name: dsh-chat-file-actions
items.desc: Open and copy local files and web links from a chat turn.

items.name: dsh-open-in-x
items.desc: Open DSH workspace directories in installed file managers, terminals, and supported editors from the Web UI.

items.name: dsh-workspace-combiner
items.desc: Multi-workspace manager: bind a docs anchor plus ordered code-project repositories into one session, injecting their absolute paths, a recursive file index, a server/client endpoint index and optional coding standards, and syncing writable directories into the sandbox.

items.name: dsh-intelligent-ui
items.desc: Offline-replayable charts and interactive explanations in DSH rc.2 Web chat, with optional AMap itineraries, confirmed follow-ups, and HTML export.

items.name: dsh-image-viewer-pro
items.desc: In-chat image viewer for the web UI: takes over content image clicks (Markdown images, message attachments rendered as blob: URLs, and read_image results) and opens a dialog with pointer-centered wheel zoom and an editable percentage, drag pan, 90° rotation, download with progress, copy as PNG, open with the default app, and ←/→ gallery browsing across the conversation.

items.name: dsh-artifact-preview
items.desc: Adds a produced-files card row to the chat and a resizable split-screen preview panel for workspace artifacts (Markdown, source code, CSV, JSON, images, HTML), plus a localhost port preview.

items.name: dsh-sidebar-settings-button
items.desc: Adds a Settings row to the sidebar header before Plugins, which opens the shell's Settings panel.

items.name: dsh-composer-alcove
items.desc: Collapses the composer to an iPhone-style home indicator while you scroll, then restores it on hover, click, or scroll up. Corner arcs dock the real composer into the left or right gutter.

items.name: deepseek-harness-freeze-content-on-window-resize
items.desc: Freezes the DSH Web GUI reading column at a fixed width and re-aligns the reading position after the window is resized or zoomed.

items.name: dsh-stock-bar
items.desc: Always-on quotes strip pinned to the top of the DSH window: watchlist, holdings with share counts and cost price, P&L, candlestick and intraday charts, 5-level order book, trade ledger, price alerts, and streamed AI review of the selected symbol.

items.name: dsh-codex-sidebar
items.desc: Codex-style details sidebar for DSH with Files, Review, Browser, and Terminal panes, transcript file links and diff stats, annotations, and Host-managed browser controls.

items.name: dsh-llm-assistant
items.desc: Resident Web overlay seat with its own assistant session: chat, images, reminders, a duty heartbeat, and on-demand read-only task reference.

items.name: dsh-llm-providers-ui
items.desc: Mounted owner of the LLM Providers Settings page: provider cards, drag-reorder card order, and picker sort.

items.name: dsh-functions
items.desc: Adds an extensible Functions menu to the DSH top bar, where plugins register one-click actions with staged confirmations, submenus and a pinned loader entry.

items.name: dsh-settings-search
items.desc: Instantly find DSH settings pages, tabs and rows by keyword, pinyin, intent or AI — and jump straight to them.

items.name: dsh-mobile-webui
items.desc: Mobile-viewport fixes for the dsh web GUI: overlay drawer sidebar with swipe gestures, icon-only composer with a mode · model · effort status line, centered popovers, and horizontal-overflow/scrollbar centering fixes.

items.name: dsh-plugin-path-completion
items.desc: Completes @path references in the Web composer: type @ (optionally ./src/ma) to list matching files and directories, pick one with the arrow keys, and the draft receives an @./relative/path reference (quoted when the path has spaces).

items.name: martty#npm
items.desc: A DSH-first Rust/ratatui agent TUI with streamed tool calls, subagents, durable sessions, and a Cordis-extensible client UI.

items.name: dsh-video-preview
items.desc: Plays local video and audio inside the conversation. Media files the model writes during a turn - screen recordings, transcodes, voiceovers - get a player under its final reply automatically when their paths appear in its commands, the command output or the reply; the play_video tool plays any other file. Video shows as compact cards with a hover preview, audio as a slim seek bar, streamed over HTTP Range so long files seek instead of loading into memory. Also registers a sidebar media preview renderer, since the built-in previewer treats mp4 as unviewable.

items.name: dsh-region-probe
items.desc: A read-only Cordis Inspect provider that lets an agent see the interface it is driving: outline() reports which UI regions the running shell actually rendered, with occupancy, geometry and current or past failure state; snapshot() returns one region's rendered node tree (tag, role, aria-label, own text, geometry, computed styles) addressed by slot key or CSS selector; failures() keeps a history of regions that failed to render and whether they recovered. Regions are addressed by the anchor the shell already writes for every slot, so it needs no region list and covers regions added later or contributed by other plugins. No UI, no tools, no dependencies, no network access.

items.name: dsh-session-tree
items.desc: Replaces the left sidebar session list with a tree of every session and its nested subagent descendants, with click-through to each conversation's multi-turn history and a tree_send tool for messaging any continuable session anywhere in the tree.

items.name: dsh-splash-gojo
items.desc: Full-screen boot animation for the DSH web client: the boot HTML paints a cover-fit artwork on its first frame, adds a slow settle, a scanning light sweep and a progress HUD, then hands the viewport over when the app mounts. Click or press Esc / space / Enter to skip.

items.name: dsh-statusline-plus
items.desc: Displays account quotas, Git state, context usage, public API reference costs, Subagent activity, and streaming speed in DeepSeek Harness Web.

items.name: dsh-flyout-sidebar
items.desc: Flyout sidebar with a file tree, uncommitted-changes list and multi-tab file/diff previews; pops out into a standalone browser tab.

items.name: dsh-cursorlike-sidebar
items.desc: A Cursor-like sidebar for DeepSeek Harness with file browsing, code editing, Git diffs, terminal, side chat, and Ctrl+L references.

items.name: dsh-keyboard-shortcut
items.desc: Adds a Keyboard Shortcuts page to the DSH Settings panel with six rebindable commands — permission-mode cycling, reasoning-effort stepping, a status-page and a task-list shortcut — plus PgUp/PgDn input navigation and an optional composer Enter remap.

items.name: dsh-plugin-groups

items.name: dsh-coding-plugin
items.desc: Coding-learn floating panel: edits and runs Python/JavaScript/TypeScript/PowerShell with exit code and timing, grades JSON course lessons with progress export, keeps Markdown notes and snippet library, and sends code plus a question into the current conversation for the main model to answer.

items.name: dsh-prompt-optimizer
items.desc: One-button prompt optimizer: rewrites the composer draft via a configurable strategy, with an editable template, few-shot examples, pinned models and reasoning effort.

items.name: dsh-quote-sidechat
items.desc: Select text in a reply and quote it into the composer as an atomic reference chip: delete the whole chip in one keystroke, click it to scroll back and highlight the quoted turn, and expand it into a bounded reference block at send time so the model can tell the quote apart from what the user typed. Also opens the snippet in a side chat, or copies it to the clipboard.

items.name: dsh-restart-button
items.desc: Power button in the DSH Web UI session header that lets you close or restart the whole DSH process.

items.name: dsh-paste-names
items.desc: Paste non-image files or folders into the chat composer as native @path references, or drag them in as absolute paths, instead of the images-only error.

items.name: dsh-plugin-workbench

items.name: dsh-model-provider

items.name: dsh-prompt-edit
items.desc: In-place prompt editing in the web chat: cleanly forks session history at the edited turn, preserves image and file attachments, and auto-archives the superseded branch.

items.name: dsh-edex-jarvis-ui#bundle
items.desc: JARVIS-style sci-fi HUD shell over the DSH web GUI: electric-cyan VITAL SIGNS / RT-MONITOR / RT-LOG left bar, POWER CORE gauges and a rotating RADAR scan disc on the right with up/down traffic chart, filesystem browser with file preview, and a terminal-styled composer with a JARVIS header strip that follows the active workspace.

items.name: dsh-edex-ui#bundle
items.desc: eDEX-UI-style shell over the DSH web GUI: system-telemetry left bar with per-core CPU sparklines, encom-globe world-map right bar with up/down traffic chart, filesystem browser with file preview, and a terminal-styled composer that follows the active workspace.

items.name: dsh-meow-smooth
items.desc: Mobile-first UX polish for the DSH Web UI: composer auto-fold, enter-as-newline on phones, compact sidebar/header/settings, zoom and overscroll lock, plus approval/question/completion notifications via in-page cards, Web Push, and webhook — zero dsh changes.

items.name: dsh-refresh-plugin

Binds soft reload (F5, Ctrl+R) and cache-busted hard reload (F5 with a modifier, Ctrl+Shift+R, appending a _dsh_refresh timestamp) through a capture-phase client key listener.

items.name: dsh-lifeline
items.desc: Right-side message navigation rail for DeepSeek Harness: per-message tick marks, hover-to-expand preview drawer, smooth jump to any historical message, star bookmarks, realtime slide animation with interrupt support, full session index with virtualization, dynamic panel avoidance, official --dsw-* token styling.

items.name: dsh-ui-harmonizer

items.name: dsh-widgets

Works on DSH 0.1.x and 0.2.x, web UI and desktop app.

items.name: dsh-plugins#dsh-desktop-entry
items.desc: Creates a Windows desktop shortcut that starts DeepSeek Harness when needed and opens the Web UI in a Chrome or Edge app window.

items.name: dsh-plugins#dsh-quote-selection
items.desc: Lets users quote selected conversation text with optional notes, then attaches the references to their next message.

items.name: dsh-raw-html
items.desc: Renders agent HTML output as real UI in the DeepSeek Harness web GUI, with visual cards, KaTeX math, Mermaid diagrams, built-in open-source fonts, and design-spec injection.

items.name: dsh-ux-plus
items.desc: A UX enhancement pack for the DSH web chat: one plugin that collects small interface conveniences, each with its own switch under Settings → UX Plus applied immediately — chat-area font size and reading width under Settings → General → Chat area, a session-row menu that copies the session ID or inherits the conversation into a new session on a chosen model, workspace and session rows ordered by recent activity with 24-hour idle auto-collapse and age labels, and settled ask_user_question cards left expanded. The switch list is generated from its own feature registry, so the pack grows as conveniences are added instead of being fixed at a count.

items.name: dsh-pi-composer
items.desc: Swaps the composer's model control for a PI-Desktop style picker: a two-pane menu with search and provider grouping, a reasoning-effort slider, ArrowUp/ArrowDown prompt-history recall, and a prompt-rewrite button with undo.

items.name: dsh-restart-button
items.desc: Restart button at the right end of the session header that restarts the whole client: the Windows desktop app (Electron shell and Host, through the Host's own graceful shutdown) or the dsh web server. It can wait until running turns and background jobs finish, reopens the open session afterwards with one-click continue for interrupted sessions, flags plugin updates that only take effect after a restart, and shows Host uptime and memory on hover.

items.name: dsh-sidebar-session-provider-icon
items.desc: DeepSeek Harness plugin: show a provider + model icon in the sidebar for every session, updated live from the composer model selector with a last-request fallback for history sessions; aggregator routes render the provider logo with a 10px model logo in the corner.

items.name: dsh-three-window#personal-web
items.desc: Three-window workbench for dsh web: chat, construct, and a read-only review window side by side for each workspace, per-window hooks, and an anonymous multi-model review that asks before it runs, groups findings by issue, and reports in Markdown.

items.name: dsh-composer-stretch
items.desc: Expand button for the DSH Web UI composer — appears at 3+ lines, stretches to near-fullscreen height, auto-collapses on send, and inserts a newline on Enter or Shift+Enter in expanded mode while Cmd/Ctrl+Enter sends.

items.name: dsh-actions
items.desc: Deterministic project actions shared by people and agents: one actions.json, a right-sidebar run panel, and agent tools.

items.name: dsh-capability-panel
items.desc: Manage MCP servers, skills, and tools for your agent — true in-context state (loaded/truncated/evicted) and per-session switches.

items.name: dsh-hero-rightbar
items.desc: Adds the right sidebar's expand trigger on pages with no conversation, matching the product's own control.

items.name: dsh-planner
items.desc: A planner board as a third tab beside chat and trajectory: a Monday-first month calendar above per-day cards holding title, note, times, three importance levels and a completion checkbox. Plans repeat daily, weekly or on weekdays with an optional end date; editing or deleting asks this occurrence versus the whole series; completion is tracked per day; one button clears a day while only skipping recurrent series. Five model tools let the agent read, write, delete, clear and undo plans in conversation.

items.name: dsh-todo-checklist
items.desc: Todo sidecar for DeepSeek Harness: turn selected text into a todo, capture todos from a conversation, review them in a left sidebar panel, get due reminders as an in-app popup or an IM bot message, and export everything to HTML, Markdown, Excel, CSV or JSON.

items.name: dsh-ui-tools
items.desc: Five web UI tools in one plugin: a provider + model two-button selector with reasoning-level control, collapse/expand-all for sidebar workspace groups, a session tab listing the files the session changed (needs kernel 0.1.2-alpha.1+, silently absent on older kernels), a workspace badge next to the session title, and a settings page that toggles them.

items.name: dsh-inline-pastes
items.desc: Inline image chips for the DeepSeek Harness composer — paste an image and it lands in the text as a numbered chip (image-1.png) with hover preview. Images still ship through the official attachment pipeline, names restart per message, the dock and sent-message thumbnails carry a sequence badge, and a pre-send self-check warns when the names in the text no longer match the images in that message.

items.name: dsh-weather
items.desc: Top-centered weather bar for the DSH Web UI: geolocation, current conditions, 12h/7d forecasts and severe-weather notifications via Open-Meteo (free, no API key).

items.name: deepseek-harness-novel-studio
items.desc: Local-first fiction workspace that links outlines, chapters, characters, timelines, writing rules, and continuity checks to the conversation.

items.name: dsh-brand-studio
items.desc: Custom branding for the shared DSH Web UI: a Settings → Branding panel for the name, badge, and local logo/wordmark images with size and rounding, live preview, optional page-title brand, and reset to the official look.

items.name: dsh-guise
items.desc: Persona wardrobe for DeepSeek Harness: save multiple personas, apply them globally or per workspace, with a master switch, an adjustable API balance guard, and a lazy token-loving tired mode that speaks on the agent's behalf when quota runs out. Files-as-config, hot reload, zero dependencies.

items.name: dsh-macos-settings-shortcut
items.desc: Restores Cmd+, to open the existing Settings dialog in DeepSeek Harness on macOS.

items.name: dsh-auto-translate
items.desc: Full-pipeline Chinese translation for the dsh web GUI: live translation of the model reasoning as it streams, in-place Chinese below each English reply, and one-line Chinese summaries for tool outputs and tool-call glosses — a standalone provider request that never enters the session transcript.

items.name: dsh-attach-picker
items.desc: Toolbar picture button in the DSH Web composer: click to pick multiple images through the native file dialog — they join the same draft-image rail as drag-and-drop and paste, with the host image-format, per-message-count and per-image-size limits enforced inline.

items.name: dsh-panellist
items.desc: Panellist manager: reorder the entries on the left rail, rename them, replace their icons, hide them, and fold several into a Group with a flyout menu, from a Settings tab.

items.name: dsh-hotspots
items.desc: Real-time hot topics panel for the DSH web GUI: AI news and engineering news, each item with a distilled summary and the source link, shown from a sidebar entry with three views, keyword/source filters, read-state marking and hotkeys.

items.name: dsh-chat-avatar
items.desc: Adds an avatar to the left of each turn's final AI reply and to the right of each user message; upload your own image and set its size and circle or square frame.

items.name: dsh-ui-translate
items.desc: Translates visible Chinese UI and content in DeepSeek Harness Web, using a browser-local OPUS-MT model for session titles, workspace names, messages, search results, and opted-in plugin prose while keeping remote translation limited to allowlisted UI labels.

items.name: dsh-cli
items.desc: Full-screen terminal TUI for DeepSeek Harness with Web-GUI parity, live streaming, agent presets, and DeepSeek blue styling.

items.name: dsh-mood
items.desc: A tiny behavioral mood ring for AI coding agents — folds session behavior (consecutive failures, repeated calls, activity) into a four-state Mood (GOOD / CONFUSED / FRUSTRATED / OVERWHELMED) shown as a low-friction session-header status light.

items.name: dsh-aseprite
items.desc: A browser pixel-art and sprite animation editor with Aseprite-compatible files, local crop/outline blueprints, and optional LLM workflow nodes.

items.name: dsh-preview-plugin
items.desc: Live preview tab for DSH — embed any dev server in an iframe with transparent SPA proxying.

items.name: dsh-oc-tui
items.desc: An opencode-inspired terminal UI for DeepSeek Harness that boots as a dsh profile app plugin, with a session sidebar, streaming chat, markdown tool cards, todo lists, slash-command suggestions, a telemetry footer with a context meter and inline approval prompts.

items.name: 857-dsh-file-attach
items.desc: Drag or paste files or pictures into the DSH Web composer as one scrolling row of chips, sent as @path references.

items.name: dsh-deepseek-chat-embed
items.desc: Embeds chat.deepseek.com directly inside DeepSeek Harness desktop with persistent login sessions and dual-entry chat panels.

items.name: dsh-mermaid-preview
items.desc: Render Mermaid fenced code blocks as native diagram cards with 8 design-system themes and adaptive layout.

items.name: dsh-theme-colorizer
items.desc: A Deepseek Harness plugin that gives its UI color themes.

items.name: redfox-skill-gallery
items.desc: Adds a sidebar entry that opens a card gallery of all Red Fox Community skills from the redfox-community-dsh plugin.

items.name: dsh-turnbar
items.desc: Video-style turn navigation for the Web UI: full-map progress bar with hover preview cards (tools/files/tokens), drag scrub, ⌘K in-conversation search, ⌘↑/⌘↓ stepping, Esc-return. Event-log powered — works beyond the loaded window. Dual-half plugin on the official composer.dock slot.

items.name: dsh-streamfold
items.desc: Streaming-transcript fold for the DSH web UI: thinking and tool rows fold away while the newest thinking window opens itself; a finished turn scrolls back to your question, which also stays pinned at the top while you read; blue sparks fly from the thinking window edge and the answer writing head.

items.name: dsh-job-progress
items.desc: Live progress for long-running background jobs in the DSH web GUI: a draggable floating ball in the session that owns the job, expanding into a panel with done/total, speed and ETA.

items.name: dsh-loupe
items.desc: Explain a selected word or sentence from a DSH conversation in a floating window: a channel of its own that leaves the session untouched, and the answer can be pinned to a session of its own.

items.name: dshline#dshline
items.desc: Terminal-native TUI frontend for DeepSeek Harness that presents sessions, models, plugins, jobs, subagents, todos, and provider configuration through Harness capabilities while preserving real terminal scrollback.

items.name: dsh-pulse-rail
items.desc: Turns the DSH turn-navigation rail into a music visualiser: each thin bar grows and thickens with its own frequency band, from system audio captured with WASAPI loopback. Geometry only, no colour or glow, and the rail keeps its native hover preview, click-to-jump and wheel scrolling.

items.name: dsh-mobile-adapt
items.desc: Turns the desktop layout into a thumb-friendly one: swipe drawer sidebar with adjustable width, layered back key, bigger tap targets, keyboard avoidance and a 15px font floor.

items.name: dsh-files-to-chat
items.desc: Right-click a file or folder in the right sidebar file tree to add it to the composer as an @ reference (⌘/Ctrl and Shift multi-select insert a whole batch), open it with the default application, or reveal it in the system file manager. Open and reveal go through the built-in open-in-app host capability, so those entries appear unless the host explicitly reports the capability as unsupported.

items.name: dsh-sidebar-panel-buttons
items.desc: Collapses the DSH Web sidebar panel menu (plugins, extensions, scheduled tasks, IM) from a vertical labelled list into a horizontal row of 36×36 icon buttons with hover tooltips; a Settings → General option switches back to the list and is remembered per browser.

items.name: dsh-drag-path
items.desc: Like Codex/Claude Code: drag any file or folder (no format limit) onto the DSH web page and its real absolute path is inserted into the composer instantly — no typing paths by hand. Workspace-first smart lookup, size checks, same-name picker, batch and clipboard paste support, Windows/macOS.

items.name: dsh-ask-in-sidebar
items.desc: Ask a sidebar assistant about selected assistant text: an ephemeral right-side panel answers from a snapshot of the main conversation's LLM history with streaming Markdown, collapsible thinking and multi-turn follow-ups, without touching the main conversation.

items.name: dsh-better-at
items.desc: Fast `@` file/session reference caching for the DSH Web GUI: preloaded indexes, browser-local keystroke filtering and native mention serialization.

items.name: dsh-turn-fold
items.desc: Folds streaming reasoning and tool calls into collapsed step bars and collapses each finished turn into a single summary bar; step bars show native tool icons, filenames, edited line counts, and failure counts, finished turns restore duration, first-token time, token usage, generation speed, and cache hit metrics from recorded Session events, and preferences persist on the Host. Changes browser presentation only. Requires DSH 0.1.5-alpha.1.

items.name: dsh-prompt-optimization-master
items.desc: Adds a button to the composer that rewrites the unsent draft into a clearer, more specific prompt, with one-click restore, a settings page and an optional per-request model override.

items.name: dsh-chinese-poetry
items.desc: Token-free Chinese classical poetry tab in the DSH conversation view with search, filters, 飞花令, daily poem, favorites, festival topics and a share-card image; AI explanation reuses your own DSH session.

items.name: dsh-panda-calendar
items.desc: A conversation-view tab for DeepSeek Harness Web showing solar/lunar dates, ganzhi year/month/day, Chinese zodiac, 24 solar terms, festivals, China public holidays including make-up workdays, multi-city weather, an epoch↔date timestamp converter with a time-zone picker, and bundled offline "on this day" history from free sources without an API key.

items.name: dsh-view-manager
items.desc: View tab manager for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI session header: enable, hide, reorder and rename the conversation view tabs (Chat / Trajectory), with locale-aware zh/en copy and npm update reminders.

items.name: dsh-find-all
items.desc: Search titles and saved text across ordinary DeepSeek Harness (DSH) conversations in all workspaces, optionally including archived chats, with Ctrl+F / Cmd+F search inside the current conversation.

items.name: dsh-ctrl-enter-submit
items.desc: Makes plain Enter insert a newline in the composer and Ctrl/Cmd+Enter submit, toggleable in settings.

items.name: dsh-file-opener
items.desc: Turns file and directory paths in DSH chat into clickable buttons: click one to preview the file in the right sidebar, or open it with the system default application.

items.name: dsh-sidebar-plus
items.desc: A file-view enhancement plugin that extends the official DSH sidebar, providing source view, in-place editing, line number display, search, and font zoom.

items.name: dsh-thinking-quips
items.desc: Personalises the DSH running-turn status line: rotating bilingual quips, a configurable animated loading icon (5 styles x 3 sizes) and one-click matching to the active theme colour, all in a General-settings panel, plus a # Chinese / # English sectioned quips editor. Ships with no dependencies, no build step and no config file.

items.name: chat-share-card
items.desc: Turn any DeepSeek Harness answer into a polished PNG share card: click a button under the reply, the answer is re-typeset on a canvas (8 gradient presets, light/dark, three fonts, width 720/880/1080, radius, padding, font size, line height, 1x-3x export, code wrap/highlight/line numbers, custom title and footer). Fully local rendering — no upload, no third-party dependency.

items.name: dsh-plugin-nickname
items.desc: Custom Chinese nicknames for dsh plugins, displayed directly in the native plugin list.

items.name: better-model-provider
items.desc: Settings page for per-model capabilities: reasoning-effort levels with their wire spellings, input modalities, and token capacities, written as declarations or sparse catalog overrides.

items.name: dsh-power-switch
items.desc: Windows-only process control for the harness: a sidebar button that shuts DSH down through the host's own graceful exit path, an app-window / normal-tab switch on the Plugins card that rewrites the desktop shortcut and restarts, and advanced settings for the wait before exit, the process exit code and a force-quit option.

items.name: dsh-settings-nav-order
items.desc: Reorder the settings panel nav by long-pressing and dragging a section: the dragged row turns translucent and follows the pointer, the order is saved to the plugin's own folder, and uninstalling restores the official order.

items.name: feature-blueprint
items.desc: Adds mind maps and an Excalidraw canvas to the DSH sidebar, with local blueprint-file editing, Excalidraw file previews and standalone CLIs.

items.name: dsh-media-inline-preview
items.desc: All-in-one inline media previewer for mip-img/mip-video/mip-audio fences with streaming playback, ffmpeg transcoding fallback, lightbox, and trust-fenced LAN/mobile access.

items.name: dsh-upload-file
items.desc: Upload any file to DSH, isolated per workspace and session — a composer file library with server-side thumbnails and a context menu to open, copy, re-download or delete.

items.name: dsh-edit-diff
items.desc: Redraws line-level diffs on edit, write, insert and str_replace_editor tool cards — unchanged lines render once and changed characters are underlined — covers run_code (PTC) sub-calls, adds a per-turn changed-files card, and opens or copies any of those paths from the card rows and the tool rows through a host route the plugin serves itself.

items.name: dsh-host-paths
items.desc: Publishes the desktop shell's file-path bridge as the host-path seam the composer reads, so files and folders dropped into the composer become @path references instead of uploaded copies (images still upload through the native image channel).

items.name: dsh-codex-like-markdown
items.desc: In-place Markdown editing for the right-sidebar document preview: a file keeps the shipped renderer's look, clicking a paragraph, heading, list, fence, or table cell puts the caret exactly where you clicked, and only the edited range is written back through ctx.fs.writeText, optionally guarded by the version it read.

items.name: dsh-skills-mcp-group-manager
items.desc: Group installed skills and manage MCP servers from a left-panel UI: filter the model skill catalog by enabled groups (union-deduped) and toggle MCP servers independently.

items.name: dsh-receipt
items.desc: Adds a corner card that estimates how much a session spent repeating a failed or empty tool call with the same arguments.

items.name: dsh-select-translate
items.desc: Select text in any Windows app and read the translation in an always-on-top card next to the cursor: streaming text follows the newest line, up to 15000 characters per request. Windows only.

items.name: dsh-reading-pad
items.desc: Immersive read-only reading panel for DSH — the model delivers pre-formatted Markdown to a native right-sidebar tab via `reading_pad_send`, with three low-blue-light themes and 30em measure typography; also browse manuscript chapters read-only.

items.name: dsh-skill-groups
items.desc: Grouped skill picker for the composer. A button beside the input box opens a panel that browses every installed skill by scene (research, office, data, writing, media, dev), with auto-classification for new skills, Chinese annotations, search and drill-down; picking one inserts the /skill-name gesture.

items.name: dsh-conversation-process-collapse
items.desc: Collapses each settled turn's process rows into one expandable disclosure in the DeepSeek Harness Web conversation while keeping the final answer visible.

items.name: dsh-mcp-plugin
items.desc: Manage DSH MCP servers from the web settings panel: list, add, edit, remove, enable/disable with live status.

items.name: dsh-mermaid-plugin
items.desc: Renders ```mermaid code blocks in DSH Web chat as SVG diagrams, with a diagram/source toggle, light/dark theme following and source-preserving error fallback.

items.name: dsh-workspace-group-plugin
items.desc: Custom sidebar workspace groups for DeepSeek Harness - group directories, drag to regroup and reorder, per-group session browsing and content search, with a one-click fallback to the official workspace list.

items.name: dsh-compact-button
items.desc: Adds a Compact context button and a New session button to the context meter panel; compact submits /compact through the same command channel, and new session starts a fresh session in the same workspace.

items.name: dsh-float-lamp
items.desc: Windows floating status lamp outside the DSH window: a borderless always-on-top glowing orb on a fully transparent background — green with a breathing halo while tasks run, orange shaking for approval, blue floating for your input, dim grey idle, dark grey host offline; hovering lists each session's latest task, drag to move, and the lamp self-extinguishes within seconds when the plugin is switched off.

items.name: dsh-intelligent-ui
items.desc: Renders model answers as interactive cards inside DeepSeek Harness chat, with 24 whitelisted components and persistent turn cards.

items.name: dsh-approval-hotkeys
items.desc: Panel hotkeys for the web UI: Enter presses the confirm action and Esc presses the cancel action on every interaction panel (approval, question, plan review).

items.name: dsh-folder-attach
items.desc: Drag folders into the DeepSeek Harness web composer instead of hitting 'only the desktop app supports folders'. Adds a host folder dialog, /folder, and drag/paste into @path mentions. Plain browser, no desktop app.

items.name: dsh-ui-zoom
items.desc: Ctrl+wheel page zoom (60–180%, remembered) for the whole DSH UI, plus a bottom-right Settings entry that opens the host settings panel, with Ctrl+0 to reset.

items.name: dsh-iconic-launcher
items.desc: Customize the DeepSeek Harness desktop shortcut icon: pick a preset or upload an image, auto-remove the white backdrop, build a multi-size ICO, and write the shortcut in one click.

items.name: dsh-effort-slider
items.desc: Replaces the native DSH reasoning-level option list in place with a draggable Off, Low, High, and Max slider while preserving the official model-selection flow.

items.name: dsh-planchart
items.desc: Publishes a project plan the agent writes: ordered steps in a panel docked to the right of the frame, and the framework graph as an auto-laid-out diagram in its own centre tab, downloadable as SVG or PNG. Charts are rebuilt from the session log, so they survive restart and resume.

items.name: dsh-plugin-liquid-glass
items.desc: A liquid glass UI plugin for the DSH desktop app. Works alongside most wallpaper plugins. Currently supports dark mode only.

items.name: dsh-arabic
items.desc: Bidi-safe RTL rendering for mixed Arabic and English text, a full Arabic interface pack (3,307 strings) registered through the DSH locale service, and three thmanyah cuts — Sans for the interface, Serif Text for reading, Serif Display for headings — placed behind whatever font the app itself is set to.

items.name: dsh-manim-card
items.desc: Adds a manim_card tool that renders Manim Python into a playable animation card in the chat stream; code runs in the browser via a bundled runtime, so no local Python is needed.

items.name: dsh-ui-sound
items.desc: Audible feedback for the DSH web interface: button presses are classified by semantics (normal, primary, toggle, send, close, danger, link) and the current session's task transitions (started, finished, failed) plus any pending interaction play a cue, each scenario with its own cue picker and switch on a settings page. All 78 cues and 12 sound packs are synthesised in the browser with the Web Audio API, so the package ships no audio files and makes no network request. A community port of dsh-plugin-uisfx to DSH 0.2.0, with the ported changes recorded in PROVENANCE.md.

items.name: dsh-next-input
items.desc: Suggests the next user reply in an empty composer after the assistant finishes, using the session model and rolling context summaries, with Tab to accept.

items.name: dsh-bulletin#dsh-bulletin-panel
items.desc: Sidebar panel for the announcement file and the ticket status table. It lists the announcements together with how many sessions have seen each one, shows the delivery status, and lets the user post, edit and delete entries. Requires the third-party dsh-better-sidebar plugin.

items.name: dsh-refresh
items.desc: Make F5, Ctrl+F5, and Ctrl+Shift+R reload the DeepSeek Harness page.

items.name: dsh-workspace-files
items.desc: Browse the directories/files of the workspace in DeepSeek Harness Web GUI and display file changes in conjunction with Git.

items.name: dsh-restart-plugin
items.desc: Adds a sidebar Restart button to DeepSeek Harness Desktop on Windows that stops the whole application process tree and reopens the app.

items.name: dsh-intelligent-ui
items.desc: Interactive cards in replies, built from a fixed catalog of 31 components (sliders, inputs, sortable tables, charts, function plots, typeset formulas, tabs, checklists, flowcharts, quiz buttons, an animation player): controls recompute in the browser without another model call, and the model never writes HTML or JavaScript. Includes a calculus engine (integrals, derivatives, limits, sums, roots, Taylor polynomials) and a bundled skill that teaches the model when to use a card.

items.name: dsh-swarm-panel#dsh-swarm-plugin
items.desc: Conversation Flow observability for DeepSeek Harness swarms, with topology, routed-message inspection, HITL pauses, Live follow, and child-session navigation.

items.name: dsh-mcp-skills-board
items.desc: MCP server and skill management for DeepSeek Harness: a sidebar panel and a plugin-page config section with search, status lights, per-row switches, expandable details, and an add-server form following Codex mcp_servers fields.

items.name: dsh-suggest-prompt
items.desc: After each completed agent turn, a bounded auxiliary LLM call writes one suggested next prompt into the session log; the web composer renders it as ghost placeholder text, adopted via Tab.

items.name: dsh-todo-board
items.desc: Cross-session TODO board as a draggable floating panel: tasks are grouped by working directory and reorderable by drag, each one carries a run mode (remind only, continue in the current session, or open a new session in the same directory), up to four attached images sent to the model as real image attachments, and an optional local time it may run at; two checkboxes track AI-done and user-verified, and the agent picks up the next unfinished task in that directory when it finishes one.

items.name: dsh-always-on-top
items.desc: Adds a pin button to the DSH Desktop title bar that toggles always-on-top for the main window. Windows 10/11 only.

items.name: dsh-selection-toolbar
items.desc: Shows a floating toolbar above text selected in a conversation, with copy, quote, ask, explain, translate, summarize, and custom prompt actions.

items.name: dsh-tab-plan-toggle
items.desc: Tab to toggle plan mode on/off.

items.name: dsh-change-review-live
items.desc: Live change review for DeepSeek Harness: tracks write/edit tool calls per session, lists changed files above the composer and opens each file's line-level diff in a plugin-registered right-sidebar tab, with session-log / initial-version / Git comparison modes, per-change and per-file revert, subagent aggregation and SSE updates. A fork of cirelir/dsh-change-review rebuilt around the right sidebar.

items.name: dsh-plugins#quote-message
items.desc: Quote earlier content of the current session into the composer: select text in any message for a Quote pill, or type @ to pick a whole message; the quote travels as a native reference chip and is serialized into the prompt as a blockquote. Client-only, no host routes, no custom session events.

items.name: dsh-plugin-text-quote
items.desc: Codex-style text annotation for conversations: select text, add a quote with your comment, inject it into the composer, and expand sent annotations as a pill.

items.name: dsh-ui-settings-icons
items.desc: Adds custom icons to the DSH Settings sidebar and exposes a keyed `settings.section.icon` slot for third-party settings sections.

items.name: fsviewer
items.desc: Codex-style right-edge workspace for the dsh web UI: file tree with preview tabs (Markdown/source), an embedded browser (direct/proxy iframe), and a side chat streaming from the host LLM — all as switchable tabs in the native details column.

items.name: dsh-workspace-hide
items.desc: Hide chosen workspaces from the DSH sidebar and archive their sessions along with them, so those sessions never spill into the ungrouped list. Fully local and reversible; with dsh-archive-manager installed the archiving is real and undoable, otherwise it stays a display-only layer. Restore any hidden workspace from Settings.

items.name: dsh-web-search-button
items.desc: Direct web search button and /search slash command plugin for DeepSeek Harness.

items.name: dsh-annotation
items.desc: Adds text selection annotation tools and annotation chips to the dsh web composer.

items.name: dsh-plugin-model-whitelist
items.desc: Tick which models appear in the DSH model selector, and fold provider groups in the settings panel.

items.name: dsh-ricewhale
items.desc: A draggable whale-maid physics widget for the DSH Web UI: throw it around, catch token coins, and eat rice bowls.

items.name: dsh-translate-on-select
items.desc: Select foreign text in a DSH conversation and a Simplified Chinese translation card appears right below the selection.

items.name: dsh-menu
items.desc: Adds a custom right-click context menu to the sidebar workspace files tree, with new folder, rename, reveal in file manager, open in browser, open in VS Code, copy path, streaming ZIP download, and delete.

items.name: dock-flash
items.desc: The dock-base Workbench adapter for the DSH Quick Control panel. The panel core ships separately as `dsh-flash`; this package is what mounts it into dock-base — sidebar/floating panel, activity-bar ⚡, editor view and the dock-flash:openQuickControl command. Requires dock-base; a broken install fails loudly instead of silently doing nothing.

items.name: dsh-flash
items.desc: The Quick Control panel core for DSH Web: a standalone floating shortcut panel whose switches other plugins register through the quickControl service, with the skin system and zh/en i18n. The dock-base Workbench integration ships separately as the dock-flash adapter.

items.name: dsh-branch-workspace-folders
items.desc: Heap-allocated stack-safe fork tree with two-track indentation, title marquee, and physical cascade purge.

items.name: chat-pace
items.desc: Configurable chat auto-scroll — paced section-by-section reading with size-proportional pauses, smooth follow, step and hold modes, hotkeys, and per-session open positions.

items.name: dsh-smooth-cursor-patched
items.desc: Comet-mode animated caret for the DSH Web composer: a glowing trail glides to the text position, with configurable accent color, thickness, trail, and a 500 ms idle blink. Extends the surface to ask-question card inputs, and fixes the caret vanishing on an empty composer or first focus, forward drag-selection not following the pointer, soft line breaks measuring against the previous line, and the caret painting outside the composer when long input scrolls. Maintained fork of Lacquervii/smooth-cursor.

items.name: dsh-wide-stats-footer
items.desc: Un-clamps the composer stats footer: long turn and token stats lines span the full composer width instead of truncating with an ellipsis.

items.name: dsh-chinese-talk
items.desc: Switches every session's thinking and answers to Chinese — terse, a little wry, plain-spoken — while keeping proper nouns in English, and adds an "answer only what was asked" interaction rule. One global system-prompt section (order 10): no UI, no binaries, no network calls. Inactive under the minimal preset, which replaces the whole prompt with its own persona.

items.name: dsh-file-extras
items.desc: Enhances the DSH Web GUI file tree with inline sizes and modification dates, plus a right-click menu for download, upload, and copy-path actions.

items.name: dsh-session-deck
items.desc: Codex-style sidebar: a pinned band for projects and conversations, collapsible 置顶/项目/组件 sections, a bell activity view of recently used conversations, and per-project emoji icons.

items.name: dsh-vscode-workbench
items.desc: VS Code-style local workbench for DSH with a file explorer, Monaco editor, full-text search and a Git panel.

items.name: dsh-close-all-tabs
items.desc: Right-Sidebar tab menu enhancement for DeepSeek Harness: adds a 'Close other tabs' item that closes every content tab of the session except the one whose menu is open and the docked guide.

items.name: dsh-file-mention
items.desc: Session-scoped @file/@folder mentions in the composer with Git-aware indexing, drag-drop and paste managed uploads, and validated path markers.

items.name: dshdesktop-restart-bottom
items.desc: Restart button for DSH Desktop placed directly above the sidebar account button.

items.name: dsh-presets-hidden
items.desc: Browser-side preset visibility and ordering controls for the new-session page.

items.name: dsh-next-prompt
items.desc: After each reply, shows a gray next-prompt suggestion in the empty composer that Tab or → accepts, and ↑ in an empty composer recalls your last sent message; nothing is sent automatically.

items.name: dsh-tui
items.desc: Full-screen terminal client for DeepSeek Harness built on pi-tui: session replay/resume, streaming responses, collapsible tool cards, in-terminal approvals and questions, model/preset/permission/plan/goal management, shell mode, and a trajectory ledger.

items.name: dsh-thinking-bar
items.desc: Replaces the composer's model and reasoning-effort selector with a two-level menu and six slider skins.

items.name: dsh-jot
items.desc: Adds a human-editable notes workspace with folders, full-text search, rich text, checklists, resizable tables, attachments, exports, and opt-in agent collaboration.

items.name: dsh-do
items.desc: One plugin for DeepSeek Harness with durable autonomous loops, sidebar GitHub discovery, AI-assisted installation, and workspace shortcuts.

items.name: dsh-tokmeter
items.desc: Live decode speed (tok/s) pill in the composer status bar that tracks the currently streaming response.

items.name: dsh-quote-followup
items.desc: Quote selected conversation text into the Web composer as native reference chips for focused follow-up turns.

items.name: dsh-model-picker
items.desc: Model picker for the DSH web composer that replaces the model seat: a search-first popup whose left column indexes the suppliers and scrolls the grouped list, with a favorites group pinned at the top, image icons separating native from bridged vision input, and a reasoning-effort panel opened from the right zone of the trigger.

items.name: dsh-recent
items.desc: Adds a 最近 (Recent) section below the workspace list in the DSH web sidebar that flattens the newest sessions of every workspace into one timeline, reusing the session rows and hover cards the shell already renders, paging in earlier sessions as you scroll, and folding the workspace list itself to the five folders with the newest history. Requires DSH ^0.2.0-rc.1.

items.name: dsh-plugin-meow-speech
items.desc: Display-layer text replacement for DSH chat messages: rewrite how any configured text appears on screen without touching the real conversation, with per-rule whole-word matching and code-block protection.

items.name: dsh-word-complete
items.desc: Word auto-completion in the Web composer: prefix-matched suggestions sorted by closeness, arrow-key selection and Enter to confirm.

items.name: dsh-peak-badge
items.desc: A chip at the left end of the composer tool row showing whether DeepSeek bills at peak or off-peak right now. Clicking it opens a card with the current state and rate, the next switch with a countdown, and why this instant is in that state: a weekend, a named statutory holiday, a 调休 make-up workday, or simply outside the peak windows. Times are resolved in Beijing time with an explicit UTC offset, so the verdict does not depend on the machine clock; a hard-coded 2026 Chinese holiday table carries the 33 holiday days and the six 调休 workdays, and a year beyond the table says so instead of guessing.

items.name: dsh-open-folder
items.desc: Adds an "Open folder" item to the session-row ⋯ menu in the DSH workspace sidebar, opening the session's workspace folder with the host OS file manager.

items.name: dsh-valley-meter
items.desc: Peak-Valley Meter (峰谷电表) — a tiny DeepSeek usage companion: a minimal two-part balance chip above the composer (currency symbol + number, nothing else), official balance refreshed every 5s; click the symbol to open the official top-up page in a new tab; hovering the chip fades in a circular backdrop under the symbol, its left arc flush with the chip's own left edge, and expands a 24h peak/valley timeline (orange=peak, blue=valley, glowing marker at the current local time) so off-peak hours are obvious; independent today-spend metering; a settings panel with 10 muted color presets plus custom valley/peak colors, detailed/minimal styles and readout toggles; all-Chinese UI.

items.name: dsh-conversation-jump
items.desc: A rail of four circular buttons in the DSH Web conversation that step to the previous or next user message, or to the top or bottom, paging older history in automatically.

items.name: dsh-plugin-operation-log
items.desc: A right-sidebar session panel that lists every Skill, MCP tool call and file read or write by turn and step, with per-failure error detail.

items.name: dsh-think-translate
items.desc: Display-layer translation for the DSH Web UI — thinking chains, task cards and answers in 8 target languages via local Ollama or Google/Bing, originals preserved.

items.name: dsh-dock
items.desc: Windows desktop launcher for DeepSeek Harness: a one-click whale icon plus a sidebar More menu with Settings / Restart-Refresh / graceful Full Exit, and a scrollable multi-DSH picker on the cold-start card.

items.name: dsh-balance-card
items.desc: Shows the API balance of the provider behind the current model as a dsh Web sidebar card, with per-package progress bars, currency/credit-aware units, a settings tab, and subscription and credit quota monitoring.

items.name: dsh-hover-sidebar
items.desc: Hover to reveal and leave to hide the left sidebar on Windows desktop and Web, with manual pinning, configurable delays and reduced-motion support.

items.name: dsh-plugin-layout-organizer
items.desc: Drag-and-drop reordering, official/third-party dividers and a stash panel for the buttons DSH renders in the sidebar, the sidebar footer, the conversation tabs, the composer dock and Settings. Only display position changes; the plugin registry is untouched.

items.name: dsh-web-relay
items.desc: Three-party collaboration protocol for dsh: Step List state machine, five-tier review chain (Gemini/web/Claude Code/dialog/manual), alternatives adjudication, cross-restart resume with heartbeat, and capability persistence.

items.name: dsh-clearview
items.desc: Adds a Reading tab to the DSH web client that shows process steps and live reasoning in source order, collapses successful turns to the final answer, and keeps the original tabs, composer, and tooling intact.

items.name: dsh-pancha
items.desc: Disk review canvas: agent-written semantics, human decisions, previewed cleanup with undo.

items.name: dsh-gemini-kitten-widget
items.desc: A Gemini kitten widget for the DSH Web UI: live Google Gemini API free-tier quota per model, a model switcher, color-coded warnings, drag-to-snap, and click-to-change lines.

items.name: dsh-tool-highlight
items.desc: Layered syntax highlighting for bash/pwsh command and read code output in the DSH web GUI (VS Code Dark+ palette: keywords/strings/numbers/functions/comments each get a color); colors only what it recognizes, keeps tables/logs plain; pure frontend, zero token overhead.

items.name: dsh-quick-ask
items.desc: ChatGPT-style side chat for the DSH Web GUI: ask small questions about the current topic in a floating side panel, answered by an independent lightweight session over the official /api RPC — the main conversation is never touched. Streaming text, collapsible reasoning, tool chips, stop button, agent-preset selector, and an automatic context snapshot from the visible main chat.

items.name: dsh-glass-weather
items.desc: Glass weather pill in the session header with 23 weather states, each with its own tint, SVG icon and canvas particle layer, per-field visibility switches, and a get_weather tool backed by keyless Open-Meteo data.

items.name: dsh-xia-plugins#packages/client-gameassist-knowledge
items.desc: Knowledge-base browser panel: tree browsing plus drag-to-cite (path-only or full content) into the composer.

items.name: dsh-web-icon-indicator
items.desc: Browser tab favicon mirrors the DSH session state (idle / running / asking / done), recolored and animated from one base SVG entirely in the browser, with colors and effects configurable from the Settings page.

items.name: dsh-ide-vscode
items.desc: Workspace file tree and code editor in the DSH right sidebar: browse the workspace of the session it belongs to, create, rename and delete files and folders (to a trash folder by default), edit in place with line numbers and syntax highlighting (Ctrl+S saves, Ctrl+D duplicates the current line), preview images and play audio or video, list and unpack archives or pack a folder into a .zip through the system tar, search by file name or jump by a pasted path, and draw file rows with the icons Windows itself uses (SHGetFileInfo, Windows only).

items.name: dsh-pintop
items.desc: Provides an always-on-top window feature for the DSH window, preventing it from being hidden unexpectedly, Windows only; requires PowerShell 7 (pwsh.exe) on PATH.

items.name: dsh-sidebar-icon-row
items.desc: Turns the DeepSeek Harness sidebar panel entries and footer entries into one row of icon-only squares with hover names, adds four icon-size presets, per-entry show/hide switches and up/down ordering, and puts a Settings shortcut in the footer row.

items.name: dsh-scratchpad
items.desc: Quick temporary conversation and workspace manager for DeepSeek Harness Web GUI.

items.name: dsh-dashboard
items.desc: Usage dashboard: offline-scans session logs to chart daily/weekly/monthly tokens, estimated costs, model/tool/skill/command leaderboards, output speed, working hours and quality metrics; gridstack+ECharts cards are drag-and-drop composable, with custom formulas and AI arrangement (prompt round-trip import).

items.name: dsh-settings-ui
items.desc: Customizes the native settings window: preset or custom window sizes, fullscreen, background transparency, and theme, solid-color, or image backgrounds, with a floating ball for quick access; saved in the local browser.

items.name: dsh-conversation-density-map
items.desc: Adds a non-uniform conversation density map(chat history markers) to the right of the DSH chat area: one tick per turn, with tick length and spacing reflecting message size, clickable to jump to a turn and expanding on hover when crowded.

items.name: dshswitch
items.desc: Adds customizable switch shortcut buttons to the left of the DSH Web GUI chat input for one-click slash-command insertion.

items.name: dsh-prompt-history
items.desc: Claude Code-style prompt history, double-Esc picker, selection quote/copy & right-click paste.

items.name: dsh-message-injector
items.desc: Presets message-injection content combos and auto-injects them into every message.

items.name: dsh-status-bar#dsh-status-bar
items.desc: Floating glass status bar for DSH on Windows 11 x64: an always-on-top capsule that mirrors session progress, the current step and pending approvals from a local DSH web profile, with peek and detail views; approval cards stay read-only until DSH returns its own decision receipt, and connecting to the official Desktop app is experimental and unverified.

items.name: dsh-session-eva-status
items.desc: Colors DSH sidebar Session rows by their official status, in an Evangelion-flavored palette: a blue left rail for a row awaiting interaction, red for the session open in the main view, purple for finished-but-unviewed, and a static rainbow title for pinned rows. Every colour is mode-scoped — dark keeps the vivid stop, light takes a darker variant solved to clear 4.5:1 against the light wall — and the split reads DSH's own dark marker. Reads official Client services only: it owns no state, never polls, and ships no host-side half.

items.name: dsh-mcp-servers-panel
items.desc: MCP server management panel in Settings: add, edit, enable/disable and delete servers across user and workspace scopes with form or JSON editing, and auto-register discovered MCP tools as native conversation tools.

items.name: dsh-terminal-button
items.desc: Embedded terminal for DeepSeek Harness: opens an in-app terminal panel in the right sidebar (DockKit) or bottom composer dock, with PSReadLine geometry protection and full theme sync.

items.name: dsh-media-web-preview
items.desc: Plays video and audio files in the right Sidebar preview pane, streamed over an authenticated HTTP Range route so a remote browser can play and seek a large file without launching a native player on the Host.

items.name: dsh-mobile-sidebar
items.desc: Below 1024px the sidebar leaves the shell frame entirely and is opened as an overlay drawer from a header button, so the conversation gets the full viewport width; wider layouts are untouched.

items.name: dsh-quick-workspace
items.desc: Replaces the host-side folder chooser in the Add workspace flow with a name dialog, so a remote browser can create and open a workspace instead of an OS dialog appearing on the Host screen.

items.name: dsh-zh-hant
items.desc: Adds a Traditional Chinese (zh-Hant) language to the web GUI, registered through the locale service with one dictionary per namespace and selectable in Settings, General, Language.

items.name: dsh-paste-spill
items.desc: Folds each 4-50 KB paste in the DSH composer into its own chip (expand or delete it individually), and turns a paste of 50 KB or more into a real file attachment. Declares DSH >=0.1.7-rc.2 <0.3.0-0, so it stays visible on the 0.2 release line.

items.name: dsh-recent-tasks
items.desc: An always-last, collapsible Recent tasks workspace group in the DSH sidebar: a sidebar entry and the Mod+Alt+N / Mod+Shift+N shortcut start a chat in a dedicated folder, so it lands in that group instead of 未分组. The group is a genuine workspace record rather than a plugin-drawn look-alike, so collapse, rename, search and drag order behave normally, and its folder, group name, pin-last and auto-repair are live settings.

items.name: dsh-temp-chat
items.desc: Floating translucent DeepSeek whale elf on the DSH page that opens a draggable, minimizable temporary chat window using the session model or a custom OpenAI-compatible endpoint, with real-time streaming.

items.name: dsh-minimal-ui-panels
items.desc: Four right-Sidebar panels for the dsh web client: artifacts, long-term memory, terminal and notes. They pair two per tab with a draggable split, so two panes show all four at once. The host half ships nine memory_* tools, artifacts_list, the /memory command, and the /api/artifacts/* and /api/terminal-notes/* routes. The terminal runs one bash command per line, with a default 120-second deadline and a stop button. Requires dsh 0.1.5 or newer, and 0.2.

items.name: dsh-prompt-optimizer
items.desc: A prompt optimizer in the composer input tool row: pick a category and a template, then ✨ rewrites the draft in place with one-click undo. Pick from the Basic, Context and Image categories; you can cancel a run, and it shows elapsed time and token usage. Ships 15 templates covering task-instruction rewriting, step planning, safety-research framing, system-prompt role cards, and text-to-image / image-to-image prompts; context templates read the recent turns of the session for coreference resolution. Calls go through the host model service, and a settings section exposes the model and the budgets. Output guards check that user-written constraints survive, warning rather than auto-retrying. Adapted for dsh 0.1.7 and 0.2.

items.name: dsh-code-studio
items.desc: File-change monitor and code editor for the DSH Web UI. Agent edits appear beside your conversation as real-time line-by-line diffs, with a syntax-highlighted editor, one-click revert, change history, workspace switcher, and per-session isolation.

items.name: dsh-deep-verbs
items.desc: Rotates the model status line through a 53-phrase English/Chinese deep-theme pool: a random pick at turn start, event-driven switching on new thinking segments or tool calls (3s throttle), and a click on the status line toggles the language.

items.name: deepseek-balance-whale-widget-bowl
items.desc: A fixed-corner DeepSeek balance whale widget for the DSH web GUI: three switchable skins (default / bowl-on-head / bowl-in-hand), balance with today usage, per-turn cost popups, peak/off-peak price conversion, press sound effects and random talk lines. Modified from MeteorNOX/DeepSeek-Balance-Whale-Widget.

items.name: dsh-codinput
items.desc: Replaces the chat composer with an editor-style input panel on CodeMirror 6: line numbers, edit + markdown-preview split, a floating window mode and a full-height sidebar tab — one input surface at a time. Drafts ride the official input machine; the official voice-input button is rendered when the host provides one, and the stats row and context meter read the same data as the official dock.

items.name: dsh-prompt-enhance
items.desc: Sparkle button immediately left of the model selector that rewrites the composer draft into an executable prompt in place, modelled on WorkBuddy: the host calls the conversation LLM with a prompt-engineering system prompt, multi-level undo keeps up to 8 previous drafts, and a token-level diff card shows added and removed spans, the number of changed spots and the net character delta. Runs on the session model, is disabled while the draft is empty, and keeps the browser-session cookie fence in front of the LLM call.

items.name: dsh-dock-launcher#dsh-dock-bridge
items.desc: Publishes the running dsh Web server's PID, port and tokenized URL to a runtime file for the DeepSeek Harness Switch Dock app, and removes it on shutdown.

items.name: dsh-sidebar-focus
items.desc: Orders and folds the DSH left sidebar by what is actually running — a workspace floats to the top when one of its sessions starts and keeps that place when the session finishes, only the N most recently active workspaces stay expanded, and six switches plus one count control each rule.

items.name: dsh-attachments
items.desc: Adds file and folder drag-and-drop attachments to the Web UI, with composer cards, persistent history, and workspace-backed paths.

items.name: dsh-btw
items.desc: Interactive Side-Assistant Dock to ask quick side questions via /btw with real-time thinking status and history pagination without interrupting the active agent loop.

items.name: dsh-prompt-optimizer
items.desc: Adds an icon button to the composer that optimizes the current draft prompt through the active model.

items.name: dsh-utility-plugins#dsh-skill-cheatsheet
items.desc: Composer button that opens a panel listing every skill available to the current session with Chinese titles, purposes and usage examples, and lets you catalogue newly installed skills in one click (saved locally).

items.name: dsh-desktop-tray
items.desc: Adds a system tray icon to DSH Desktop, with settings to hide the main window to the tray on minimize or close and self-healing after app updates.

items.name: dsh-refresh
items.desc: Adds a refresh button to the sidebar footer that reloads the plugin list and the page so newly installed plugins take effect without restarting the desktop app.

items.name: ncm-player
items.desc: Floating NetEase Cloud Music player for DSH Web: draggable collapsible window with mini mode, playlist discovery with search and hot lists, synced lyrics with translations, persistent playback queue, QR-code or Cookie login, colors following the DSH skin theme.

items.name: dsh-composer-recall
items.desc: Arrow-key input history for DSH 0.1.2-alpha.1: press ↑ in an empty composer to recall this session's prompts, ↓ to go forward, Esc to restore the draft.

items.name: dsh-diff-card
items.desc: Per-turn file-change card for DSH Desktop: +N −M badges, aligned diffs, and Mac/Windows file open (system app, Finder/Explorer, VS Code).

items.name: dsh-reasoning-slider
items.desc: Adds a model-aware reasoning effort slider with native and animated modes, light and dark palettes, and shared or per-model colors.

items.name: dsh-step-clock
items.desc: Shows the running agent step above the web composer as a Chinese sentence: its step number, the tools it is running, and how long it has been going. A finished step keeps its duration on screen until the next one starts, so a slow step can be identified after the fact.

items.name: dsh-plugins#dsh-turn-scrubber
items.desc: Compact right-edge turn rail with hover summaries and click-to-jump navigation. Ships on npm as `dsh-turn-scrubber`.

items.name: dsh-file-attachment
items.desc: Drag-and-drop / paste / upload files and images; on non-multimodal models images are auto-described by a configured VLM.

items.name: dsh-vocab-study
items.desc: Offline vocabulary panel: a capsule beside the composer opens a word card, and a dockable tabbed panel tracks today, progress, the mistake book and settings.

items.name: dsh-side-branch
items.desc: Read-only side branch in the right sidebar: quote text to ask follow-ups without polluting the model context of the main session; every follow-up rebuilds the branch from the latest settled turns of the main session, and writes are refused at the tool-execution layer so the prompt prefix stays cacheable.

items.name: dsh-enter-using
items.desc: Codex-style keyboard answers for the pending command-approval panel — 1 allows once, 2 rejects, Enter confirms the highlighted choice, arrow keys move it, and Esc rejects, with the buttons still usable by mouse.

items.name: dsh-open-artifacts
items.desc: Adds an action to the session menu and the session title bar that opens the artifacts folder of that conversation: it reads the session log, works out which directories the conversation wrote files to, and opens them in Explorer.

items.name: dsh-clipboard-menu
items.desc: Adds a right-click menu to DeepSeek Harness inside desktop shells that ship no context menu: cut, copy, paste and select all in the composer, copy and copy-as-plain-text on selected text elsewhere, and a search entry that opens the default browser with a configurable engine.

items.name: dsh-phone#client
items.desc: iPhone-style agent phone: dual-panel calls & SMS, RCS group chat with trust gates, cross-device agent messaging via the registry inbox bridge, L0–L4 trust badges and evidence audit.
