Experimental: trust summaries are not a security guarantee, and SMS/signalling is relayed through the operator's inbox (visible to them); E2E encryption is planned.

items.name: dsh-role-cards
items.desc: Replaces the new-session hero with a combined picker: role cards for the agent presets and a workspace card, collapsed into capsule buttons that expand into two scrollable rows.

items.name: dsh-hover-approve
items.desc: Anchors an approve/answer bubble to each DSH Web sidebar session row — one-click handling of authorization, questions, plan reviews and blocked goals without opening the conversation.

items.name: dsh-notebook
items.desc: Sidebar notebook with titled notes and inline images (videos rejected); click a title to copy its body to the clipboard, reference a note in the composer with @, and optionally open the notebook for every new session.

items.name: dsh-minimal-transcript
items.desc: Minimal DSH Web transcript toggle: hide thinking, tool-call, and turn-process rows from the session header while preserving assistant answer text.

items.name: dsh-task-capsule
items.desc: Session-header task capsule with color-coded run states, click-to-jump and a multi-task dropdown, plus task notification cards (done / error / waiting-for-confirmation) with synthesized sound and optional system notifications.

items.name: dsh-sdd-progress-xc
items.desc: SDD task progress (todos) and progress ledger (sdd/progress.md) as a right-sidebar tab bound to the current session, rendered with the official MarkdownText, auto-refresh every 5s.

items.name: dsh-file-link-menu
items.desc: Adds a right-click menu on file references in chat output, listing registered applications with icons for open-with, revealing files in the file manager, and copying absolute or relative paths resolved against the session workspace, while code blocks, plain text and external links keep the native menu.

items.name: openquantum#openquantum-web-branding
items.desc: Applies OpenQuantum branding, browser metadata, and PWA assets to the native DeepSeek Harness web UI.

items.name: dsh-turn-nav
items.desc: Turn histogram navigation rail for DeepSeek Harness Web with mixed, DeepSeek, and Codex visual variants.

items.name: dsh-composer-launcher
items.desc: A launcher panel for DSH: manages the capability composer, the plugin inventory and the MCP bridge, and walks you through installing the browser tab-bridge extension.

items.name: dsh-quick-phrases
items.desc: Adds a draggable, position-persisted chip bar of configurable quick phrases to DeepSeek Harness, plus a /-triggered phrase menu with per-phrase pin, slash-menu, bar-visibility, and click-to-send toggles.

items.name: dsh-prompt-history
items.desc: Terminal-style composer for the DSH web GUI: shell prompt history (↑/↓, prefix search, Ctrl+R), Codex-style completion and next-prompt prediction (Tab or → to accept), selection toolbar (copy / quote / ask in side chat), right-click paste, draggable chat TOC, and a parallel side-chat thread in the right sidebar.

items.name: dsh-media-preview
items.desc: Renders local audio/video paths as inline, playable previews in DSH chat: replaces paths with <audio>/<video> players backed by same-origin /api/media-preview/* route, with explicit error statuses.

items.name: dsh-user-question-nav
items.desc: ChatGPT-style question nav rail with up/down arrow buttons — per-question tick marks on the chat edge, hover-triggered drawer listing every user question with real-time search filter, one-click smooth-scroll jump, and active-question highlight synced to scroll position.

items.name: dsh-improved-inline-edit
items.desc: A mid-run steer input for DeepSeek Harness Web: while the agent works, an input bar appears above the composer to inject modification requests into the next decision via agent.steer(), without stopping the conversation. Drafts persist per session, unread injected messages can be recalled from the bubble, and an optional guiding prefix is supported.

items.name: dsh-peak-status
items.desc: Header chip for the DSH web GUI that shows whether the current Beijing time is inside DeepSeek's API peak window, with a live clock and countdown to the next transition.

items.name: dsh-showreel
items.desc: Turns the latest completed DSH session turn into a shareable vertical recap video: editable five-scene storyboard, host-side privacy redaction, optional AI polish and TTS narration, MP4/WebM export with PNG cover.

items.name: dsh-prompt-enhance
items.desc: Adds an enhancement chip to the composer input action row, left of the model selector: it rewrites the draft in place using the model already selected in the session, in five styles, with one-click undo and an /enhance slash command.

items.name: agent-trees
items.desc: Live multi-way tree of the current session's agents in the DeepSeek Harness conversation view and right sidebar, with status, plan progress, tokens, cost (requires dsh-cost-meter), and runtime on every card.

items.name: dsh-prompt-enhancer
items.desc: Adds a prompt enhancement button to the composer toolbar that rewrites the draft through a model call, keeps @file references verbatim, and offers one-click undo.

items.name: dsh canvas
items.desc: A persistent shared canvas for DSH Web and its agent, with a browser UI and tools to organize media, nodes, and connections.

items.name: dsh-ui-tools
items.desc: Developer tools panel for the DSH web UI: file browser with preview, edit, and path-only file mentions; multi-tab terminals with quick commands; Git panel with commit, push, pull, and branch switching; and background job management. UI ported from pi-web-ui.

items.name: dsh-open-workspace
items.desc: Adds Open workspace entries to the sidebar session-row menu and the session header actions slot, opening the session workspace folder in the system file manager.

items.name: dsh-zh-labels
items.desc: Re-applies Chinese UI labels to the DSH client modules on every start, so translations survive upgrades.

items.name: dsh-better-session-title
items.desc: Replaces the session topbar title with a workspace and session breadcrumb, switching workspaces, sessions and subagents from dropdowns in the topbar.

items.name: xy-dsh#xy-dsh-lamp
items.desc: Always-on-top lamp board for macOS: one lamp per agent, one row per session, collapsing to one lamp per running task; a lamp turns blue and blinks while an approval or a question is waiting on you, and the root agent finishing raises a system notification.

items.name: xy-dsh#xy-dsh-question-nav
items.desc: Keeps the question you are currently on pinned above the composer, with a dropdown of every earlier question that scrolls the conversation back to that turn; questions folded into process groups are expanded first, and Escape, scrolling or clicking outside collapses the panel.

items.name: dsh-gpt-niang-widget
items.desc: A GPT/ChatGPT-persona desktop pet pinned to the bottom-right corner of the DSH web GUI — shows balance, today's usage, peak/off-peak pricing and per-turn cost, with editable bubbles (text, balance, usage, pricing, images, random lines and weighted choices), per-line styles and fonts, a floating quick editor, sound effects, custom character art/animation/audio, and snapping/flipping. 54 GPT-flavored lines across five groups. Its routes, bundle id and data files are namespaced so it can run alongside the whale and Xiaoke widgets. A derivative of MeteorNOX/DeepSeek-Balance-Whale-Widget (MIT).

items.name: dsh-input-optimizer
items.desc: Rewrites the draft in the DSH composer into a clearer, more executable prompt through the harness's own LLM routes, showing an original/optimized comparison before you adopt it.

items.name: dsh-goal-mode-enhance
items.desc: Visual goal lifecycle for the DSH web UI: a composer dock to create, multiline-edit, pause, resume, complete and clear session goals with live round progress, plus a phase-dot composer entry and a settings-page goal overview.

items.name: dsh-side-chat
items.desc: Native side-by-side chat beside the main conversation: an independent archived DSH session with full native UI, on-demand parent-context retrieval, selection quoting, and a keep-or-delete lifecycle.

items.name: dsh-session-theme
items.desc: Shows every session theme in the DSH Web left sidebar immediately on page load by warming the session projection cache at startup; no need to click into a conversation first.

items.name: dsh-xmlans
items.desc: Desktop pet for DSH: 兰酱, an angel-winged maid in a transparent always-on-top window who reacts to session states (thinking, working, waiting, done, error), shows task progress and DeepSeek balance, and responds to drags, head pats, pokes and wing touches.

items.name: dsh-better-right-click
items.desc: Better Right-Click: right-click menu on file references in the DSH transcript. Copies the absolute path, reveals the file selected in Explorer by reusing and focusing an existing window, and lists every app registered for that file type so you can open it with the one you want. Menu labels follow the DSH display language (Chinese and English). Windows only (Explorer reveal and the registered-apps list use PowerShell).

items.name: dsh-pi-tui
items.desc: Third-party TUI mode for DeepSeek Harness (dsh --profile pi-tui), built on a vendored pi-tui fork: covers the main session loop plus approvals, commands, session switching and full-text search, as well as presets, skills, model/settings menus and slash commands.

items.name: dsh-client-ui-sidebar-perfmon
items.desc: Host performance monitor in the right Sidebar: CPU, memory and swap gauges, a GPU clock and VRAM bar, CPU / GPU / motherboard / drive temperatures, and a process table sortable by CPU, memory or name.

items.name: dsh-sidebar-enhancement
items.desc: Enhanced right-sidebar files panel: rename, create, upload, download (a directory is zipped on the fly), copy the full path and delete from the tree; an editable document renderer for 128 text extensions with Ctrl/Cmd+S save and conflict detection; plus an independent bottom terminal panel with tabs and a quick-command library persisted under the DSH home.

items.name: dsh-xswt-tauriapp#dsh-desktop-app
items.desc: Installer entry for the dsh-xswt-tauriapp desktop shell, a Tauri desktop shell for DeepSeek Harness: on the first dsh start after installation it downloads this platform's installer from the release, checks it against the release SHA256SUMS before writing it, and opens it with the system installer. It installs nothing itself and adds no UI to dsh.

items.name: dsh-message-edit
items.desc: Inline user message editor: adds a pencil edit button next to Copy below sent user bubbles, switches the bubble in-place into a rounded editor card, and resends via session branch fork or in-session follow-up.

items.name: dsh-selection-quote
items.desc: Cursor and GitHub PR Review style selection toolbar: quote selected text to chat (Cmd+L), write inline comments (Shift+Cmd+L), and batch-insert from a composer dock.

items.name: dsh-plugin-stock-x
items.desc: Financial quantitative workbench and stock ticker: floating ball and drawer panel, real-time A/HK/US/global market quotes, multi-period K-lines and 5-day intraday charts, depth order book, capital flow, sector heat map, and AI investment research.

items.name: dsh-boot-video
items.desc: Full-screen video boot splash — play an mp4 at startup, skip with a click, import your own clip, and non-playable codecs are transcoded to H.264 automatically.

items.name: dsh-diff-review
items.desc: Session change-review for DeepSeek Harness: tracks write/edit tool calls and renders VS Code-style side-by-side diffs via diff2html, auto-following the theme, with subagent aggregation and one-click revert.

items.name: dsh-draft-keeper
items.desc: Keeps the images you pasted or attached in the composer, per session: they are mirrored locally in the browser and handed back through the official draft channel when you return to the conversation or the composer remounts, and dropped as soon as the message is sent or you remove them.

items.name: dsh-picflow
items.desc: Pasted screenshots become numbered references: each Ctrl+V image is stored in the attachment library under a stable number, listed in a composer-dock thumbnail panel with an image source in the @ menu, and inserted as a reference chip at the caret — automatically after paste when the auto-insert switch is on.

items.name: dsh-xwide-annotation
items.desc: Select text in a conversation to attach a numbered highlight with a colour stored per note, keep every mark in an outline panel that jumps back to its quote, and let a corner self-check badge report style, selector and saved-key problems without opening dev tools.

items.name: dsh-input-optimizer
items.desc: Adds a four-pointed-star button left of the composer's model selector that rewrites the unsent draft in place — grammar, wording, punctuation and execution order — preserving code, commands, paths, identifiers, numbers and URLs byte-for-byte, answering nothing and never overwriting text typed while it runs. A pencil under every user message reopens that message for editing without touching the draft; because the Harness session log is append-only, an edit forks the conversation before that message rather than rewriting it. A circular restart icon under every reply asks that one question again in a fresh conversation that carries none of the earlier turns. Both are refused while a turn is still answering, and disabled when the reply used a tool that can leave a trace or when the files the message named have since changed. A right-sidebar memory tree draws the conversation as turns, showing what was actually asked and answered, every answer to one question on its own line labelled original, edited or memory-free, newest first, with arrows that re-read an answer in place; right-clicking jumps to a branch or removes it from the plugin's own history.

items.name: dsh-prompt-for-me
items.desc: Adds a composer button that optimizes the current prompt or designs the next one from the current session and project context.

items.name: deepseekharness-mcp-manager
items.desc: MCP server manager for DeepSeek Harness: add, edit, enable/disable, restart and delete MCP servers from Settings → MCP 管理, with JSON export/import, four mcp_manager_* model tools and an HTTP API; install via npx, npm or cross-platform scripts.

items.name: dsh-conversation-map
items.desc: A live conversation map for DeepSeek Harness web: real-time session tree with subagent lineage, running state, and one-click navigation.

items.name: dsh-prompt-optimizer
items.desc: Adds an optimize button beside the composer that analyzes and rewrites the prompt draft with SSE streaming, conversation-context awareness (template vs intent-polish strategies), an edit-continuity memory chain, undo, and model routing with fallback and a connectivity test.

items.name: dsh-knj-menu
items.desc: Third-party menu manager for the DSH Web UI: collects new menu entries added by other plugins into one place, with fold/collapse and pinned menu items.

items.name: dsh-knj-prompts
items.desc: Prompt scene picker for DSH: choose a scene from a dropdown and it opens a new session with the prompt already filled in (with {variable} placeholders), so you only tweak and send.

items.name: dsh-erii-boot-splash
items.desc: Erii (Sakura) themed boot splash animation — falling sakura petals, a mint monster mascot with a blossom on its head, and a soft pink progress bar; fades out after ~3 seconds without blocking input.

items.name: dsh-plugin-chat-zoom
items.desc: Zoom only DSH chat messages and input (80%–200%) using Ctrl shortcuts or settings, with local memory and no sidebar scaling.

items.name: dsh-editor
items.desc: VS Code-style code editor: sidebar file tree over the workspace, Monaco editing, file read/write, Git status and diff, search, and Markdown preview.

items.name: dsh-550c-boot
items.desc: Full-screen 550C boot intro for DSH: a 4-second simple cut and a 16-second rewrite sequence, skippable by click or Esc, with four phosphor palettes. The host half injects the opening frame while the document is still parsing, so the built-in loading card never shows; the desktop caption strip turns transparent, so those window buttons float on the animation.

items.name: dsh-about
items.desc: About section for the DeepSeek Harness settings: version info, npm latest/next update check with one-click install and auto-restart, and GitHub release history.

items.name: dsh-prompt-enhancer
items.desc: Prompt enhancement for the composer: an "✨ Enhance" button rewrites your draft prompt into a clearer, more structured version with first-principles thinking, grounded in session context, memory and recent conversation; asks clarifying questions in a card when key info is missing, then previews the result before applying it to the input.

items.name: dsh-plugins#dsh-focus-composer
items.desc: Returns the caret to the session composer on Ctrl+I; the key is rebindable in Settings and works from any region of the desktop window.

items.name: coderdd#dsh-rdd-goal-tree
items.desc: Read-only goal-tree status strip above the composer: planners see the full node tree, workers see their claimed node, and worker reports call back to the planner session.

items.name: dsh-agent-grid
items.desc: Replaces the DSH sidebar with a fixed 2×4 board of eight standing agent seats; each seat shows its own status, latest tool call, reasoning and result, and a settings switch restores the stock sidebar at any time.

items.name: dsh-split-screen
items.desc: Split-screen workspace for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI - chat with several agents side by side in panes that look and behave exactly like the stock conversation: drag-to-split, live sessions with queued messages and in-pane ask_user/approval cards, per-pane view tabs (Chat/Trajectory/plugin views), a compact TUI composer mode (Alt+T) and pane-focus shortcuts. Requires DSH 0.1.5+.

items.name: dsh-full-view
items.desc: Keeps the current chat in a movable, resizable floating window when the right file or browser panel enters full view, with a compact input bar, a whale restore button and a return to the original split layout.

items.name: dsh-recent-sessions
items.desc: Opens the recent sessions in a sheet that floats over the sidebar workspace list, from one row above Settings: rows sorted by last activity with their run state, a draggable height, and a list that settles onto whole rows after stopping. The sheet paints no surface of its own, so it reads as part of the sidebar.

items.name: dsh-selection-explain
items.desc: Select text in the DSH web UI to stream a translation and an explanation of what it means in that specific context, read against the conversation it came from; the panel keeps a replayable history and can be promoted into a full session.

items.name: dsh-think-flow
items.desc: Chain-of-thought panel for the DSH Web right sidebar: folds the live reasoning stream of each session into turn → step groups carrying the reasoning text and the tool calls made in that step. Only the newest turn is expanded by default and earlier turns collapse to one line; steps are grouped into activity phases by a local rule, the step waiting on a tool is marked, tool failures show their reason, full reasoning text is fetched per step on demand, an all-turn directory searches turn titles, user text and turn numbers locally, and a whole turn can be summarised into a Chinese title with one model call.

items.name: dsh-prompt-market
items.desc: Prompt market beside the composer: browse and search three built-in online prompt sources, bookmark or write your own, and insert into the input box.

items.name: dsh-claude-slider
items.desc: Replaces the reasoning-effort dropdown with a draggable snapping slider, and draws 13 canvas effects across five style families (thrust, fluid, fantasy, tech, texture) with three tiers that unlock as the effort level rises. Custom mode combines 10 particle forms with 8 flow trajectories; 9 accent presets and a hex picker recolor every effect, and optional key sounds cover two voice clips, a synthesized duck squeak, a mechanical click and a local audio file.

items.name: deepseek-harness-plugins#file-change-viewer
items.desc: Takes over the edit/write rows in the chat stream with the official native row shell and collapse behavior; expanding shows per-file code cards with file-type icon, add/delete stats, per-block collapse, highlight/plus-minus toggle, syntax-highlighted unified diff with real file line numbers, and a configurable context margin. Also ships a patch tool (beta, off by default) that applies multi-spot multi-file patches atomically via the *** Begin Patch envelope.

items.name: dsh-workspace-studio
items.desc: Three-pane workspace layout with file-tree browsing, file editing, a non-linear conversation mindmap view, and mobile mode support.

items.name: dsh-math-copy
items.desc: Copying rendered math from the chat puts the formula's LaTeX source on the clipboard instead of KaTeX's visual glyph text.

items.name: dsh-select-ask
items.desc: Select text in the chat to quote it into the composer as an annotation, or to ask about it in a throwaway side panel that leaves no record.

items.name: dsh-pins-fixtool
items.desc: Pins passages selected in a conversation into a per-conversation right-sidebar panel, marks them in the transcript, jumps back to the source passage on click, and quotes a pinned passage into the composer from the selection toolbar or by typing @; the panel tags, searches, filters and exports the pins as a Markdown outline.

items.name: dsh-thinking-highlight
items.desc: Counts keywords inside thinking rows and highlights them once a row is expanded, with a count chip per keyword on the title line that doubles as an on/off switch for that word, per-keyword tint, text colour and text size (10-22px, the same range the host body-text setting uses), typeface, bold / italic / underline and whole-word matching, plus a dedicated settings section.

items.name: dsh-pomodoro
items.desc: Classic 25/5/15 pomodoro timer for DSH that ties each run to the current session task or a manual project name, with a stats panel, a 365-day heatmap, a draggable floating timer and a corner pill, local JSON storage, and CSV export.

items.name: dsh-artifact-center
items.desc: Artifact center: search, preview and open files produced by DSH conversations.

items.name: dsh-read-image-view
items.desc: Display read_image results in DSH Web and Desktop: complete previews, grouped multi-image galleries, transparency checkerboards, keyboard and touch zoom, and session-authorized loading. Verified with DSH Desktop 0.11.1 / Harness 0.2.0-rc.2.

items.name: dsh-free-models-hub
items.desc: A drawer panel for the DSH web UI with a paginated list of free LLMs; one-click or batch writes each as a custom model provider into Settings, plus a local multi-key rotation proxy.

items.name: dsh-decision-split
items.desc: Decision split view for DSH web UI: a decision summary card in the main window plus the full plan in an independently scrollable side panel, so you can review the whole plan while writing decisions and send them back to the agent with one click.

items.name: deepseek-media-gallery
items.desc: Sidebar button that opens a semi-transparent popup for browsing, previewing, downloading and deleting generated images and videos, with a settings page for the media, record and download directories.

items.name: dsh-rail-equalizer
items.desc: System-audio visualizer for the turn navigator rail: the rail reacts in real time to whatever the default playback device is rendering, with four motion modes (spectrum, pulse, sway, travelling wave), a 16-band logarithmic spectrum from a 2048-point FFT on the host, and live sensitivity, strength, bass-punch and wave-speed controls. Audio is captured host-side through WASAPI loopback, so there is no permission prompt, no microphone and no screen capture. The browser half adds one attribute, one stylesheet, some CSS variables and a sidebar control row, and never patches the official component; switching it off removes the attribute, the stylesheet and the variables, returning the rail to its default styling. Windows only.

items.name: dsh-mobile-ui
items.desc: Phone-first drawer shell for DSH Web. Collapses the session list into a tap-to-open drawer, keeps header plugin actions, and turns Settings into a full-width sheet.

items.name: dsh-prompt-polisher
items.desc: Composer prompt polisher: a button in the input tool row rewrites the current draft through the session model (workflow engine, enabled automatically) or an OpenAI-compatible standalone API with host-side key storage, backfills the rewritten text with a replace/give-up dialog when the draft changed mid-run, and ships concise/structured style presets, custom templates with a {draft} placeholder, one-click restore from the status dock and reference-chip protection.

items.name: dsh-chat-thinking-editor
items.desc: Adds an edit action to finalized assistant replies in DeepSeek Harness, letting you rewrite the reply text or reasoning chain; the edit is saved as a surface replacement.

items.name: dsh-reveal-files
items.desc: Turns each produced-file chip into a per-file menu: open the file, copy its path, reveal it in the native file browser, or open a terminal cd-ed into its directory.

items.name: dsh-window-control
items.desc: Tired of going fullscreen by hand every time you open Harness? This plugin fills the screen for you - auto-maximize (keeps the window buttons) or true fullscreen on launch, then maximize / restore / minimize / always-on-top anytime. It quits only after a native confirmation dialog - Esc, double Esc, or Ctrl+Q; in fullscreen, Esc leaves fullscreen first. The window channel installs itself, so no script or Python is needed; the first install takes effect after two DSH restarts.

items.name: dsh-wide-conversation
items.desc: Sets the DSH web client conversation column to a percentage of its own width (40-100, default 100 = full width) instead of the built-in 680-920px reading measure, edited from a collapsible card under Settings > Plugins.

items.name: dsh-sidepanel
items.desc: A Codex-style right side panel for the DSH Web UI — session artifacts browser (live file tree, scan include, preview, reveal) plus a side chat that forks the current session with a model picker, human-pacing scheduled runs and smart send-to-bottom scrolling.

items.name: dsh-soul
items.desc: SoulFusion-style personalization: 9 response styles, custom instructions, persona cards, per-session switching, long-term memory with audit trails.

items.name: dsh-t3-model-picker
items.desc: A port of the T3 Code model picker into the composer: a provider rail, search results grouped under provider headings, favorites kept in the browser, unavailable-provider badges, and Cmd/Ctrl+1..9 jump shortcuts for the first nine rows of the visible list.

items.name: dsh-t3-new-session-screen
items.desc: A T3 Code-style New Session screen for the composer: a "What should we build in <project>?" headline whose project name opens a workspace menu, a reasoning-effort picker in the composer tool row, and a git branch strip under the card that searches local and remote refs and switches with git checkout.

items.name: dsh-t3-session-ui
items.desc: Session-context surfaces ported from T3 Code: a session-row hover card showing machine, git branch, model, agent preset, approval policy and token usage, a status pill covering pending approval, awaiting input, working, error and subagent work, a provider and model chip, a per-session header strip, a lineage breadcrumb, row-menu actions that copy the context or run DSH compaction, and a preference row in DSH Settings for choosing which facts appear. Nothing is added to the composer.

items.name: dsh-custom-style
items.desc: Adds a Custom CSS section to Settings for adjusting dialog dimensions, font sizes, full-window wallpapers, and inspecting stable selectors.

items.name: dsh-assistant-bubble
items.desc: Adds a configurable bubble behind assistant replies, with an optional liquid-glass material and matching chrome for process, tool-call and reasoning rows.

items.name: dsh-plan-build-mode
items.desc: Plan / Build mode switcher for DeepSeek Harness: an always-visible dropdown in the composer beside the permission control that switches the current session both ways through the shipped /plan and /plan off commands, plus a Default mode row in Settings → General that decides the starting mode for newly created sessions.

items.name: dsh-preset-workshop
items.desc: Preset workbench for editing per-agent personas, system prompt sections and tool descriptions, selecting tools and skills, previewing request context, and importing or exporting JSON/YAML configurations.

items.name: dsh-side-chat
items.desc: Codex-style /side side conversations for DeepSeek Harness: a temporary fork of the current chat in a floating panel, inheriting context without interrupting the main task.

items.name: dsh-any-attachment
items.desc: Lets the DSH web UI attach files of any type as pathless @-mentions: pick a workspace file from the @ menu or drop one into the composer, and the agent reads it directly.

items.name: dsh-drop-any-file
items.desc: Extends the DSH web chat drag-and-drop to accept every file type: non-image files are saved into the active session workspace so the agent can read and use them.

items.name: dsh-mcp-toggle
items.desc: Enables or disables MCP servers from Settings → MCP Servers: stops or starts each @deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client connection immediately and persists the change across restarts.

items.name: dsh-inline-comments
items.desc: Annotate on selection, persist through refresh; send the notes with your message and the model answers each one.

items.name: dsh-deepseek-chat
items.desc: Web chat entry for DeepSeek Harness: a sidebar button opening chat.deepseek.com in a dedicated desktop window under dsh-desktop, with in-webview fallback for plain web environments.

items.name: dsh-desktop-shell
items.desc: A dsh web plugin that wraps the running Harness in a native Windows desktop window: it bundles a Wails v3 desktop client (so installing the plugin is enough), probes the web port and writes the ~/.dsh/dsh-web-port.json protocol file for the client, registers a system tray, desktop/Start Menu shortcuts and a startup autostart toggle, and the client can start dsh itself if it is not running.

items.name: dsh-composer-live
items.desc: Live Markdown rendering and typing enhancements for the DSH web composer - syntax-highlighted code blocks, list/quote continuation, format toolbars.

items.name: dsh-video-bg
items.desc: Play a local video behind the DeepSeek Harness chat UI, with play/pause, opacity, scrim and fit controls.

items.name: dsh-snippets
items.desc: Manages CSS and JS snippets for the DSH web GUI, injecting enabled CSS as style elements and running enabled JS in the page, with a sidebar-footer quick toggle, its own page in the Settings navigation, and optional folder or Gist sync.

items.name: dsh-coros-badge
items.desc: Shows the linked COROS watch model and cumulative activity days in the Web UI, expanding to a one-line review and suggestion when clicked.

items.name: dsh-pricing-badge
items.desc: Shows the DeepSeek API peak and off-peak hours, the current model's output price and the account balance in the Web UI.

items.name: ai-plugin#dsh-plugin
items.desc: Aipx toolkit: skills plus a Hub Console that fronts every MCP server with ~4 meta tools — server pool health, per-tool enable/disable, a tool catalog, and a search playground showing exactly what mcp_search hands the model.

items.name: dsh-diagram
items.desc: Renders mermaid code blocks in the chat as diagrams in place (flowchart, sequence, class, state, ER, gantt, pie), with zoom, source toggle, copy PNG and SVG download.

items.name: dsh-quote-annotate-pro
items.desc: Adds selection quoting and anchored annotations to DSH conversations: selected text enters the composer as an anchored quote reference, a quote bar jumps back to the source message and highlights it, and the sent quote block names the turn and role it came from.

items.name: dsh-a2ui-studio
items.desc: A2UI-inspired agent-authored application cards with a persistent machine directory, SSH probes, and reviewed monitoring and control actions. SSH probes require OpenSSH (ssh, ssh-keyscan, ssh-keygen).

items.name: dsh-prompt-forge
items.desc: Prompt optimizer for the composer: a button in the tool row rewrites your draft through a model channel you already configured, streaming into a panel that floats above the composer without taking up layout. Your draft changes only when you click Accept — and Accept is refused while the answer is still streaming, so a half-finished reply can never be written back. It asks first when the draft carries @ references or attachments, which a whole-draft replace would flatten into plain text. No global keyboard shortcuts, and no API key ever reaches the browser: the host half makes the call.

items.name: dsh-rollback
items.desc: TRAE-style conversation rollback rebuilt for DSH 0.1.7-rc.2: per-turn file checkpoints restore touched files and truncate the model context in place under the same session id. Adds a /rollback doctor framework-contract self-check, an affected-file diff preview computed against the current on-disk state so it stays correct after a restart, a one-click undo-last action with a Ctrl+Shift+Z shortcut, a setting for whether rolled-back messages stay hidden, and English UI text.

items.name: dsh-chat-typography
items.desc: Set the DSH Harness conversation flow's font, font size and line spacing, plus the padding between the conversation text and the window edges.

items.name: dsh-hover-archive
items.desc: Codex-style session archiving: hovering a sidebar conversation row reveals an Archive icon at the far right; one click archives the session via the official workspace archive API.

items.name: dsh-image-annotate
items.desc: Draws circles, arrows, boxes and text on the DSH image preview, keeps every mark selectable so it can be dragged, scaled or re-edited later, and attaches the flattened PNG to the composer at the original image resolution.

items.name: dsh-whale-tray
items.desc: Whale tray launcher for DeepSeek Harness: a Windows system-tray app and a macOS menu-bar app that start/stop the dsh service, summon the Web UI, restart and top up — running independently of the dsh process, like a Steam launcher for dsh.

items.name: dsh-web#packages/dsh-task-board
items.desc: Task board for the dsh web GUI: a sidebar multi-column kanban whose cards run in real DSH agent sessions and can also be scheduled with cron expressions, executed host-side even with the browser closed.

items.name: dsh-web#packages/dsh-web-all
items.desc: Plugin and skin collection for the DSH Web UI: task board, Git graph, right-side panel, remote mobile UI, pet, live token stats, and a skin center.

items.name: dsh-gpu-pulse
items.desc: Floating GPU monitor for the DSH Web UI: a compact, draggable strip with one row per discrete GPU (exact name, utilization, VRAM, temperature, power draw) from nvidia-smi, stays visible over side panels and side cards, with a top-VRAM-process list when the driver reports it; degrades to an n/a pill on machines without an NVIDIA driver.

items.name: dsh-adaptive-reasoning
items.desc: Pixel-art reasoning-effort slider for DSH Web with continuous 0–100 dragging, 16ms throttled writes, snap-to-level commits, and a WebGL ember fire that ignites as the slider moves.

items.name: dsh-feedback-combined
items.desc: One-click thumbs up/down feedback UI that injects rating summaries into model context.

items.name: dsh-sidebar-annotations
items.desc: Browser and mini-program element annotations with collapsible composer notes and source locations.

items.name: dsh-prompt-seed
items.desc: Rewrites drafts with one model call or predicts the next reply when empty; independent tasks, safe draft replacement, result previews, and original-text recovery.

items.name: dsh-settings-drawer
items.desc: Lets you choose which items appear in the DeepSeek Harness settings left nav.

items.name: toolfolk-for-dsh
items.desc: Visualize the plugin and model call flow as a 3D office with six fixed workstations, thought bubbles and a delivery sheet.

items.name: dsh-composer-keys
items.desc: Composer key remap for the DeepSeek Harness web UI: bind Enter, Ctrl/Cmd+Enter, Shift+Enter or any custom chord to the Send, Newline or Interrupt actions, with cross-action migration, durable persistence and native behavior preserved by default.

items.name: dsh-agent-bridge
items.desc: Adds a Web composer switch between the native DSH agent and Grok Build, proxying Grok Build sessions and slash commands through ACP.

items.name: dsh-paperclip
items.desc: DSH Web GUI paperclip button: a 📎 button in the composer opens a file picker (drag & drop supported) and inserts file contents into the textarea.

items.name: dsh-sticky-notes
items.desc: Quick sticky notes with colored labels, pin, timed reminders, and password protection for DeepSeek Harness.

items.name: dsh-startup-intro
items.desc: Startup video intro with per-clip playback parameters (segment, speed, brightness, fit, blurred cinema fill, hold ratio and fade duration) and light/dark clip variants selected by the app theme.

items.name: dsh-effort-slider-split-seat
items.desc: Fork of dsh-effort-slider that splits the composer model seat into two buttons: the model name opens the model list, the effort label opens the Claude-style slider with WebGL fire.

items.name: dsh-draft-fold
items.desc: Folds long composer drafts into a compact summary card once a character threshold is reached, without changing message submission.

items.name: dsh-model-picker
items.desc: Replaces the chat input model picker with a provider-grouped, collapsible list: groups models by provider, folds vision-bridge mirror providers back into their upstream, and carries the reasoning-effort options each model declares in settings. Tested on DSH Desktop only; the DSH web build is untested.

items.name: dsh-task-details
items.desc: Task details sidebar for DeepSeek Harness: a "View task details" button under every finished turn opens a resizable right-sidebar panel showing that task's input files, intermediate artifacts, output files, tools and skills used, inferred languages, a step-by-step flow timeline, and the model provider with token usage and cache hit rate.

items.name: dsh-selection-followup
items.desc: Select any text in a DSH chat reply to get a floating Follow-up/Copy pill: one click quotes the selection into the composer so you can type your own follow-up question, or copies it.

items.name: dsh-prompt-enhance
items.desc: Adds a sparkle button left of the model selector in the composer: it rewrites the draft into a clearer, more complete task brief, replaces it in place with one-click undo, offers five rewrite styles, and greys out while the draft carries file/command chips.
